title: GRC Engineer
description:
Hey there!
We’re Fever, the world’s leading tech platform for culture and live entertainment.

Our mission? To democratize access to culture and entertainment. With our proprietary cutting-edge technology and data-driven approach, we’re revolutionizing the way people engage with live entertainment.

Every month, our platform inspires over 300 million people in +55 countries (and counting) to discover unforgettable experiences while also empowering event creators with our data and technology, helping them scale, innovate, and enhance their events to reach new audiences.

Our results? We’ve teamed up with major industry leaders like Netflix, F.C. Barcelona, and Primavera Sound, presented international award-winning experiences, and are backed by several leading global investors! Impressive, right?

To achieve our mission, we are looking for bar-raisers with a hands-on mindset who are eager to help shape the future of entertainment!

Ready to be part of the experience?

Now, let’s discuss this role and what you will do to help achieve Fever’s mission.

About the role:

The GRC Engineer will play a key role in running and scaling Fever's security compliance programme. You will turn compliance from manual, point-in-time exercises into automated, continuously monitored controls, while running several audits in parallel (SOC 2, ISO 27001, ISO 27701, PCI DSS, ENS and others) and keeping them on time.

This role is "engineer-first" and also delivery-focused. You will work with engineering, security, privacy, finance and business teams to translate requirements into technical controls, build automated evidence collection, assess our vendors, answer customer security questionnaires and RFPs, and manage the compliance projects from start to finish across the Fever group companies.

Join us if you thrive in a fast-paced environment and are excited about pushing the boundaries of what’s possible. This is an opportunity to have a real impact as a high-growth global category leader.

What would you do at Fever?

On your first month in Fever:

  • You will be fully integrated into the team. You will participate in planning and follow-up meetings with other areas.
  • You will have met the departments of Fever.
  • You will get familiar with Fever's technological structure and ecosystem (applications, infrastructure, architecture, etc.)
  • You will gain an understanding of our security processes, tools, audit calendar and compliance roadmap.

After 3 months in Fever:

  • You will support SOC 2 initiatives: scope, control set, gap remediation and readiness for the observation period.
  • You will build automated evidence collection workflows using our compliance platform, AI and scripting.
  • You will run audit requests and auditor follow-ups for the ongoing certifications.
  • You will run vendor security assessments and answer customer security questionnaires and RFPs.

On your 6th month in Fever:

  • You will lead the SOC 2 audit with the external auditor, coordinating control owners across the company.
  • You will manage several compliance projects in parallel, with clear milestones, owners and reporting to leadership.
  • You will create a knowledge base and answer library that speeds up questionnaires, RFPs and partner reviews.
  • You will embed compliance checks and telemetry into a standardised GRC platform for continuous control monitoring.

Key responsibilities

  • SOC 2 Type II readiness, observation period and audit, and keep the controls operating effectively afterwards.
  • Participate in multiple audits and certifications in parallel (SOC 2, ISO 27001, ISO 27701, PCI DSS, ENS), coordinating evidence, auditors and control owners.
  • Translate requirements into technical controls and build automated evidence collection and continuous control monitoring.
  • Run the third-party risk management process: vendor security assessments, due diligence, risk ratings and follow-up.
  • Manage responses to customer and partner security questionnaires, RFPs and security assessments.
  • Plan and execute compliance projects end to end, reporting status and risks to leadership.
  • Automate compliance checks on AI governance and enablement.
  • Improve key information security processes, including risk management, policies and security awareness.

About you

Must have:

  • Hands-on experience preparing for and running SOC 2 Type II audits, from scoping to final report.
  • Experience managing international audits and certifications (ISO 27001, PCI DSS or similar).
  • Proven experience in vendor security assessments and answering security questionnaires and RFPs.
  • Programming/scripting/AI skills (e.g. Python, Go, Bash) and experience building API integrations to automate evidence gathering.
  • Strong project management skills: planning, prioritisation and stakeholder follow-up across teams.
  • 3+ years of relevant experience in GRC Engineering, Security Compliance or Security Engineering in a cloud-native company.
  • Fluent in English.
  • Good communication skills.

It would be a plus if you have:

  • Bachelor or Master’s Degree in Computer Science, Information Security, or another similar relevant degree (or equivalent experience in a technical security role).
  • Certifications such as ISO 27001 Lead Auditor/Implementer, CISA, CRISC, CCSP, AWS security or equivalent.
  • Experience with the use of AI and agentic processes to enhance efficiency and provide stronger technical capabilities.
  • Experience with compliance automation platforms (e.g. Vanta, Drata) and AI-assisted workflows for repetitive compliance tasks.
  • Experience with AI risk governance frameworks (NIST AI RMF, ISO/IEC 42001, EU AI Act).

Benefits & Perks

  • Opportunity to have a real impact in a high-growth global category leader
  • 40% discount on all Fever events and experiences
  • Responsibility from day one and professional and personal growth
  • Great work environment with a young, international team of talented people to work with!
  • Health insurance and other benefits such as Flexible remuneration with a 100% tax exemption through Cobee
  • English and Spanish Lessons
  • Wellhub Membership
  • Possibility to receive in advance part of your salary by Payflow
  • Attractive compensation package consisting of base salary and the potential to earn a significant bonus for top performance

Thank you for considering joining Fever. We cannot wait to learn more about you!

Our main goal is to find the best possible talent regardless of place of birth, racial or ethnic origin, gender, gender identity, religion, opinion, sexual orientation, disability, pregnancy, marital status, age or caring responsibilities. If you require any kind of accommodation during the selection process please contact our Talent team so we can help you by providing a welcoming and seamless journey.

We’re Fever, the world’s leading tech platform for culture and live entertainment.

Ready to be part of the experience?

Now, let’s discuss this role and what you will do to help achieve Fever’s mission.

About the role:

This role will be focused on understanding and reducing the security risk of Fever's cloud infrastructure and data. You will run technical risk assessments of our AWS environments, data platforms and new architectures, identify the weaknesses that could lead to a security incident or a data breach, and work with the owning teams until those risks are fixed.

As part of the Cybersecurity team, you will focus on defensive security in cloud and data environments: where our sensitive data lives, who and what can access it, how it is protected, and how secure the infrastructure underneath is. This is an exciting opportunity to make a tangible impact in a high-growth global category leader, working alongside experts to implement best practices and innovative security solutions. If you're passionate about cloud and data security and enjoy tackling challenges in a dynamic environment, we’d love to have you on board!

What would you do at Fever?

On your first month in Fever:

  • You will be fully integrated into the team. You will participate in planning and follow-up meetings with other areas.
  • You will have met the departments of Fever.
  • You will get familiar with Fever's technological structure and ecosystem (applications, infrastructure, data platforms, architecture, etc.)
  • You will gain an understanding of our security processes, tools, risk methodology and overall security landscape.

After 3 months in Fever:

  • You will run infrastructure and architecture risk assessments using our risk methodology.
  • You will map where sensitive data is stored and processed (S3, databases, data warehouse, SaaS) and who can access it.
  • You will participate in security configuration reviews to ensure cloud and data environments meet industry standards.
  • You will develop automation to detect data exposure, excessive permissions and misconfigurations.
  • You will participate in vulnerability management sessions, collaborating with stakeholders to drive continuous security improvements.

On your 6th month in Fever:

  • You will own the risk assessment process for infrastructure and data, from design reviews to risk acceptance.
  • You will drive the remediation of the main data and infrastructure risks with clear owners and deadlines.
  • You will lead initiatives to implement secure solutions for data: classification, encryption and key management, and least-privilege access.
  • You will act as a point of contact for technical guidance on cloud architecture, data security and configurations.
  • You will develop cybersecurity technical documentation and secure best practices guidelines to educate and support stakeholders.

Key responsibilities

  • Perform technical risk assessments and threat models of cloud infrastructure, data platforms and new architectures, and document residual risk.
  • Maintain the infrastructure and data risk register, prioritising risks and tracking treatment plans with owners.
  • Identify, classify and protect sensitive data across AWS services, data warehouses and SaaS (data security posture).
  • Review and enforce encryption, key management (KMS), network isolation and identity and access controls for data stores.
  • Conduct regular security assessments to identify vulnerabilities and misconfigurations in the AWS ecosystem.
  • Develop and deploy automated security solutions to detect, report and remediate data exposure and misconfigurations.
  • Collaborate with Data, DevOps and engineering teams to build security into data pipelines and infrastructure.

About you

Must have:

  • Proven experience performing security risk assessments of cloud infrastructure and architectures (threat modeling, likelihood/impact, residual risk).
  • Strong experience with AWS cloud infrastructure security including IAM, networking, KMS, S3, logging and organisation-level controls.

  • Knowledge of risk and cloud security frameworks (ISO 27005, NIST SP 800-53, CIS Benchmarks, CSA CCM).
  • Ability to work cross-functionally and explain risk to technical and business audiences.
  • 3+ years of experience in cloud security and/or cybersecurity roles.

  • Fluent in English.

  • Experience with Data Security Posture Management (DSPM), CNAPP or CSPM tools.
  • Familiarity with infrastructure as code (Terraform, CloudFormation, or similar).
  • Knowledge of privacy regulations affecting data (GDPR) and PCI DSS.
  • Security certifications (e.g. CCSP, AWS Security Specialty, CRISC, CISSP or similar).

title: Enterprise Solution Engineer - South East
description:
Location: Remote – South East Region (must reside in FL, GA, SC, NC, or TN)

Sigma’s vision is to create an insight-driven world where people, organizations, and, ultimately, humanity are transformed for the better by data. At Sigma, we are building a cloud-native business intelligence platform that allows users to tap into their biggest databases hosted in the cloud and easily conduct ad hoc analysis to gain business insights in seconds. All without any SQL programming. We are growing the Solution Engineering team and are looking for a Solution Engineer who will help redefine the business intelligence landscape for our customers. You will join a talented team of Solution Engineers with a shared mission to truly make data access easy to drive business results.

The Sigma Solution Engineer believes in the power of analytics to transform organizations and uncover new data insights to increase business agility. The Sigma Solution Engineer will act as the trusted advisor to our prospects and customers working in tandem with Sales, Business Development, Product Management, Engineering, and Support. This individual is ultimately responsible for managing and delivering on all activities related to the technical presales cycle. This includes presentations, demonstrations, and hands on development of prototypes. You will align closely with our field Regional Sales Managers (Enterprise) focused on sales in new and existing accounts.

What You Will Be Doing

  • Understand and uncover business challenges and issues faced by the customer and be able to run a targeted discovery sessions or workshop
  • Engage with business users to define, create, and showcase solution prototypes
  • Build and present customized demos for customers, trade shows, and webinars
  • Confidently present and articulate the business value of the Sigma platform to all levels within an organization
  • Deliver product, technical, and security related responses on RFPs/RFIs
  • Participate in product, sales, and relevant technology certifications to acquire, maintain, and grow skill sets
  • Work as a team player by contributing, learning, and sharing new knowledge
  • Be conversant in integration and data migration approaches to facilitate enterprise-type sales cycles
  • Manage multiple customer engagements concurrently
  • Attain quarterly and annual objectives assigned by management
  • Become a Sigma champion and product expert, prospects and customers will look to you for advice and expertise

Qualifications We Need

  • Minimum 5 years of business intelligence experience
  • Customer relationship skills
  • Strong understanding of database concepts
  • Cloud data warehouse experience - Snowflake, Redshift, BigQuery
  • ETL experience - Fivetran, Matillion or traditional ETL
  • Excellent organizational skills and ability to multitask in a fast-paced startup environment
  • Experience implementing production business intelligence solutions or proof of concepts
  • Bachelor’s degree in computer science or related field or equivalent technical & business experience
  • 25% Travel

Qualifications We Want (also, skills you’ll learn!)

  • Experience at a SaaS company or with cloud architectures
  • Experience with data analytics business use cases
  • Business consulting
  • AI/Apps development experience
  • Startup experience

About Sigma

Sigma is a modern analytics & business intelligence (BI) application built for the cloud. Trusted by data-first companies, Sigma provides live access to cloud data warehouses using an intuitive spreadsheet interface—empowering business experts to ask more of their data without writing a single line of code. With the full power of SQL, the cloud, and a familiar interface, business users have the freedom to analyze data in real time without limits. Sigma is self-service analytics as it was meant to be: a single source of truth that eliminates data extracts, simplifies analysis, and drives BI adoption at every level of business. Sigma is closing the gap between data teams and business experts. To learn more about Sigma, visit www.sigmacomputing.com or join the conversation on Twitter @SigmaComputing.

About us:

Sigma is the AI Apps and agentic analytics platform built on the cloud data warehouse. Business and technical teams use Sigma to explore live data, build intelligent applications, and automate critical workflows all without moving data or breaking governance. Sigma supports a spreadsheet interface, SQL, Python, and native AI in a single governed workspace, giving every team the speed to act and IT the control to scale. Sigma is trusted by more than 2,000 customers, including AMD, Duolingo, Colgate-Palmolive, and JPMorgan Chase.

Sigma announced its $80M in Series E financing in May 2026. The round was led by Princeville Capital, with new strategic investors Databricks Ventures, ServiceNow Ventures, and Workday Ventures participating alongside returning investors Altimeter Capital, Avenir Growth Capital, D1 Capital Partners, K5 Global, NewView Capital, Spark Capital, Sutter Hill Ventures, and XN. This milestone follows Sigma reaching $200M in annual recurring revenue in April 2026, with more than 100% year-over-year growth and 1.1 million new active users added in the latest fiscal year.

Come join us!

Benefits For Our Full-Time Employees:

  • Equity
  • Generous health benefits
  • Flexible time off policy. Take the time off you need!
  • Paid bonding time for all new parents
  • Traditional and Roth 401k
  • Commuter and FSA benefits
  • Lunch Program
  • Dog friendly office

Sigma is an equal opportunity employer. We are committed to building a smart and strong team regardless of race, color, ancestry, religion, sex, national origin, sexual orientation, age, citizenship, marital status, disability, gender, gender identity or expression, veteran, or any other protected status. We look forward to learning how your experience can enable all of us to grow.

Note: We have an in-office work environment in all our offices in SF, NYC, London and Sydney. All roles have a 25% travel expectation unless explicitly stated otherwise.

Our Privacy Practices

When you submit a job application on this site, Sigma processes your personal data for the purposes of evaluating your candidacy for employment at Sigma and as otherwise needed throughout the recruitment and hiring process. Please review Sigma’s Candidate Privacy Notice for more details. Please note that your personal data may be transferred to a country other than the one in which it was provided (including to the USA, the UK, and Canada, Australia).

Sigma’s use of AI

This hiring process utilizes artificial intelligence tools to assist in candidate screening and assessment. Our AI tools are designed to complement, not replace, human decision-making.

title: Security Engineer, Offensive Security
description:
Role Description

As anÂ Offensive Security Engineer within Dropbox Security, you will investigate how attackers could compromise our products and infrastructure, including AI-enabled applications and agentic systems. You will help identify meaningful attack paths and improve the controls intended to prevent, detect or contain them.

This is a hands-on offensive security and threat research role with broad scope and meaningful impact. You will contribute to investigations and multi-phase red team exercises, help prioritize work based on risk, develop attack techniques, and build tooling and automation that expand the reach of our security testing. You will apply practical AI security knowledge alongside broader offensive security skills across applications, cloud infrastructure, and identity systems. Working closely with experienced researchers and partners across Product Security, Detection & Response, Threat Intelligence, Privacy, and engineering, you will help translate technical findings into clear business risk, recommend practical improvements, and validate their effectiveness through retesting. Sound judgment, clear communication, responsible execution, and ownership of your work are essential to the role. You will contribute to the Red Teamâs tools, research methods, and testing practices while developing your own areas of expertise, investigating emerging technologies, and helping advance Dropboxâs offensive security capabilities. You will have opportunities to deepen your skills, publish research, take on increasingly complex projects, and see your work influence security decisions across Dropbox.

Our Engineering Career Framework is viewable by anyone outside the company and describes whatâs expected for our engineers at each of our career levels. Check out our blog post on this topic and more here.

Responsibilities

  • Plan and execute offensive security assessments by defining objectives, scope, rules of engagement, and safeguards, adapting your approach as new evidence emerges.
  • Investigate unfamiliar applications, infrastructure, APIs, and trust boundaries to identify and trace meaningful attack paths.
  • Develop and safely demonstrate exploits and attack chains that clearly establish potential impact to Dropbox.
  • Build and improve offensive security tools, agents, automation, and testing harnesses, ensuring results are reliable, repeatable, and appropriately validated.
  • Assess security risks across AI-enabled applications, agents, tool integrations, and supporting infrastructure, including the responsible use of AI-assisted research techniques.
  • Partner with security, privacy, legal, and engineering teams to communicate risk, strengthen prevention and detection capabilities, address root causes, and verify improvements through retesting.

Many teams at Dropbox run Services with on-call rotations, which entails being available for calls during both core and non-core business hours. If a team has an on-call rotation, all engineers on the team are expected to participate in the rotation as part of their employment. Applicants are encouraged to ask for more details of the rotations to which the applicant is applying.

Requirements

  • 5+ years in offensive security, vulnerability research, red teaming or closely related security engineering, or equivalent demonstrated capability.
  • A track record of independently leading complex investigations or engagements and discovering and exploiting non-trivial vulnerabilities.
  • Understanding of application security, authentication and authorisation, cloud infrastructure, APIs and software supply chains, with deep practical expertise in one or more areas and the ability to trace attack paths across systems and trust boundaries.
  • Hands-on experience attacking or evaluating LLMs, AI agents, ML systems, AI-enabled applications, or agentic architectures.
  • Familiarity with security risks in AI-enabled applications, agents and tool integrations, and the ability to investigate unfamiliar technologies.
  • Ability to write code to build or adapt offensive tools and automation, and to read and investigate unfamiliar production codebases.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience developing novel attacks, repeatable security evaluations or testing frameworks for AI-enabled systems, or building and validating AI-assisted offensive research capabilities.
  • Expertise across multiple attack surfaces, or advanced specialist capability in areas such as exploit development, reverse engineering, endpoint security, cloud exploitation or software supply-chain attacks.
  • Experience developing automated vulnerability discovery, fuzzing, program analysis or evaluation systems across large codebases or complex environments.
  • Experience conducting coordinated exercises with defenders to measure detection and response effectiveness and validate improvements against realistic attack techniques.
  • Contributions through original research, vulnerability disclosures, open-source tools, technical publications, internal training or mentoring.

Durable Skills

AI fluency means using these tools to amplify human judgment, not replace it. We believe people with these skills will thrive as work and technology continue to evolve:

  • Awareness: Understand yourself and others.
  • Judgment: Evaluate information and make decisions in complex situations.
  • Adaptability: Learn, adjust, and stay effective through change.
  • Connection: Communicate, collaborate, and build trust.

title: Analytics Engineer - Data Platform (m/f/d)
description:
At Statista, we’re all about facts and data, for we are the world's leading business data platform. By providing reliable and easy-to-use data as well as various data analytics products and services, we empower people worldwide to make fact-based decisions.

Founded in Hamburg in 2007, we have quickly grown into a global company with offices in major cities such as London, New York, Berlin and Tokyo. And we still have a lot of plans. Our constant growth does not only prove our success, but also keeps creating new development and career opportunities for our employees.

We value and celebrate our diverse culture. You are welcome here for who you are, no matter where you come from, what you look like, or whether you prefer bar graphs to pie charts. Your story matters – keep writing it as part of our team.

Are you ready to join us?

You’ll join Statista’s newly formed Data Platform team. We’re building a central platform that brings together data—from market statistics to consumer surveys—under consistent standards for quality, documentation, and access. This gives product teams and AI agents a trusted foundation to build new applications and features without duplicating data or setting up separate pipelines.

Your role

  • Design, implement, and maintain backend services in Python that power our data access and distribution layer

  • Build and operate automated build, test, and deployment pipelines following CI/CD and GitOps practices, running on AWS and Kubernetes

  • Design and maintain data models and schemas (Avro, SQL) for our data pipelines and services, and publish them to downstream consumers via our Kafka-based distribution platform and schema registry

  • Build access-layer data models in our analytics environment (e.g., Snowflake) so applications can work with the data directly, including via API

  • Act as the coordination interface between the Data and Tech divisions, aligning priorities, schemas, and timelines across upstream and downstream teams

Your profile

  • 4+ years of experience in analytics engineering, data engineering, or a related role.

  • Strong SQL skills and solid experience in data modeling (e.g., dimensional modeling, star schemas).

  • Hands-on experience with event streaming and message distribution, ideally Kafka, including schema management with the Kafka schema registry (Avro, Protobuf, or JSON Schema).

  • Experience designing data contracts and schemas between upstream producers and downstream consumers.

  • Experience with cloud data warehouses (e.g., Snowflake, BigQuery, Redshift) and modern data stack tools (e.g., dbt, CI/CD).

  • Openness to AI-assisted development workflows (e.g., Claude Code or similar).

  • Comfort working at the boundary of streaming/operational data and analytical data models, and building access layers that serve applications via API.

  • Strong attention to detail with a quality-focused and structured working style.

  • Interest in data governance, standards, and scalable data architecture.

  • Analytical mindset with strong problem-solving skills.

  • Excellent communication skills in English (German is a plus), with both technical and business stakeholders, combined with a solid understanding of business requirements and contexts.

What we offer

In addition to our great team, culture, and our shared goal of empowering people with data, there are many other things that make Statista a great place to work! Join us and benefit from:

  • Work from abroad up to 30 calendar days a year

  • Hybrid work and flex-time

  • International team and social events

  • Subsidized urban mobility and access to fitness and wellness options

  • Free access to Langdock and all its amazing functionalities

  • Career & training opportunities

  • Attractive locations and modern offices

  • Mental health support with OpenUp

Some of the benefits listed here apply only to the German entity and to Junior-level roles or above.

title: Business Operations (Revenue & GTM)
description:
Our team shared’s mission is deploy AI agents to transform how patients and doctors connect

We believe healthcare shouldn’t be defined by missed calls, endless waiting lines, and overwhelmed staff. Patients and professionals deserve better.

Vocca builds AI voice agents that answer every call instantly, schedule and reschedule appointments, and free up staff to focus on what matters most: care.

Already trusted by 15 000+ providers, we’re transforming the patient–provider relationship, one call at a time.

Want to shape the future of healthcare?

Join us !

  • Discover our company culture and values

  • Here is a product teaser

  • Eliott's interview for Welcome to the jungle

  • Eliott's quick interview for Speedinvest

  • Articles on our A round (techfundingnews, Maddyness, les echos, our blog)

Context

We’re experiencing one of the strongest growth rates in the French Tech ecosystem, and we’re targeting €30M ARR by end of 2027. To get there, we need to triple the sales team while increasing productivity, and therefore the ARR signed per account executive.

Your Mission

At the end of your first year, you will have built a system in which the sales team has tripled in size and increased ARR per sales rep by 50% (from €400K to €600K).

To achieve this, you own Business & Revenue Operations end-to-end. You sit at the intersection of Sales, Ops, Finance and Product. You report to Robin, Head of RevOps, and work hand in hand with the Head of Sales, your main internal client.

Beyond the revenue engine, you are the go-to partner of leadership on revenue decisions: segmentation and targeting, pricing, sales capacity planning, and the operational setup of our US expansion. You turn ambiguous questions into structured, data-backed recommendations, then you build the solution yourself.

This is an A-to-Z, hands-on role. You define the strategy, build, run, document and iterate.

Responsibilities

Sales & GTM Ops

  • Own the CRM (Attio): pipeline structure, stages, fields, hygiene

  • Define and track funnel metrics (SQL, win rate, cycle length, ARR)

  • Build deal workflows, pricing logic and approvals

  • Support sales with clean data, dashboards and forecasts

  • Instrument meetings, calls, emails and demos in the CRM

  • Define activity standards, ensure data completeness, provide visibility on activity vs results

  • Implement compensation rules as the single source of truth; automate calculations, reporting and payout exports; make sure numbers are clear, trusted and undisputed

  • Own the sales tool stack (demo platform, telephony, call recording, integrations): reliability, adoption and proper usage across the team

Onboarding & Delivery Ops

  • Structure deployment workflows (from signed deal to live)

  • Track time-to-live, blockers and handoffs

  • Standardize configs, templates and playbooks

Billing & Revenue

  • Own the contracts → billing → cash collection flow

  • Work with tools like Hyperline, Stripe and invoicing

  • Track MRR, ARR, churn, expansion and cohorts

  • Ensure pricing is applied correctly (per site, per provider, per call)

Revenue Analytics & Strategic Projects

  • Build weekly and monthly revenue dashboards

  • Track unit economics (ARPA, gross margin, CAC, LTV)

  • Lead ad hoc analyses for leadership: market segmentation, territory design, pricing, capacity planning

  • Surface issues early. No surprises.

Process & Documentation

  • Write everything down (Notion)

  • Create SOPs so the company doesn’t rely on tribal knowledge

  • Make the org scalable from [25] to 100+ people

 

This role is for you if

  • 3–6 years in RevOps, Sales Ops, BizOps in a SaaS / startup that scaled

  • Very strong with tools and wants to build from the ground up (CRM, spreadsheets, automation)

  • Structured thinker, you prioritize your task according to the impact on your yearly mission : scale sales and attain 10M in ARR.

  • You're structured, pragmatic, and execution-driven

  • You're comfortable working directly with founders

  • You care about data, but even more about things actually working

  • Fluent in French, Professional English

 

Benefits

  • Equity (BSPCE)

  • Executive contract (cadre) on a forfait-jours basis, with ~8–12 RTT days per year (depending on the year's public holidays).

  • Hybrid rhythm from Paris: 3-4 days at the office, 1-2 day per week remote.

  • MacBook provided.

  • Meal vouchers: €9 per working day (55% covered by the company).

  • EGYM Wellpass (Gymlib).

  • Health insurance: 50% of Alan covered.

  • Public transport: 50% of Navigo covered.

  • Annual offsite and multiple team events throughout the year.

Recruitment process

1️⃣ Discovery call (30 min) with our Talent Acquisition Manager

2️⃣ Hiring Manager interview (45 min) with Robin, Head of Revops

3️⃣ Case study (1hr) with Alexandre, and Robin

3️⃣ Culture / founder fit (1hr) with Eliott, CEO and/or Hugo, CTO + coffee with the team

4️⃣ Reference check

5️⃣ Offer ! 🎉

We aim to keep the process within 30 days. You’ll receive continuous feedback throughout.

Why should you join Vocca?

  • An entrepreneurial adventure, with a supportive, high-energy, execution-focused team

  • A product already live, with delighted customers in a fast-growing market (healthcare automation, voice AI)

  • A true scaling phase, with everything still to build

  • Real responsibilities from day one

We hire people, not roles.

If you're excited about our opportunities but don't check every box, we'd love to hear from you. Everyone, no matter how underrepresented, should feel free to apply as it can only bring learnings or success. If you identify yourself as a woman: Did you know that research shows women often apply only when meeting 100% of requirements?

We'll be thrilled to receive your application!

description:
Our team shared’s mission is deploy AI agents to transform how patients and doctors connect

We believe healthcare shouldn’t be defined by missed calls, endless waiting lines, and overwhelmed staff. Patients and professionals deserve better.

Vocca builds AI voice agents that answer every call instantly, schedule and reschedule appointments, and free up staff to focus on what matters most: care.

Already trusted by 15 000+ providers, we’re transforming the patient–provider relationship, one call at a time.

Want to shape the future of healthcare?

Join us !

  • Discover our company culture and values

  • Here is a product teaser

  • Eliott's interview for Welcome to the jungle

  • Eliott's quick interview for Speedinvest

  • Articles on our A round (techfundingnews, Maddyness, les echos, our blog)

Vocca in a few words

Vocca is an AI voice agent that answers 100% of the calls of medical centres. The patient calls, the AI books the appointment or answers the question, and the medical secretaries keep their time for the cases where a human is really needed.

  • $20M raised, with the founders of Alan and Datadog as investors

  • Close to 1 million calls a month going through the platform

  • More than 1,000 medical staff use our product all day

The problem

Every medical centre has its own rules. Who can book what, with which practitioner, at what time, what to do with an urgent case at 6 pm. Today these rules live in prompts and in the heads of our ops team. Each new clinic takes hours of manual work, and the ops team is the bottleneck of our growth.

We are building the platform that removes that bottleneck. A scenario engine where the behaviour of the agent is structured configuration, not free text. A self-serve onboarding where a clinic connects its software and sets itself up. A dashboard where the medical staff stop executing and start supervising: the agent handles the volume, humans check what matters.

This is the difference between selling a service and selling a product. The long term vision is simple: a clinic signs, connects its software and is live within days, without a single developer involved. You would be building that.

What you will own

  • The scenario engine and its configuration model. One product that handles the rules of thousands of medical centres without becoming a swamp.

  • The self-serve onboarding, from the backend to the dashboard. Internal tooling already took a clinic deployment from days to under an hour. The next step is zero developer ticket on a standard onboarding.

  • The dashboard our clinics use all day. Fast, reliable and clean enough that a medical secretary prefers it to the phone. We take frontend quality seriously and follow a design system written in code.

  • Your features, end to end. From the spec with the ops team to production, and the fix when something breaks, with the reason it does not happen again.

How we build

  • Experimental, not R&D. You test, you prove with data, you ship. Challenging a decision means coming back with a result, not a debate.

  • Ship, then fix the last 1%. We ship the version that works, then fix the last 1% when it shows up. With AI, this trade off is much cheaper than before. The judgment about what not to touch is yours.

  • AI, seriously. Agents in every workflow, Claude Max provided. A migration estimated at 3 months was done in 2 weeks.

  • Close to the field. Every change lands in front of more than 1,000 medical staff. You talk every day with the ops team that deploys clinics and the sales team that sells the product.

Stack

TypeScript everywhere, backend and frontend (Node, monorepo), PostgreSQL, a design system written in code. We are migrating our last Python services to TypeScript over the coming months.

Who does well here

  • 3 to 8 years building full-stack products in production, in startups that were growing fast.

  • You stayed long enough somewhere to see a system live, break and get better, and you learned from it.

  • TypeScript is your main language, backend and frontend, not a line on your CV. You have a real eye for interface quality and the discipline to follow a design system.

  • You think about the product and the business as much as the code, and you know how to build systems that hold when the volume explodes.

  • You move without waiting for a perfect frame: you try, you propose, you ship. You ask for help when you are stuck.

  • You had good practices before AI: solid system design, clean refactoring and a good nose for the risks of generated code that nobody tested.

Probably not for you if you need every feature fully specified before you start

What we expect from you

  • First week. Onboarded on the stack, your first improvement on the dashboard is in production.

  • First month. You own one feature end to end, from the spec with the ops team to production, without mockups or hand-holding.

  • First 3 months. The first version of the scenario engine is in production. A standard clinic can be onboarded without a developer ticket.

  • 6 to 12 months. Most new clinics are live within 7 days. Clinics configure their own rules in the dashboard.

Process: 4 steps, fast

  1. 45 min with Nans (Talent).

  2. 45 min with Pierrick, Head of Engineering.

  3. 1h30 in our office with the engineering team: coding without AI and a real conversation about product architecture.

  4. 30 min with Hugo, CTO.

Then references and an offer. When the match is obvious, we have made an offer in 24 hours. You get feedback at every step.

Practical

  • Paris, rue d'Alexandrie (Sentier), new offices.

  • Hybrid, 3 days at the office.

  • BSPCE.

  • Claude Max provided.

We aim to keep the process within 30 days. You’ll receive continuous feedback throughout.

title: Product Engineer, AI (Junior to Mid-Level)
description:
About us

At PastaHR, we're building the Agentic AI platform for enterprise recruiting teams.

Recruiters are drowning in applications, repetitive tasks, and manual processes. Meanwhile, agentic AI adoption in enterprise recruiting is still in its infancy. We're here to change that. Our platform integrates with existing applicant tracking systems like Workday and SAP, bringing AI-powered screening, scheduling, and custom AI agents into the workflows recruiters already use.

While other recruiting startups sell to startups, we bring AI into the real world. We serve enterprise customers across industries like retail, manufacturing, construction, logistics or financial services including companies like Aldi, Siemens, Swisscom or Vontobel.

We're a small, ambitious team with big goals.

Our team brings together people with strong backgrounds in technology, startups, and entrepreneurship. As a bootstrapped company, we grow through real commercial success. That means we're resourceful, move fast, and achieve a lot with a lean team.

At PastaHR, you'll take on real responsibility from day one, have a direct impact on our product and customers, and grow alongside the company. You'll be pushed outside your comfort zone, but you'll never be on your own.

If you thrive on ownership, enjoy solving hard problems, and want to build something that actually makes a difference, you'll feel right at home.

About the role

  • You will plan, build and ship AI-powered features and agents to be used by some of Europe's largest companies.

  • You will collaborate closely with our customers to improve and integrate AI agents into their daily workflows

  • Unlike at other companies, you will own projects end to end – even if as a junior (with the required support from the team)

  • You'll work across the stack, from frontend interfaces to AI agents and enterprise integrations, taking ownership from idea to production

Our tech stack:

  • Nextjs / React / Typescript / Shadcn / Tailwind/ AI SDKs / PostgreSQL / dbos

  • All the latest LLMs and Decision Models / Langfuse for observability and evals

  • Infra: AWS

What we're looking for

  • You must have finished your degree and are looking for a full-time position (this is not an internship).

  • You are a builder at heart. This means you built full-stack applications yourself and can showcase projects beyond university coursework.

  • You are highly skilled using AI coding agents. You use AI to move faster but take full responsibility for the code you ship.

  • You care deeply about user experience, have an eye for good design, and want to keep improving it.

  • You're curious, proactive, and comfortable figuring things out independently.

  • You have demonstrated ambition beyond academics through personal projects, internships, entrepreneurial ventures, or extracurricular activities.

  • You are willing to work in a hybrid setup with multiple days a week in our office in Zurich.

Nice-to-haves

  • Experience with TypeScript, React, and Node.js.

  • Experience with non-deterministic systems, especially LLM evaluations

  • Experience with durable execution frameworks such as dbos, Temporal etc.

  • Fluent in German (We work with companies in the DACH region, the better your German, the closer to the end user you can be.)

What we offer

  • Real ownership and impact from day one

  • Fast learning alongside experienced engineers and founders

  • Hands-on work with cutting-edge AI and high token limits

  • Latest MacBook Pro

  • 26 vacation days per year (you can use flexibly)

PastaHR is for you, if:

  • You enjoy taking full ownership of your work and proactively driving topics forward.

  • You like working with the newest tools and finding the best solution to a problem.

  • You’re eager to learn quickly, grow in your role, and evolve with the company.

  • You want to help shape the company and see the real impact of your work.

PastaHR is not for you, if:

  • You don't want a challenge, learn a ton and grow with the company.

  • You need clear structures in the team and a lot of guidance.

  • Your preferred work environment consists primarily of remote work/home office.

  • You are in search of a more laid-back workplace.

The process

  1. Introduction Call (30 minutes): A casual conversation to get to know each other and discuss your background and interests.

  2. Technical Interview (45-60 minutes): Dive into technical skills and problem-solving.

  3. Personal Fit Interview (30-45 minutes): Meet one of our founders to explore alignment with our values and vision.

  4. Onsite Case Study (1–2 days): Join us at PastaHR to work on a case study, interact with the team, and experience our culture firsthand.

  5. Decision: We’ll get back to you promptly with our decision and next steps.

We are an equal opportunity employer! We embrace and celebrate diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all employees. We are open to all groups of people without regard to age, color, national origin, race, religion, gender, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity and/or expression, marital status, or any other legally protected characteristics.

title: Junior Business Controller (Data specialist)
description:
Do you enjoy working with numbers, analysing data and finding out what is really happening behind the figures? As Junior Business Controller at HG, you will support our Controllers and Group Financial Controller with financial analyses, reporting and increasingly data-driven insights.

At HG, you will work in a compact organisation with an international reach. You will get the opportunity to learn from experienced colleagues, take responsibility early and turn financial and business data into insights that help us make better decisions. We value people who are curious, take initiative and have the energy to turn ideas into action.

About the role

As Junior Business Controller, you will support our Controllers and gradually build your own areas of responsibility. The role combines financial activities with a strong focus on data, analysis and improving management information.

You will:

  • support the Business Controllers with financial analyses, reporting and recurring control activities;

  • own and maintain the data model

  • analyse financial and business data and translate it into useful insights;

  • investigate differences, trends and developments and help explain what is happening behind the numbers;

  • build, review and improve data models used for reporting and analysis;

  • use various tools including Excel and Power BI to make information clearer and easier to use;

  • investigate how data flows from source to report and identify opportunities to improve data quality and reporting;

  • help reduce manual work by finding smarter and more reliable ways of working;

  • contribute to improvements in management information and financial processes;

  • translate questions from colleagues into practical analyses and insights.

An important part of the role is conceptual thinking about data. You understand how information should be structured, see connections between different data points and can think about how a data model can be improved to provide better business insights.

Your development in data

Next to your finance responsibilities, you will grow step by step into the data side of the role, coached by our current Data Specialist. You do not need to master these areas from day one: together we will set up a development path in which you learn to:

  • contribute to HG's Business Intelligence and data strategy, making sure data supports our company goals;

  • design and maintain data models (such as star schemas) and database/Lakehouse structures, so that data is accurate, reliable and accessible;

  • integrate data from different sources and systems in a medallion model (Bronze for raw data, Silver for engineering, Gold for consumption);

  • manage the HG Data Dictionary, data repositories and the underlying data architecture;

  • apply data governance and data quality practices, including audit trails, data privacy requirements and best-practice frameworks such as DAMA;

  • map business processes (BPMN 2.0) and translate business requirements into practical data solutions;

  • work with tools such as SQL, Python (pandas), Power Query, Power Automate and Microsoft Fabric, and over time explore AI techniques;

  • document data models and data processes, and monitor data systems for performance and reliability.

This gives you a strong combination of finance and data expertise, which is becoming increasingly valuable in modern Business Control.

Collaboration & positioning

You will be part of the Finance team and work closely with our Business Controllers. This gives you the opportunity to learn from experienced colleagues while contributing your own analytical and data-driven perspective.

Because HG is a relatively compact organisation, you will have direct contact with colleagues across different disciplines. This means you can quickly see how your analyses and improvements are being used in the business. At the same time, you will work within an international organisation, with colleagues and markets across Europe.

The role is based at our head office in Almere.

HG is a compact, fast-growing and international organization where you can directly see the impact of your work. This requires ownership, initiative and a pragmatic, results-oriented mindset. The team culture is open, pragmatic and focused on results, encouraging you to bring ideas forward, challenge constructively and take responsibility. Everything we do is guided by our three core values: Aim High, Be Brave, Be Connected.


What you bring

We are looking for someone who is analytical, energetic and curious. You enjoy getting to the bottom of a question rather than simply producing a report. You want to understand why the numbers look the way they do and how the underlying data can provide better insights.

You bring:

  • willingness to learn

  • around 3–5 years of relevant work experience, for example as a big 4 auditor, Finance Analyst, Data Analyst or Junior Business Controller;

  • solid knowledge of finance and accounting, preferably gained through an education in Accountancy, Finance & Control, Business Information Management, Data Analytics);

  • experience with or a strong interest in Power BI;

  • strong analytical skills;

  • the ability to think conceptually about data, reporting and data models;

  • a curious and proactive approach to solving problems;

  • the confidence to ask questions and challenge existing ways of working;

  • an energetic mindset and the drive to learn and improve;

  • a genuine eagerness to learn and to keep developing yourself, both in finance and in data;

  • fluent English; knowledge of Dutch is desirable.

  • experience with AI tools, such as Copilot.

    Please note that we do not offer visa or work permit sponsorship for this position. You must therefore hold a valid EU work permit

What we offer

This is a role where you can build a strong foundation in modern Business Control while developing further in data and analytics. You will not only work with existing reports and figures, but also have the opportunity to improve how information is structured, analysed and used.

You can expect:

  • a monthly salary between €4.000 and €5.200 (excluding holiday allowance), depending on your experience.

  • an annual on-target bonus of 10% of your gross annual salary; 

  • full-time employment with 30 days of annual leave; 

  • a pension scheme; 

  • a commuting allowance; 

  • a dynamic and ambitious working environment where initiative and ownership are valued;

  • the opportunity to grow towards a broader Business Controller role as your knowledge, experience and responsibilities develop;

  • structured coaching by our Data Specialist to develop your data skills alongside your finance role;

  • a friendly, welcoming team, with a free shared lunch every Monday and monthly social drinks.

We are HG

HG is a leading European brand in specialist cleaning and maintenance products.

title: Solutions Integration Architect - Workday
description:
About Zip

Zip is the AI platform for enterprise procurement — built for humans and agents working together. By orchestrating procurement across teams, tools, and suppliers with the help of AI agents, companies can secure the resources they need to innovate faster than ever before.

The world’s most influential enterprises trust Zip, including T-Mobile, OpenAI, AMD, Mars, Dollar Tree, and more. Together they’ve saved over $8 billion and processed over $500 billion in spend. Zip’s team includes product leaders from Apple, Airbnb, and Meta, as well as former procurement leaders from United Health, Sanofi, MGM Resorts, Discover, and NASA.

Backed by Adams Street, Alkeon, BOND, CRV, DST, Tiger Global, and Y Combinator, Zip has raised $371 million, most recently at a $2.2 billion valuation and has been recognized by Forbes Fintech 50, Fast Company's Most Innovative Companies, Inc. Best in Business, and LinkedIn Top Startups.

Your Role

We’re looking for a Solutions Architect to help build the technical foundation that powers Zip’s ERP and integration ecosystem. This role focuses on internal technical enablement, navigating complex customer environments to architect the cleanest possible solutions, partnering closely with Product, and driving best-in-class standards across all of Zip’s integration workflows - with a specific focus on the Workday Financials ecosystem.

As Zip continues to scale rapidly across enterprise customers like Coinbase, Notion, Canva, Samsara, Snowflake, and Databricks, your impact will be foundational: creating reusable integration assets, defining standards of how the Zip product interacts with external systems.

You Will

You’ll work closely with our Engineering, Product, and Design (EPD) teams while reporting to Engineering to design, maintain, and iterate on Zip-owned ERP and integration templates that power scalable, repeatable customer implementations. Your work will directly influence how hundreds of future implementations are delivered, raising the technical bar for both our EPD teams and our customer-facing technical consultant organization.

  • Architect & standardize Workday integrations: Design, maintain, and iterate on Zip’s core Workday Financials and Procurement integration templates, ensuring they deliver scalable, repeatable, and robust customer implementations.

  • Bridge product & the field: Work closely with Engineering, Product, and Design (EPD) to ensure integration templates stay perfectly aligned with core product architecture, field insights, and emerging customer needs.

  • Turn nuance into scale: Analyze complex customer implementations to identify reusable data mapping patterns and system nuances, converting bespoke solutions into standardized internal assets.

  • Support pre-sales engineering: Partner with account teams during pre-sales to design and vet integration architectures, ensuring prospective customers are set up for smooth, best-practice deployments.

  • Drive technical implementation excellence: Define, document, and champion technical solution consulting best practices, raising the technical bar and driving consistency across all implementations.

  • Become a Multi-ERP expert: Leverage your existing Workday, P2P, and financial systems expertise to build deep fluency across additional ERP ecosystems, ultimately becoming the ultimate subject matter expert on integration architecture, data models, and Zip’s App Studio.

  • Build for permanent scale: Approach every technical challenge with an engineering mindset - designing and executing a solution thoroughly once so that future implementations happen effortlessly. You balance high-level architectural design with a willingness to dive directly into API configurations and template modifications to get the job done right.

Qualifications

  • 6+ years of hands-on experience delivering integrations with Workday Financials.

  • Strong foundational knowledge of core Workday Financials business processes, data models, and the Foundation Data Model (FDM) layout, specifically within Core Financials, Procurement, and Supplier Accounts.

  • Familiarity with standard Workday integration methods and tools, such as Workday Studio, EIBs, Core Connectors, Web Services (WWS), and RaaS (Reports-as-a-Service).

  • Familiarity with iPaaS tools is preferred, but we welcome candidates with strong core integration logic who can learn new platform tools quickly.

  • Experience working with XML / REST based endpoints and standard authentication protocols.

  • Past ERP implementation, integration, configuration or administration experience is required.

  • Ability to translate highly technical information for audiences with varying degrees of technical knowledge.

  • Comfortable working with API documentation.

  • Comfortable testing and troubleshooting integration errors.

  • Able to understand customer requirements and document that information quickly, with little oversight

  • A continual learner and open to learning new technologies that Zip may integrate with in the future.

  • Strong communication skills.

  • Extreme attention to detail and pride yourself in being incredibly proactive.

  • Experience working with product and engineering teams.

  • Process-driven with a strong bias toward continuous improvement; you consistently look for opportunities to make systems better than you found them through systematic improvement.

The salary range for this role is $126,000 - $170,000. The salary for this position is determined based on a variety of job-related factors that may include location, relevant experience, education, or particular skills and expertise.

Perks & Benefits

At Zip, we’re committed to providing our employees with everything they need to do their best work.

  • 📈 Start-up equity

  • 🦷 100% health, vision & dental coverage options

  • 🌴 Flexible PTO

  • 🏋️‍♀️ ClassPass membership

  • 🚠 Team building events & happy hours

  • 💻 Home office stipend

  • 🛜 Phone/internet reimbursement

  • 🍼 Paid parental leave

  • 🧑‍🧑‍🧒‍🧒 Fertility stipend

  • 💸 401k plan

We're looking to hire Zipsters and that means hiring people who take ownership, communicate openly, have an underdog mindset, and are excited to increase the pace of innovation for every business in the world. We encourage all candidates to apply even if your experience doesn't exactly match up to our job description. We are committed to building a diverse and inclusive workspace where everyone (regardless of age, religion, ethnicity, gender, sexual orientation, and more) feels like they belong. We look forward to hearing from you!

title: Clinical Research Associate
description:
Precision for Medicine is not your typical CRO. At Precision for Medicine we have brought together new technologies, expertise and operational scale to help the life sciences improve the speed, cost and success rate of bringing life-changing therapies to patients. What sets us apart is the way we integrate clinical trial execution with deep scientific knowledge, laboratory expertise and advanced data sciences. We have a strong focus on Oncology and Rare Disease.

Precision for Medicine is looking for Senior/Clinical Research Associate.

Position Summary:
The Senior/CRA has wide-ranging and broad experience and typically handles the most complex and advanced assignments. Responsibilities will be dependent upon the type and timing of the program to which the Senior CRA is assigned and will, at a minimum, include start-up and study implementation activities, on-site monitoring of clinical research studies as well as on-going site management.
Incumbents are expected to be able to manage appropriately sized or complex clinical trials, and support Clinical Trial Managers and/or Project Managers with trials as required. An increased focus on training and mentoring junior staff members may be expected.
Essential functions of the job include but are not limited to:
• Independently oversees all aspects of study site management to ensure patient safety is protected, quality of data generated by managed sites resulting in consistently low query levels and in acceptable Quality Assurance reports.
• Provides guidance at the site and project level towards audit readiness standards and supports preparation for audit and required follow-up actions.
• Establishes, updates, tracks and maintains study specific trial management tools/systems, and status reports.
• Manages site start up procedures including the feasibility and recruitment of potential investigators, preparation of EC/IRB submissions, collection and review of regulatory documents, review and adaptation in Patient Informed Consents, notifications to IRB, EC and regulatory authorities, as appropriate, translation of study related documentation, organization of meetings and other tasks as instructed by the Clinical Trial Manager/Project Manager.
• If required, assists the negotiation of study budgets and the execution of investigator contracts under directions of Site Contract Management department/designee.
• Verifies the process of obtaining informed consent has been adequately performed and documented for each subject/patient, as required/appropriate. Assesses factors that might affect subject/patient’s safety and clinical data integrity at an investigator/physician site such as protocol deviation/violations and pharmacovigilance issues.
• Independently conducts all forms of site visits, including pre-study/qualification, initiation, routine monitoring, and close-out visits, in accordance with the protocol, local laws, ICH-GCP and Precision SOPs. Performs Monitoring Oversight Visits to assess other CRA team members. Prepares and submits for review, accurate and timely monitoring reports from all site visits (on-site and remote).
• Documents activities via confirmation letters, follow-up letters, trip reports, communication logs, and other required project documents as per SOPs, Clinical Monitoring Plan/Site Management Plan and client requirements. Supports subject/patient recruitment, retention and awareness strategies. Enters data into tracking systems as required to track all observations, ongoing status and assigned action items to resolution.
• Routinely reviews the Investigator Site File (ISF) for accuracy, timeliness and completeness. Reconciles contents of the ISF with the Trial Master File (TMF). Ensures the investigator/physician site is aware of the requirement of archiving essential documents in accordance with local guidelines and regulations.
• Communicates effectively and proactively with both site personnel and Precision Project and Clinical Trial Management to relay protocol/study issues including any deviations and implements necessary actions in response to those issues.
• Develops and maintains good working relationship with investigators and study staff, serving as an ambassador to promote Precision high quality and professional image.
• Performs investigational product (IP) inventory, reconciliation and reviews storage and security. Verifies the IP has been dispensed and administered to subjects/patients according to the protocol. Verifies issues or risks associated with blinded or randomized information related to IP. • Applies knowledge of GCP/local regulations and organizational procedures to ensure IP is appropriately (re)labelled, imported and released/returned.
• Performs data review activities, including remote EDC CRF and patient profiles review, query resolution, and assists data management and clinical data quality personnel to resolve data discrepancies.
• Identifies and processes Serious Adverse Events according to the procedures defined by the study team. Also demonstrates a full understanding of the SAE reporting process.
• Identifies site risks and escalates those to Clinical Trial Manager/Project Manager with suggested contingencies. Owns the timely and appropriate resolution of the risk with oversight from project team.
• Prepares for and attends Investigator Meetings and/or sponsor face-to-face meetings. Participates in global clinical monitoring/project staff meetings (inclusive of Sponsor representation, as applicable) and attends clinical training sessions according to the project specific requirements. May prepare or assist in preparation of study-specific presentations/training materials and tools.
• Assists the team managers in the preparation and review of protocols and other study documentation.
• Supports the design and development of CRFs and clinical trial documents as they pertain to clinical monitoring activities (i.e. operating manuals, monitoring guidelines, etc.).
• Assists with review of clinical study reports.
• Functions as a mentor, assisting with the training and developing of new employees and junior monitors.
• Interacts with client, participates in proposal activities, including development and client presentations.
• Initiates payment requests for investigators.
• Travels as necessary according to project needs.
• Performs other duties as assigned by management.

Qualifications:

Minimum Required:

  • Bachelor's degree / international equivalent or equivalent combination of education and experience ideally in a business, scientific or healthcare discipline.
  • Minimum of 3.5 years of on-site monitoring experience; Oncology experience；
  • Global Clinical Trial experience

Other required:

  • High in proficiency in the Microsoft Office package of programs (Outlook, Word, Excel, and PowerPoint).
  • Customer service demeanour; demonstrate flexibility and teamwork.
  • Ability to focus on detail for extended periods of time, high attention to accuracy.
  • Fluency in English communication, verbally and in writing.
  • Working knowledge of the drug development process.
  • Travelling required (60-70%)

Preferred:

  • Solid experience in clinical research or related experience.
  • Excellent organizational skills.
  • Ability to work efficiently in a remote work environment.

Any data provided as a part of this application will be stored in accordance with our Privacy Policy. For CA applicants, please also refer to our CA Privacy Notice.

Precision Medicine Group is an Equal Opportunity Employer. Employment decisions are made without regard to race, color, age, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, disability, veteran status or other characteristics protected by law.

If you are an individual with a disability and require a reasonable accommodation to complete any part of the application process or are limited in the ability or unable to access or use this online application process and need an alternative method for applying, you may contact Precision Medicine Group at myHR@precisionmedicinegrp.com.

Recruitment Fraud Warning: Please be aware that fraudulent individuals and websites may impersonate Precision Medicine Group or its affiliates and attempt to obtain personal, financial, or banking information through fake job postings or employment offers. Precision Medicine Group will never request payment, banking details, or other sensitive financial information as part of the recruitment process. If you believe you have been targeted by a recruitment scam, we encourage you to report the incident to your local law enforcement authorities, consumer protection agency, or relevant cybercrime reporting organization in your country. Please also notify us at myHR@precisionmedicinegrp.com so we can investigate and take appropriate action.

Candidates must be legally authorized to work in the country of employment without employer sponsorship.

title: Quality Assurance Rater - Spanish speakers in Spain
description:
Join our elite team of Senior Raters as a critical contributor to high-quality validation data that directly influences product development and quality assurance for leading search engines and AI technologies.

This flexible, remote opportunity allows you to apply your analytical and research skills to evaluate search results and AI-generated content while contributing to the development of high-quality AI systems.

 

A Day in the Life of a Quality Assurance Rater

In this role, you'll conduct analytical assessments of search results and AI responses, providing ratings and feedback that help improve AI model performance and search quality.

Your work will maintain high quality standards and deliver the accuracy our clients depend on.

You'll evaluate a variety of rating tasks, analyze content with attention to detail, conduct research to support rating decisions, and identify guideline gaps or task inconsistencies.

You'll also participate in training and calibration sessions while contributing feedback to improve rating processes and guidelines.

 

Key Responsibilities

  • Evaluate search results and AI-generated content for quality, relevance, accuracy, and usefulness.
  • Conduct online research to verify information and support rating decisions.
  • Apply rating guidelines consistently while maintaining quality standards.
  • Document edge cases, guideline gaps, and task-related issues.
  • Provide clear written feedback and rationale for ratings when required.
  • Participate in training, calibration sessions, and ongoing quality reviews.
  • Meet productivity expectations while maintaining high-quality work.

 

TELUS Digital AI Community

Our global AI Community is a vibrant network of 1 million+ contributors from diverse backgrounds who help our customers collect, enhance, train, translate, and localize content to build better AI models. Become part of our growing community and make an impact supporting the machine learning models of some of the world’s largest brands. 

Qualification path

 

Candidates will complete project-specific training and qualification assessments before joining the program. Ongoing work will be subject to regular quality assurance reviews and performance monitoring.

 

Basic Requirements

  • Working as a freelancer with excellent communication skills in Spanish & English.
  • Resident in Spain for the last 5 consecutive years.
  • Familiarity with current and historical business, media, sports, news, social media, and cultural affairs.
  • Strong analytical thinking, attention to detail, and research skills.
  • Experience using web browsers, search engines, and online research tools.
  • Daily access to a reliable broadband internet connection, smartphone, and personal computer.
  • Demonstrated research capability through professional background OR strong track record of self-directed research and information verification
  • Ability to work independently and follow detailed guidelines consistently.
  • High level of creativity and logical skills with the ability to achieve consistent targets

 

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience in quality assurance, content moderation, data annotation, research, journalism, editing, or information verification.
  • Familiarity with AI technologies, search engines, and digital content ecosystems.
  • Subject matter expertise in areas such as Popular Culture, Social Sciences, STEM, Medicine, Law, Finance, or Engineering.
  • Additional language skills may be beneficial depending on project requirements.

 

Equal Opportunity

All qualified applicants will receive consideration for a contractual relationship without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, disability, or protected veteran status. At TELUS Digital AI, we are proud to offer equal opportunities and are committed to creating a diverse and inclusive community. All aspects of selection are based on applicants’ qualifications, merits, competence, and performance without regard to any characteristic related to diversity.

title: Revenue Operations Analyst
description:
About Augment

Logistics is broken. Let's fix it.

We are a team of engineers, product designers, and customer champions building Augie, Augment's AI teammate for supply chain. Augie reasons and acts like a seasoned operator, automating the busywork of quoting, dispatch, tracking, billing, and more for freight brokers, 3PLs, for-hire carriers, private fleets, and distributors.

Our team has scaled billion-dollar companies, built delightful products, and powered billions in commerce. If you thrive in fast-paced, high-impact environments and want to define how AI reshapes supply chain, apply today.

Overview

We're looking for a Revenue Operations Analyst to join our growing RevOps team. You'll own our deal desk, support territory planning, and run the reporting our sales leaders rely on every week as we grow from 12 AEs to more than 20. You'll also keep our data clean and handle the day-to-day work behind forecasting, quota administration, and commission calculations. This role reports to the Director of Revenue Operations.

Our GTM Motion

Our motion is outbound-led. SDRs prospect and qualify freight brokers, 3PLs, for-hire carriers, private fleets, and distributors before AEs run discovery and close. We sell across Mid-Market, Enterprise, and Strategic segments, with six-figure ARR deals and buying committees that span operations, IT, and finance. Your deal desk and reporting work needs to hold up to that complexity.

What You'll Do

  • Own the deal desk: review pricing, discounts, and non-standard terms, route approvals, and make sure every closed deal is booked correctly

  • Partner with Sales, Finance, and Legal so quotes and contracts move fast without surprises

  • Support territory planning: model coverage and capacity, manage account assignments, and keep regions and segments up to date as we roll them out, starting with Distribution

  • Own sales reporting: run the weekly forecast and pipeline reports leadership uses to call the quarter, and build dashboards for pipeline, conversion, bookings, and AE and SDR performance

  • Report contracted ARR and live, billing ARR side by side, and work with Finance so the numbers tie out

  • Keep HubSpot clean and reliable: own data quality, required fields, account ownership, and deal hygiene

  • Calculate commissions and support quota tracking, working with the Director and Finance

  • Help onboard new hires to our sales tools and processes, and document how things work

What We're Looking For

  • 2 to 4 years in Revenue Operations, Sales Operations, or Deal Desk at a B2B SaaS company

  • Hands-on experience running or supporting a deal desk, including pricing approvals and contract review

  • Experience supporting territory planning or account assignment

  • Hands-on CRM admin experience. We're on HubSpot, and experience there is a strong plus

  • Strong Excel or Google Sheets skills, and comfort with SQL or a BI tool

  • A detail person who cares when the numbers don't match and digs in until they do

  • Clear communication with sales leaders and reps, including pushing back when the data says otherwise

Bonus Points For

  • Experience in logistics, freight, trucking, distribution, or supply chain tech

  • Experience administering commission plans or quota models

  • Familiarity with Gong, LinkedIn Sales Navigator, Seamless.ai, Clay, or BI platforms

Why Join Us?

  • Competitive Salary + Stock Options

  • Comprehensive Health, Vision, and Dental Benefits

  • Flexible PTO

  • Monthly stipend

About Augment

At Augment, we set out to create a fully autonomous AI platform that streamlines operations and reclaims the human element in logistics. Our founders recognized a pattern: talented professionals were stuck handling manual data entry, phone calls, and repetitive tasks, instead of focusing on high-impact problem-solving and strategic decision-making.

That insight became our missionâto free logistics professionals from busywork so they can focus on what truly drives business growth. Augment isnât just about efficiency; itâs about transforming an entire industry by empowering teams with AI-driven solutions that make logistics smarter, faster, and more adaptive.

Join us on this journey!

Augment is an Equal Opportunity Employer and values diversity at our company. We consider all qualified applicants without regard to race, color, religion, national origin, gender, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, age, marital status, veteran status, disability, or any other legally protected status.

Augment complies with federal, state, and local laws regarding equal employment opportunity and reasonable accommodation. If you need assistance or an accommodation during the application or interview process, please contact your recruiter.

We also consider qualified applicants with arrest and conviction records in accordance with applicable federal, state and local fair-chance / ban-the-box laws (for example, but not limited to, the California Fair Chance Act).

Our hiring process uses AI-powered tools to assist with screening and evaluating applications based on job-related criteria. All AI-assisted outputs are reviewed by human recruiters who make all decisions about which candidates advance in the process.
