title: Webentwickler für interne Tools & Automatisierung (m/w/d)
description:
Du entwickelst unsere interne Software weiter, baust Benutzeroberflächen mit No-Code- und Low-Code-Tools und automatisierst Abläufe mit n8n und KI. Dafür bringst du praktische Programmiererfahrung mit. Ein bis zwei Jahre technische Praxis reichen für den Einstieg aus, wenn du bestehenden Code lesen, Änderungen selbst umsetzen und Fehler eingrenzen kannst.

Wir sind AdKochMarketing, eine Recruiting- und Employer-Branding-Agentur für das Gesundheits- und Sozialwesen. Von unserem Hamburger Büro aus betreuen wir Kunden in der DACH-Region und haben bereits über 250 Projekte umgesetzt. Deine Anwendungen und Automationen nutzt unser Team täglich im Recruiting, in der Kampagnensteuerung und im Reporting.

Deine Aufgaben

  • Interne Software weiterentwickeln. Du arbeitest dich in unsere bestehenden Anwendungen ein, setzt Änderungen im Code um und baust neue Frontends und Benutzeroberflächen mit No-Code- und Low-Code-Tools.

  • Geschäftsprozesse automatisieren. Du schaust dir an, welche Arbeitsschritte sich im Team wiederholen, und entwickelst dafür zuverlässige Workflows mit n8n, Make oder vergleichbaren Tools.

  • KI-Agenten und Prompts entwickeln. Du baust KI-gestützte Workflows, testest ihre Ergebnisse anhand konkreter Anwendungsfälle und verbesserst sie für den täglichen Einsatz.

  • Schnittstellen und Datenflüsse aufbauen. Du verbindest CRM, externe Datenquellen und weitere SaaS-Tools über APIs. Du entwickelst Workflows, die Daten erfassen, anreichern und ans CRM übergeben.

  • Datenbanken und Infrastruktur betreuen. Du pflegst Datenstrukturen in Supabase und Airtable und betreust unsere Anwendungen auf UpCloud.

  • Fehler beheben und technische Abläufe dokumentieren. Du findest heraus, warum ein Workflow oder eine Anwendung ausfällt, behebst die Ursache und hältst die wichtigsten Abläufe so fest, dass das Team sie nachvollziehen kann.

  • Technische Lösungen fürs Team umsetzen. Du klärst Anforderungen mit den Kollegen, führst bei Bedarf neue Tools ein und hilfst bei technischen Fragen zu unseren internen Systemen.

Das bringst du mit

  • 1-2 Jahre technisches Grundverständnis und praktische Programmiererfahrung. Du kannst dich in vorhandenen Code einarbeiten, Änderungen selbst umsetzen und Fehler systematisch eingrenzen. JavaScript oder TypeScript passen besonders gut zu unserem Stack. Andere Programmiersprachen wie Python sind ebenfalls eine gute Grundlage.

  • Abgeschlossene Ausbildung oder Studium in einem IT-Bereich, z.B. Informatik, Wirtschaftsinformatik, Fachinformatik, Elektrotechnik bzw. andere nachweisbare Erfahrung im Bereich IT / Automatisierung

  • Interesse an Frontends und Low-Code. Du möchtest interne Benutzeroberflächen entwickeln und arbeitest dich selbstständig in die dafür nötigen Tools ein.

  • Struktur- und Prozessdenken. Du verstehst, wie Abläufe zusammenhängen, arbeitest dich in bestehende Prozesse ein und entwickelst Lösungen, die sich im Alltag zuverlässig nutzen und pflegen lassen.

  • Sehr gutes Deutsch in Wort und Schrift auf mindestens C1-Niveau. Du kannst Anforderungen mit dem Team klären und technische Abläufe verständlich dokumentieren.

Von Vorteil ist Erfahrung mit n8n, Make oder Zapier, mit Next.js oder Low-Code-Frontends sowie mit APIs, Supabase, Airtable oder SQL. Auch Erfahrung mit KI-Tools wie ChatGPT, Claude oder Gemini und mit CRM-Anbindungen ist willkommen.

Das bieten wir dir

  • 💸 4.000–5.000 € brutto pro Monat bei Vollzeit, je nach Erfahrung.

  • 🏡 Vor Ort oder hybrid. Du kannst vollständig in unserem Hamburger Büro arbeiten oder hybrid mit 3 Tagen vor Ort und 2 Tagen im Homeoffice pro Woche. Unser Büro liegt in der Spaldingstraße 218 20097 Hamburg, 3. OG.

  • ⚙️ Eigene technische Projekte. Du begleitest interne Anwendungen und Automationen von der ersten Anforderung bis zum Einsatz. Bei der Umsetzung bringst du deine eigenen Ideen ein.

  • 🚀 Ergebnisse, die du im Alltag siehst. Das Team nutzt deine Lösungen im Recruiting, in der Kampagnensteuerung und im Reporting. Du bekommst direktes Feedback und siehst, welche Arbeitsschritte deine Lösungen vereinfachen.

  • 💻 Ein vielseitiger Tech-Stack. Du arbeitest mit n8n, Make, Supabase, Airtable und UpCloud. Dazu kommen API-Integrationen und KI-Tools wie GPT und Claude.

  • 🧠 Fachliche Entwicklung im Job. Du vertiefst deine Programmierkenntnisse, baust interne Oberflächen und sammelst praktische Erfahrung mit KI-Agenten, Datenbanken und Schnittstellen.

  • 📈 Perspektive auf mehr Verantwortung. Mit wachsender Erfahrung kannst du größere Projekte eigenständig übernehmen und mitentscheiden, wie sich unsere interne Software weiterentwickelt.

  • 🤝 Kurze Abstimmungswege im Team. Du arbeitest direkt mit den Kolleginnen und Kollegen aus Recruiting, Marketing und Kundenbetreuung zusammen und kannst Anforderungen und Feedback schnell klären.

Du hast schon einmal eine Anwendung gebaut, eine Schnittstelle angebunden oder einen Prozess automatisiert? Dann freuen wir uns auf deine Bewerbung. Erzähl uns gern kurz von einem Projekt und davon, was du dabei selbst umgesetzt hast.

title: GTM Engineer
description:
Our team shared’s mission is deploy AI agents to transform how patients and doctors connect

We believe healthcare shouldn’t be defined by missed calls, endless waiting lines, and overwhelmed staff. Patients and professionals deserve better.

Vocca builds AI voice agents that answer every call instantly, schedule and reschedule appointments, and free up staff to focus on what matters most: care.

Already trusted by 15 000+ providers, we’re transforming the patient–provider relationship, one call at a time.

Want to shape the future of healthcare?

Join us !

  • Discover our company culture and values

  • Here is a product teaser

  • Eliott's interview for Welcome to the jungle

  • Eliott's quick interview for Speedinvest

  • Articles on our A round (techfundingnews, Maddyness, les echos, our blog)

Context

We’re experiencing one of the strongest growth rates in the French Tech ecosystem, and we’re targeting €30M ARR by end of 2027. To get there, our SDR and AE team keeps growing and every rep has to go faster, not just work harder. Today, prospecting still relies on individual initiative: each rep builds and enriches lists their own way. That’s what this role fixes.

 

Your mission

Every SDR starts the day with the right accounts, the right contacts, the right trigger and the right message, without building a list by hand. Every inbound lead reaches the right SDR fast, with its context. You build and run the system that makes this true, in France first, then in the US.

You report to Robin, Head of RevOps. Your main internal clients are the SDRs and the Sales team, and you work hand in hand with Marketing on inbound.

This is an A-to-Z, hands-on role: you define the approach, build the workflows, run them and iterate.

 

Responsibilities

Data & Enrichment

  • Build and own the enrichment system: the right source for each field, fallbacks, deduplication, data quality metrics

  • Take over the data foundation currently being built with an external partner (CRM cleanup, market mapping, scoring) and turn it into pipeline

  • Define ICP scoring and qualification criteria with Sales leadership

  • Deliver lists SDRs can act on immediately

Signals & Outbound

  • Identify the events that make an account worth contacting now (new practitioners or sites, tools in place, hiring, closed-lost deals to reactivate…) and wire them into scoring and routing

  • Own the outbound stack: sequencing tool, deliverability (domains, warm-up, sending limits), multichannel sequences triggered by signals

  • Use AI to personalise at scale, with guardrails

  • Set clear handoff rules from reply to SDR

Inbound & Attribution

  • Build lead capture and routing with Marketing: qualification, spam filtering, pre-enrichment, routing to the right SDR

  • Track speed-to-lead and alert when leads wait

  • Keep source and campaign attribution clean from first touch to signed deal, so Marketing and Sales read the same funnel

SDR Enablement

  • Build the SDR cockpit in Attio and the SDR playbook

  • Help new SDRs ramp in weeks, not months

  • Give visibility on activity and conversion per rep

  • Sit with SDRs, listen to calls, and ship small apps and automations that remove clicks

What this is NOT

  • Not a campaign operator role: you build the engine, you don’t just press send

  • Not a data analyst role: dashboards serve decisions, not decoration

  • Not SDR management: Sales leadership manages and coaches the team, you build what they run on

Expected outcomes

30 days

  • Audit of enrichment, lists, sequences and the SDR day, with frictions ranked by cost

  • First enrichment wave shipped: every SDR has their own list

  • Inbound flow mapped with Marketing: sources, routing, where leads leak or wait

  • Roadmap agreed with Sales leadership and Marketing

3 months

  • Enrichment running inside Attio, scoring live

  • First signals wired into sequences, in France and the US

  • Sequencing tool live, deliverability monitored

  • SDR cockpit and playbook adopted by the team

  • Inbound routing automated, speed-to-lead tracked

  • Every workflow documented

6 months

  • Lists arrive pre-enriched with reliable emails and phone numbers

  • Signal-driven outbound is the default motion in France and the US

  • A new SDR is productive within weeks

  • Meetings and pipeline measurable per rep, channel and source, from first touch to signed deal

Why join now

You’re our first GTM Engineer: a blank page and a direct impact on revenue you can measure every week. We are [25] today and hiring [40] people in [2027]. The engine you build is what the whole sales team will run on, in France and in the US.

 

This role is for you if

  • You have 3–5 years in GTM Engineering, Growth Ops, Sales Ops or RevOps with a strong outbound component, in B2B SaaS or a startup

  • You’ve built outbound systems end to end yourself, deliverability included

  • You’ve set up inbound routing and conversion tracking with a Marketing team

  • You’re hands-on with a CRM (Attio, HubSpot or Salesforce), enrichment and sequencing tools, and n8n or equivalent. You’re comfortable with APIs, scripts and SQL, you use AI as a co-pilot, and you have no developer ego

  • You’re obsessed with data quality, not data quantity, and you take GDPR seriously

  • You’re comfortable working directly with founders and owning a system end to end

  • You’re fluent in French and English

Nice to have: experience in healthtech or vertical SaaS selling to practices and clinics, US outbound, a Clay / Cargo / warehouse-backed GTM stack.

 

Benefits

  • Equity (BSPCE)

  • Permanent contract (cadre, forfait-jours, ~8–12 RTT days per year) or freelance mission, depending on your preference

  • Hybrid rhythm from Paris: 3–4 days at the office, 1–2 days per week remote

  • MacBook provided

  • Meal vouchers: €9 per working day (55% covered by the company)

  • EGYM Wellpass (Gymlib)

  • Health insurance: 50% of Alan covered

  • Public transport: 50% of Navigo covered

  • Annual offsite and team events throughout the year

Hiring process

  1. Discovery call (30 min) with Xavier, Talent Partner

  2. Hiring Manager interview (45 min) with Robin, Head of RevOps

  3. Business case on site (prep in the office + presentation) with Robin and a Sales lead

  4. Final interview with Eliott, CEO, + coffee with the SDRs

  5. Reference check

  6. Offer

We aim to keep the process within 30 days. You’ll receive continuous feedback throughout.

Why should you join Vocca?

  • An entrepreneurial adventure, with a supportive, high-energy, execution-focused team

  • A product already live, with delighted customers in a fast-growing market (healthcare automation, voice AI)

  • A true scaling phase, with everything still to build

  • Real responsibilities from day one

We hire people, not roles.

If you're excited about our opportunities but don't check every box, we'd love to hear from you. Everyone, no matter how underrepresented, should feel free to apply as it can only bring learnings or success. If you identify yourself as a woman: Did you know that research shows women often apply only when meeting 100% of requirements?

We'll be thrilled to receive your application!

title: Forward Deployed Engineer - Zurich
description:
About the team

OpenAI’s Forward Deployed Engineering team partners with customers to turn research breakthroughs into production systems. We operate at the intersection of customer delivery and core platform development.

About the role

Forward Deployed Engineers (FDEs) lead complex end-to-end deployments of frontier models in production alongside our most strategic customers. You will own discovery, technical scoping, system design, build, and production rollout, partnering directly with customer engineering and domain teams.

You will measure success through production adoption, measurable workflow impact, and eval-driven feedback that changes product and model roadmaps. You’ll work closely with our Product, Research, Partnerships, GRC, Security, and GTM teams.

This role is based in Zurich. We use a hybrid work model of 3 days in the office per week. We offer relocation assistance. Travel up to 50% is required.

In this role you will

  • Own technical delivery across multiple deployments from first prototype to stable production

  • Build full-stack systems that deliver customer value and sharpen how we learn

  • Embed closely with customer teams, understand their needs, and guide adoption of what you build

  • Scope work, sequence delivery, and remove blockers early

  • Make trade-offs between scope, speed, and quality; adjust plans to protect delivery

  • Contribute directly in the code when progress or clarity depends on it

  • Codify working patterns into tools, playbooks, or building blocks that others can use

  • Share field feedback that helps Research and Product understand where the models succeed and where they can improve

  • Keep teams moving through clarity and follow-through

You might thrive in this role if you

  • Bring 5+ years of engineering or technical deployment experience that includes customer-facing work

  • Have scoped and delivered complex systems in fast-moving or ambiguous environments

  • Write and review production-grade code across frontend and backend using Python, JavaScript, or comparable stacks

  • Have built or deployed systems powered by LLMs or generative models and understand how model behaviour affects product experience

  • Simplify complexity and make fast, sound decisions under pressure

  • Communicate clearly with engineers, product teams, and customer stakeholders

  • Spot risks early and adjust without slowing down

  • Model calm and judgment when the stakes are high

About OpenAI

OpenAI is an AI research and deployment company dedicated to ensuring that general-purpose artificial intelligence benefits all of humanity. We push the boundaries of the capabilities of AI systems and seek to safely deploy them to the world through our products. AI is an extremely powerful tool that must be created with safety and human needs at its core, and to achieve our mission, we must encompass and value the many different perspectives, voices, and experiences that form the full spectrum of humanity. 

We are an equal opportunity employer, and we do not discriminate on the basis of race, religion, color, national origin, sex, sexual orientation, age, veteran status, disability, genetic information, or other applicable legally protected characteristic.

For additional information, please see OpenAI’s Affirmative Action and Equal Employment Opportunity Policy Statement.

Background checks for applicants will be administered in accordance with applicable law, and qualified applicants with arrest or conviction records will be considered for employment consistent with those laws, including the San Francisco Fair Chance Ordinance, the Los Angeles County Fair Chance Ordinance for Employers, and the California Fair Chance Act, for US-based candidates. In addition, job duties require access to secure and protected information technology systems and related data security obligations.

title: Technical Community Support - Spain
description:
A NOTE ON HOW TO REACH US

We're truly grateful that so many people have Foundant on their radar — it means a lot that our work resonates with others. That said, due to the high volume of direct messages and emails we receive, cold outreach isn't the preferred way to be considered for a role, and we're not able to prioritize applications submitted this way. To apply for open positions, please visit our careers page, which is the fastest and most effective route to being considered.

About Foundant

At Foundant, we build mission-critical software for the social good ecosystem — helping foundations, grantmakers, nonprofits, and community organizations streamline their work, strengthen relationships, and maximize their impact. We serve the giving community worldwide with a comprehensive suite of solutions spanning grant management, community foundation software, and giving analytics.

We're a unified company shaped by strong roots across our product portfolio, and we operate with intention and purpose. Our team of ~350 people across six countries is connected by a shared North Star: to be the trusted partner and strategic advisor to the communities we serve.

Role Summary

As a Technical Community Support with SmartSimple’s Essential Support team at Foundant, you'll be the voice of customer support and a critical link between our clients and internal teams. You’ll provide prompt, professional, and knowledgeable technical support to help mission-driven organizations succeed with our software. This role combines troubleshooting expertise with a passion for customer success, operating as a technical problem-solver and customer advocate who helps organizations achieve their missions more efficiently and effectively.

Where You’ll Work:

  • As a remote-first workplace, we believe in offering flexibility and the freedom to work where it suits you best, while staying connected through technology. Our global network of talent is supported by physical office hubs and virtual collaboration, fostering a dynamic environment where innovation and growth thrive.
  • With office locations in Bozeman, MT, Toronto, Canada, and Dublin, Ireland, you'll be part of a globally connected team. Whether you're working remotely or from one of our office locations, you'll be contributing to a vibrant, collaborative culture focused on driving meaningful impact across the world.

WhatYou’llDo:

  • Respond to and triage inbound support tickets, applying initial diagnosis and prioritization based on severity and SLA.
  • Troubleshoot common SmartSimple configuration, workflow, and reporting issues, resolving independently where possible.
  • Escalate complex or unresolved issues to Subject Matter Experts with clear documentation of steps already taken.
  • Maintain accurate, timely ticket notes and status updates in the ticketing system (powered by Zendesk) to support reporting on KPIs and knowledge continuity.
  • Maintain a high level of communication with all levels of client interaction to ensure proactive, solution-oriented problem identification and resolution.
  • Test fixes provided by the Engineering team and incorporate them into client systems.
  • Advocate new platform features and assist clients in adopting these through upgrades, configuration changes, or training. Provide instruction and documentation to ensure the technical success of these initiatives.  
  • Facilitate relationships across client success, internal teams, and departments to strengthen partnerships.
  • Contributor to continuous process improvement within and between all areas of Support.
  • Participate in team huddles, training sessions, knowledge-sharing activities and process improvement discussions.
  • Meet individual and team KPIs for ticket volume, response time, and customer satisfaction.
  • Some travel may be required (estimated less than 10%).
  • Other duties as assigned.

WhatYou’llNeed:

Required qualifications

  • Bachelor’s degree in Technology, Engineering, Sciences, Mathematics (STEM) field.
  • 1–2 years of experience in a customer-facing technical support, or SaaS support role.
  • Strong written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to explain technical concepts to non-technical users.
  • Comfortable learning new software platforms quickly; prior exposure to SaaS, CRM, or grants management tools is a plus.
  • Solid troubleshooting instincts - able to isolate a problem, test hypotheses, and document findings.
  • Strong organizational skills and attention to detail when managing a queue of concurrent tickets.
  • Demonstrable success in thinking strategically, executing tactically, while providing consistent and high levels of client satisfaction and retention in a fast-paced environment.  
  • Comfortable working in a metric-driven environment.
  • Must be legally eligble to work in Spain.

Required Technical Skills

  • Basic understanding of cloud and SaaS terminology.
  • Fundamental knowledge of databases and SQL - able to read basic queries, understand table relationships, and assist with simple data troubleshooting.
  • Field data storage concepts - understanding of data types, field mappings, and how data is stored and retrieved in database systems.
  • Basic HTML/CSS knowledge - able to read and understand HTML/CSS code, troubleshoot formatting issues.
  • JavaScript fundamentals - able to recognize JavaScript syntax, understand basic functions and logic, and troubleshoot workflow automations.
  • Workflow automation concepts - understanding of conditional logic, triggers, actions, and how automated workflows function in SaaS.
  • Integration protocols and SSO (Single Sign-On) - familiarity with how external systems connect via integrations, including SMTP, SFTP, API connections, and authentication methods.
  • Data analytics fundamentals - able to interpret reports, understand data visualizations, and assist with report troubleshooting and configuration.

Preferred qualifications

  • Familiarity with SaaS, SmartSimple or similar technology platforms.
  • Experience with a ticketing platform such as Zendesk.
  • Exposure to the nonprofit, philanthropic, or grants management sector.
Why You’ll Love Working at Foundant:
  • At the heart of everything we do is a commitment to innovation and making a positive impact. Whether you’re working on projects that empower not-for-profits, community foundations, or corporations, your contributions will help drive real-world change.
  • We offer competitive salary and benefits, including tuition, and lifestyle reimbursements, and bespoke mindfulness and fitness initiatives.
  • With our Flexible PTO policy, you’ll have the freedom to manage your time in a way that supports your personal well-being and professional success.
  • We’re committed to your professional and personal development. With our merger, you'll have the chance to collaborate across teams, giving you exposure to diverse ideas, expertise, and projects that span multiple industries.
  • As part of a larger organization, you’ll have even more opportunities to grow your career. Whether it’s exploring new roles, leadership opportunities, or shifting to a different department, we support internal mobility to help you achieve your career goals
  • You’ll enjoy autonomy and responsibility, empowering you to approach your work creatively and independently, fostering innovation and independent thought.
  • Employee recognition is a core part of our culture. When you do a great job, we make sure everyone knows about it!

Foundant is an equal opportunity employer, committed to building a diverse workforce that represents the communities we serve. We welcome and encourage applications from all qualified candidates, and will consider all applicants without regard to race, color, citizenship, religion, sex, marital/family status, sexual orientation, gender identity, Indigenous status, age, disability, or individuals who may require accommodation.

Foundant is also committed to providing accommodations throughout the interview and employment process. Accommodations are available upon request for candidates participating in all aspects of the selection process. If you have accessibility requirements during the recruitment process and require accommodation, please contact .

title: Product Engineer
description:
Referral bonus: If you know someone exceptional feel free to connect us via LinkedIn (Dennis Agidigbi), if we end up hiring them for a full-time role, you'll receive 10,000€.

🌍 About Zauber

After co-founding and scaling Forto to over $600M in funding, I took a step back to reflect on what’s still broken in global logistics. The answer was clear: it’s still a human-first, spreadsheet-heavy industry, full of repetitive processes and broken system interoperability.

With the rise of AI agents, we now have the tools to rethink that from the ground up. Zauber builds autonomous agents for the global logistics industry, AI workers that handle operational tasks, talk to systems and humans alike, and get better every day.

🚢 We're already live with global logistics leaders in Europe and Asia

💰 Backed by P9 - one of Europe's top early-stage funds

📈 Growing fast and hiring exceptional engineers to join early

Now we are looking for an exceptional Product Engineer to help us define and build the next generation of AI-powered logistics systems.

🧠 What You'll Do

You will help turn vision into product and bring our first AI agents into the hands of real users. This is a high-ownership role, working closely with the founding team and customers to build something truly new. You'll operate across the full stack—talking to customers one hour and debugging an agent loop the next—making the foundational technical decisions that define what the product becomes.

• Talk directly to customers and translate their needs into product direction and system architecture

• Build full-stack features that combine intuitive interfaces with intelligent backend logic, including LLM orchestration, agent workflows, and structured data pipelines

• Push the limits of what LLMs and agents can do in production, working through the hard problems of reliability, latency, and evaluation

• Scale from demo-quality code to robust, production-ready systems, making deliberate tradeoffs between speed and durability as the product matures

• Help shape the technical vision and product strategy of the company

👤 You Might Be a Fit If You...

• Have experience taking full ownership of technical projects, from architecture through to delivery and iteration

• Are pragmatic and fast in the early days, but know when to raise the bar for scale and quality

• Love writing and shipping code, and are not afraid to throw it away when the problem shifts

• Enjoy speaking with users and iterating quickly based on feedback, treating customer insight as a core input to engineering decisions

• Want to build something ambitious and impactful, from the very beginning

🛠 What You Bring

• Strong skills in Node.js, TypeScript, and React, with an instinct for patterns that move fast without creating debt—clean service boundaries, event-driven architectures, thin abstractions that are easy to replace

• Experience with distributed systems and serverless infrastructure that handle concurrency, failure, and scale

• Hands-on MongoDB experience, including schema design that balances query performance with flexibility

• Familiarity with observability tooling, ideally Datadog—tracing across async workflows, using metrics to debug production issues, not just monitor them

• Experience with modern AI tooling: LLMs, vector stores, embedding pipelines, prompt engineering

• Practical understanding of LLM-powered features in production—eval frameworks, structured output parsing, context window management, error recovery

• A track record of shipping products that create real value

• Curiosity for how industries work and a drive to improve them through software

• High-agency mindset and the ability to operate independently in a fast-changing environment

📍 Location & Logistics

• In-person Monday to Wednesday in our Berlin office (travel within Europe expected)

• Annual offsite (last year we took the team for 4 weeks to San Francisco)

• Start: As soon as possible

💼 What We Offer

• Top-of-market compensation and meaningful early equity

• Direct access to real users and fast feedback loops

• A highly experienced team with full trust and autonomy

• The opportunity to shape the foundations of a company and product from day one

• A mission that matters: building intelligent systems to power the future of global trade


💬 How We Hire

Our interviews focus on work you’ve owned, designing systems together, and building something close to the problems we solve at Zauber. Read How we hire Product Engineers for the stages, what we look for, and how to prepare.

🚀 Why Now

We’re not a demo company. We’re in production with real customers, in one of the world’s most critical and complex industries. Demand is not our bottleneck, execution is. This is your chance to join extremely early, shape the company, and build what will become the core infrastructure for global logistics automation.

We envision a world where every shipment is proactively managed by intelligent agents. Where operators have superhuman capabilities at their fingertips and trade never stalls.

🇪🇺 Building from Europe

What drives us personally is the belief that Europe’s long-term prosperity and sovereignty depend on a strong economic engine. We need more AI product-first European global champions on the world stage.

Our mission is to build one of the biggest automation companies in the world - from Europe. While our HQ will be in Europe, we will relentlessly benchmark ourselves with the best globally and sell internationally from the beginning.

title: Corporate Counsel, Commercial
description:
About Carrot:

Carrot is the leading global fertility and family care platform, built on intelligent care orchestration: the right clinical guidance, at the right moment, in the context of each memberâs life. More than a thousand multinational employers, health plans, and health systems trust Carrot to support millions of members across 195 countries â from pre-pregnancy through menopause and major life moments in between. Carrot's comprehensive clinical program delivers industry-leading cost savings for plan sponsors and award-winning experiences and improved outcomes for millions of people worldwide.

Carrot is widely regarded as a defining force in healthcare innovation as a recipient of several top-tier awards, including Fast Company's 'Most Innovative Companies' and CNBC's '100 Barrier Breaking Startups'. The company is regularly cited by leading global outlets â including The Economist, Bloomberg, The Wall Street Journal, NPR, ABC News, and Harvard Business Review â as a leading voice on digital health, the future of work, and family health. Learn more at get-carrot.com.

The Opportunity ð

As Corporate Counsel, Commercial, you will be the legal partner behind Carrotâs customer and vendor contracts. Day to day, you will negotiate, draft, and review a high volume of commercial agreements, including master services agreements, service level agreements, professional services agreements, and NDAs. You will partner closely with Sales and other business teams to resolve redlines and customer questions quickly, manage most matters from start to finish, and escalate high-risk issues when the moment calls for it.

This role is built for an attorney who pairs sharp legal judgment with practical business thinking. You will help move deals toward close while managing risk thoughtfully, supporting employers, health plans, and health systems around the world. You will join a collaborative Legal team and have support as you grow into greater independence and take on work with limited oversight.

Â 

What Youâll Own ð¼

In this role, you will:

  • Negotiate, draft, and interpret a wide range of commercial and vendor agreements, managing most contract matters from intake through signature.
  • Partner with Sales and other business teams to resolve redlines and customer questions efficiently and keep deal timelines on track.
  • Provide strategic legal advice to internal client groups, translating legal and regulatory risk into practical business recommendations.
  • Identify and explain operational and revenue-related risks, and escalate high-risk issues at the right time.
  • Manage a high volume of contracts at all times while protecting quality and turnaround speed.
  • Support privacy and data protection terms in commercial agreements, including HIPAA Business Associate Agreements and Data Protection Agreements.
  • Work across a complex, global matrix of collaborators to support Carrotâs growth.
  • Use contract lifecycle management and AI tools to improve the efficiency of legal research, drafting, and contract workflows.

Â 

What Success Looks Like Â ð

In your first 12â18 months, you will have:

  • Independently managed a high volume of commercial contracts from intake to signature with consistently timely turnarounds.
  • Become a trusted legal partner to Sales and other client groups, resolving redlines and customer questions efficiently.
  • Taken on increasingly complex and multi-party agreements with limited oversight.
  • Escalated high-risk issues proactively, with clear recommendations for the business.
  • Built working fluency in Carrotâs products, customer segments, and the global fertility and family-building landscape, and applied it to practical negotiating positions.
  • Improved contract workflows by making full use of Ironclad and AI-enabled tools.




About You â¨

You likely have:

  • A J.D. and membership in at least one U.S. state bar.
  • 3+ years of legal experience, in-house and/or at a law firm, ideally with in-house transactional experience at a health plan or startup.
  • A strong grasp of contracting concepts and solid experience drafting, negotiating, and interpreting commercial and vendor agreements such as MSAs, SLAs, professional services agreements, and NDAs.
  • Experience counseling a sales organization.
  • The ability to analyze and advise on legal and regulatory risk, with creative solutions that support growth.
  • Flexibility, a willingness to work on a broad variety of legal matters, and comfort with ambiguity.
  • A record of strategic thinking and of working across a complex matrix of global collaborators, pairing strong legal analysis with practical business recommendations.

Â 

Nice to Have â­

While not required, we would be especially excited if you bring:

  • Experience drafting and negotiating commercial contracts with global companies.
  • Experience with complex multi-party commercial agreements and vendor agreement review.
  • Hands-on experience with contract lifecycle management software, especially Ironclad.
  • Experience using AI tools.
  • Knowledge of privacy laws including HIPAA, CCPA, and GDPR in the context of BAAs and DPAs.
  • Interest in fertility and reproductive health policy, and how it differs by country and culture.
  • Knowledge of the employee benefits, healthcare, and/or pharmaceutical industries.

Â 

Why This Role Matters ð§¡

Carrotâs contracts are how our mission reaches people. Every agreement with an employer, health plan, or health system shapes how well members around the world can access fertility and family-building care. In this role, you help Carrot say yes to growth in ways that protect the company, our customers, and the members we serve.

Because you will own most matters from beginning to end, your judgment directly affects deal velocity, customer trust, and revenue. You will be a visible, trusted partner to Sales and the broader business while helping a rapidly growing global company scale its commercial legal function.



Interview Process ð¤

We believe in a thoughtful and transparent interview process designed to create alignment for both candidates and our team.

For this role, candidates can expect:

  1. Recruiter Screen â 30 minutes
  2. Hiring Manager Interview â 30â45 minutes
  3. Cross-Functional Panel Interviews â 45 minutes
  4. Executive Leadership Conversation â 30 minutes

Throughout the process, we will share additional context about the team, business priorities, customer landscape, and what success looks like in this role.

Â 

Why Candidates Join Carrot ð

Carrot offers the opportunity to do meaningful work in service of a deeply human mission.

Highlights include:

  • A mission-driven company focused on expanding access to fertility and family-forming care globally.
  • A high-growth environment where leaders are empowered to shape strategy and drive impact.
  • Competitive compensation, equity, and comprehensive benefits.
  • Flexible Time Off and a culture that actively encourages employees to recharge.
  • Comprehensive parental leave and family-forming benefits.
  • A collaborative, inclusive, and values-driven culture.
  • The opportunity to work alongside passionate, thoughtful teammates committed to improving healthcare outcomes worldwide.

Â 

Â 

Compensationð°

Carrot offers a holistic Total Rewards package designed to support you in all aspects of life, inside and outside of work. Our benefits include comprehensive health and wellness coverage, retirement savings plans, parental leave, family-forming assistance, and a competitive compensation package. This role is:

Base + equity roles:
Compensation for this role is structured as base salary plus equity, giving you ownership in Carrot's long-term growth. This role does not include an annual bonus or variable compensation.

  • Base Salary Range:Â  $140,000-$160,000
  • Geo-Tier Adjustment: ForÂ highly experienced candidates within 50 miles of San Francisco, NYC, or Seattle.

Actual compensation may vary from the posted base salary depending on your confirmed job-related skills and experience.



Fraud and Security Notice: Please note that all communication regarding job opportunities at Carrot will come exclusively from an @get-carrot.com email address. If you receive messages from any other domain, please disregard them and report the incident to: securityreporting@get-carrot.com

Â 

A Note on AI

At Carrot, we believe AI can help us work smarter, move faster, and create more meaningful experiences for our members, customers, and each other. While not every role requires deep technical AI expertise, we value people who are curious, eager to learn, and excited to thoughtfully incorporate AI into their day-to-day work.

For some roles, AI fluency is a core requirementâand we'll call that out clearly in the qualifications. For everyone else, we're looking for people who embrace new ways of working, use AI responsibly to improve quality and efficiency, and continue to learn as the technology evolves.

Why Carrot?

Carrot has received national and international recognition for its pioneering work, including Fast Company's Most Innovative Companies and World Changing Ideas, Inc. Power Partners, and Modern Healthcareâs Innovators. Carrotâs global workforce has been acknowledged with several accolades, including Fortuneâs Best Workplaces in Healthcare, Great Place to Work, and Age-Friendly Employer certifications. Carrot is regularly featured in media reporting on issues related to the future of work, women in leadership, and healthcare innovation, including MSNBC, The Economist, Bloomberg, The Wall Street Journal, CNBC, National Public Radio, Harvard Business Review, and more. Learn more at carrotfertility.com.Â

title: Private Practice Enablement Specialist (PST)
description:
Our Mission

Healthie is an AI-Native, ONC Certified EHR for modern outpatient healthcare.Â 

Healthie is proud to power clinically excellent healthcare for over 40,000 providers who deliver clinically excellent healthcare - longitudinal and collaboratively, with patient and provider experiences at the center. Both healthcare and technology are undergoing unparalleled industry innovation, and itâs incredible to see the momentum - from consumers, from providers, and from reimbursement for this type of healthcare - grow exponentially.Â 

We provide the powerful infrastructure every care delivery organization needs. On the surface this includes EHR, Scheduling, Engagement, Billing, Data, and much more. Underneath the iceberg are thousands of configurations, settings, widgets, automations, and limitless capabilities because we are an API-first platform. Our fully brandable platform makes it easy for clinics and organizations of any size to scale and never reach a limit.Â 

Today, over 3 billion API calls are made to Healthie every month, as thousands of organizations who work with more than 21 million patients in total, rely on Healthie to deliver clinically excellent healthcare in over 35 specialties, from behavioral healthcare to complex chronic care management and personalized medicine.

We believe in the power of technology to improve access to healthcare and weâre building the rails that make this a reality. We work fast and with quality because we provide business-critical, healthcare-critical software that clinicians and patients need for a better healthcare system. Weâre customer-obsessed, operate with lightning-fast processes and responses, and always share our product roadmap publicly-Â  so customers can see what weâre building, and remain relentlessly focused on how care gets delivered.

Healthie is backed by leading investors, and while we've $42M raised to date, more importantly, we operate with fiscal responsibility and have been profitable for more than half of our time as a company. We know that building an ONC-Certified EHR is a lifetimeâs body of work, and we are here to build for our customers forever.

Learn more at https://www.gethealthie.com/

About the role

Weâre hiring a Customer Success Manager to join our Private Practice Enablement team and help customers get the most out of Healthie throughout their entire journey with us. Youâll work with private practices and growing healthcare organizationsâsome brand new to Healthie, others who have been with us for years.

This is a highly customer-facing role centered around understanding how practices operate and helping them use Healthie to accomplish their goals. Youâll build relationships with healthcare executives, practice managers, providers, and clinical champions, becoming a trusted resource as their workflows, teams, and needs evolve.

Our ideal hire is curious, resourceful, and a natural educator. You enjoy learning how different healthcare organizations work, can turn complex questions into clear next steps, and are excited to develop the product expertise needed to help customers use Healthie successfully.

About the work

  • Youâll spend much of your day connecting directly with customers through live 1:1 calls and email, helping with everything from initial setup and training to workflow optimization, feature adoption, and new needs that emerge as their practices grow.
  • Youâll learn how customers deliver care, understand their operational and patient care goals, and use deep product knowledge to recommend workflows that make Healthie work for their organization.
  • Youâll solve problems in real time. Sometimes thereâs a straightforward answer; other times youâll need to investigate, think creatively, test different approaches, or bring in the right people to find a solution.
  • Youâll create personalized resources, screen recordings, and examples when showing a customer how to accomplish something is more helpful than simply telling them.
  • Youâll manage multiple customer conversations and priorities at once, adapting your communication and approach to different practices, personalities, and challenges.
  • Youâll collaborate with Support, Product, Engineering, Sales, and Marketing, sharing what youâre learning from customers and helping improve our product, resources, processes, and overall customer experience.


Details, details

  • This is a full-time, remote position and U.S. work authorization is required.
  • This job is Monday-Friday, 9am-5pm PST.Â 
  • Weâre seeking fluent English speakers/writers.
  • The salary range is $93,000 - $102,500

About you

Youâve done this kind of work before. Weâre looking for someone with 3â5 years of experience in Customer Success or similar customer-facing role. And it is a requirement that you've worked at a software company. Bonus points if youâve worked in healthcare technology, or have experience working with private practices or growing healthcare organizations.

  • Youâre comfortable independently leading customer conversations and building relationships with everyone from individual providers to practice managers and healthcare leaders. You ask thoughtful questions, listen closely, and know how to adapt your approach to the person in front of you.
  • Youâre a natural educator and an excellent communicator. You can take complicated products, workflows, and questions and turn them into clear, practical next steps. We value good writers.
  • Youâre curious about how customers work. You want to understand what someone is actually trying to accomplish before recommending a solution, and you enjoy learning the different ways healthcare organizations operate and deliver care.
  • Youâre a strong problem-solver with good judgment. When there isnât an obvious answer, youâre comfortable researching, testing different approaches, and using the resources around you to figure out the best path forward.
  • Youâre organized and self-directed. You can manage customer calls, emails, follow-ups, and projects simultaneously, take ownership of whatâs in front of you, and recognize when something needs another perspective or team.
  • Youâre good at navigating challenging conversations. You can set expectations, explain limitations, and provide thoughtful guidance even when the answer isnât exactly what a customer hoped to hear.
  • You have plenty of tech skills, and you're confident working across a variety of tools and apps, and can troubleshoot everyday issues on your ownâthings like browser quirks, connectivity problems, login hiccups, and mobile device settings.
  • Youâre a collaborative teammate and strong customer advocate. You share what youâre learning, give helpful and direct feedback, and bring patterns from customer conversations back to the broader team so we can continue improving how we support our customers and build Healthie.

How to applyÂ 

Please submit a PDF cover letter and introduce yourself. Include:

  • Tell us who you are and why you want this job at Healthie.
  • Where are you based and what time zone are you in?
  • Why do you want to work in Customer Success?

In your cover letter, answer these real-world customer scenarios. Reply to the customer directly like you would if you worked on our Private Practice team. Also tell us how youâd approach the conversation, and explain your thinking for each reply.Â 

  • A customer recently signed up for Healthie and is excited to get started. They want to go live as soon as possible and have an upcoming appointment with a client. They need help manually adding the client to Healthie and sending them an invitation to access the platform.

  • A customer who has been using Healthie for several years reaches out because their practice has grown and their current workflow is no longer working well for their team. They have a specific idea for how theyâd like to solve the problem, but you arenât sure whether Healthie can support exactly what theyâre asking for.Â 

Interview Process

  • Interview with Talita, Private Practice Team Lead (30 minutes)
  • Interview with Justin, VP of Customer Support (30 minutes)
  • Live demo with Talita and Jen (30 minutes)
    • Youâll be asked to give us a brief product demo. Youâll share your screen and show us how to add a client and schedule an appointment.Â 
  • Final session with Talita and Justin (30 minutes)
  • Reference checks

title: Sales Development Representative (Graduate/Junior) - 4 Day Week + Remote
description:
No sales experience? Good. That's not what we're hiring for.

Most people you'll call didn't ask to hear from you. They're running construction sites, chasing programmes and fighting fires, and they'll give you about ten seconds to prove you're worth two minutes. Earn those two minutes, find a real problem, and you'll be opening doors at some of the UK's biggest construction firms. 

You don't need a sales CV for this. You need to be curious, resilient and genuinely coachable. We'll teach you the rest, with a proper 90-day plan, a coach alongside you every week, and a playbook built from the calls that are actually winning. 

It won't always be easy, but you'll learn faster than almost anywhere else. If you'd rather be genuinely good at sales in two years than comfortable in two months, keep reading.

(this will be a long write up but we like to give you all the details before you spend your time applying) 

_________________________________________________________________________________________

We are Shape.Construction! 

We are digitising the largest and most fundamental industry in the world, the industry that literally builds the foundations of the civilisation we all depend on to spare us from a brutal hunter-gatherer life: CONSTRUCTION 

It is one of the least digitised industries in the world but also the largest – 1 in 9 people globally work in the construction industry and it constitutes 11% of global GDP. 

Improving construction strengthens the very foundation of human civilisation. (Watch our short film about it). 

We got our start as a high-end construction project management consultancy. As a consultancy, we are focused on genuinely upgrading the way construction projects are delivered. We then take the deep understanding of the projects we work on to develop construction management software products that anyone can use to deliver their projects better. 

We are building a full suite of products one module at a time – kind of like office 365 but for construction management - Check out Shape, our construction management tech 

The core of all this is our true secret sauce; people. We only recruit the very best both in capability and personality. We are deeply focused on designing a new type of organisation that is optimised for the flourishing of the people in the team first and foremost. People that join us develop fast as a whole person in ways they never imagined. 

This approach has allowed us to grow from just 2 people in 2017 to over 220 today (including consultancy) and we are still very much at the beginning! Joining us isn't just some "job", it is a transformative educational experience. We challenge you to be your best self in all aspects of life. 

4 core values for a good life 

We believe a life of human flourishing is all about meaningful relationships with others and challenging yourself to create a positive impact. So our values reflect the 4 levels of relationships that each of us has: 

  • Grow yourself – Your relationship with yourself
  • Care about people – Your relationship with others around you
  • Execute to greatness – Your relationship with your team
  • Build civilisation – Your relationship with humanity and the world 

This goes much deeper but for the sake of brevity, we will keep the summary version!

We enshrined our values in our vision

We exist so that everyone in our team can thrive in a high-impact community that: 

  • Connects us with meaningful relationships
  • Inspires us to develop ourselves to become better humans
  • Empowers us to pursue our own learning adventures 

We believe that, by first doing this, we can achieve the highest levels of value for the world. 

And enable the achievement of our vision through our dual missions: 

  1. To fully digitise the construction of human civilisation
  2. To create a new type of organisation that enables human flourishing while delivering a huge positive impact on society

_________________________________________________________________________________________

The Role 

Purpose of the role 

You're where every Shape deal starts: finding the right people at construction firms and booking qualified meetings that turn into free launches and contracts. It's a role for someone who wants to learn sales properly, from the ground up, in a team that cares about doing it well.

 

What the job actually is

Most of your day, every day, is on the phone. You'll be calling commercial, project and operations leaders at tier 1 and tier 2 construction firms (main contractors and the subcontractors who work for them). They're running live projects, their time is precious and they're wary of anyone selling software. You'll hear "no", "not now" and "just send me an email" a lot. Almost all of our pipeline is outbound, apart from customer referrals, so the meetings you book are ones you've created yourself. 

Quality over quantity, always. We care about the work we do and take pride in doing it properly, and we're looking for people who feel the same. On the phone, that starts with a real conversation, not a script. It means being curious enough to ask the second and third question, listening more than you talk, and caring more about understanding someone's world than getting a calendar invite out of them. By the end of the call, you should know what's actually going wrong for them, on which project, and why it matters now. Then you only offer a solution to people who genuinely want or need to fix it. If they don't, that's fine: you thank them and move on. Get that right and the meeting follows naturally, and it's one worth having. 

 

How the team is set up

You'll sit in the UK sales team, working day to day with an Account Executive who takes your meetings forward to a free launch and then a contract. You open the door, they win the deal, and you succeed together. You'll work with a CRM, a dialler and call recording, plus a playbook, a library of calls that have actually won, and AI call-prep tools built for how we sell. 

 

Where you'll work 

Remote, anywhere in the UK, with the chance to attend industry events in person in the near future. 

 

Why it's worth it 

  • A career in a market that's only just going digital: around $10 trillion is spent on construction every year, yet it's one of the least digitised industries in the world, and spending on construction management software is forecast to nearly double by 2030. People who can sell software and genuinely understand construction are rare. Learn both here, and you'll have skills that stay in demand for years as the industry catches up, and you'll be helping it work better along the way.
  • Senior conversations from the start: you'll be speaking directly to leaders at some of the UK's biggest construction firms, not working your way through gatekeepers.
  • Coaching that knows the industry: weekly reviews and coaching from people who've lived and breathed construction, on site, not just on the phones.
  • A playbook that works: built from calls that have won, so you're not starting from scratch.
  • Progression on merit: a proper conversation about your next step within a year, based on what you've shown.
  • You'll shape how we sell: what you learn and suggest makes it into the playbook.
  • A 4-day week: the same standards and targets, delivered in four days. 

 

Your top responsibilities 

  • Open doors: start proper conversations, every day, with the people who feel the problem and can decide.
  • Qualify properly: test the problem early, dig in before you pitch, and keep qualifying after the "yes".
  • Hand over cleanly: your CRM notes tell the story, so your Account Executive picks up exactly where you left off.
  • Be obsessed with your numbers: know them every day, track them weekly and act on what they tell you.

 

Your roadmap: your first year 

Your first 90 days combine structured onboarding with a reduced target, so you learn properly before you're measured at full pace. 

  • Before day 1, ready to go: every tool set up and working, so week 1 is spent learning, not setting up.
  • Month 1, learn the why: how construction projects run and where they lose money, what Shape does about it, and the language of the industry. Listen to every call in our library, write your first-call pitch, role-play daily, and make your first supervised calls when you're ready.
  • Month 2, practise live: on the phones every day, with call reviews alongside you. We judge you on the quality of your conversations, not volume, as you book your first meetings.
  • Month 3, build consistency: building up to a full day of calling and booking regularly. Across your first three months, you work to half the full target.
  • From month 4, full target: the same target every SDR carries.
  • Months 4–6, make it consistent: the rest of your probation is about hitting that target month after month, with your own scorecard and weekly 1:1s.
  • Around 12 months, what's next: a progression conversation about Senior SDR or Account Executive, based on what you've shown, not how long you've been here. 

 

Why three months is realistic: it's fast compared with most sales teams, and that's deliberate. You won't be learning just from trial and error. You'll have a structured onboarding, a playbook built from calls that have won, daily call reviews early on, weekly 1:1s and your own scorecard. Our best have been fully up to speed in a month. You will make mistakes, and that's fine. You won't be thrown in at the deep end. 

 

How you'll be measured 

Good numbers come from good conversations. You'll have your own monthly scorecard, built around three questions: are you reaching the right people, are those calls turning into real conversations, and are those conversations turning into meetings worth having?

Your main target is qualified meetings attended: meetings that actually take place, where your Account Executive agrees there's a genuine opportunity. You'll know your numbers from day one, and we'll go through them with you every week.

No grey areas: you and your Account Executive are partners. What makes a meeting qualified is written down and shared, so you'll both know where the bar is. If you ever see one differently, you talk it through with the call recording in front of you. Decisions come down to facts, never opinion or politics.

What our best are doing: booking around 20% more meetings than target, turning conversations into meetings at nearly double the minimum rate, and keeping more people on the phone than our standard asks for, with almost every meeting qualified (92%) because they do the basics properly. That's the bar, and we'll help you get there. 

 

A start-up at a pivotal point

If you've ever wanted to join a start-up right as it takes off, this is that moment. We're past the early days: our sales process is working, customers are launching with us and we know what good looks like. Now we're growing, and the people who join now will shape what comes next. 

You get the start-up stuff, the exciting and the real: things move fast, you'll build as you go, your ideas get heard (and actually used), and you'll see the impact of your work every week. We hold ourselves to a high standard, back each other up and enjoy it along the way. 

We're looking for people in it for the long term, and that works both ways. We'll invest in you with weekly coaching, structured training and progression on merit. In return, we want people who want to build something with us over years, not a stepping stone.

 

Your Capabilities 

Why experience isn't everything 

Sales skills can be taught. Attitude is much harder to teach, and bad habits are harder to unlearn than good ones are to learn. We'd rather hire someone hungry who gets better on every call than someone with three years of bad habits. So whether you're just finishing your studies or already have a year or two in sales or a customer-facing role, this is the role for you. If you have 2+ years of outbound B2B behind you, take a look at our Senior SDR role instead.

What we look for instead 

  • A forever learner: you never feel you know enough. You're always looking for the next thing to learn, and you go after it.
  • A sponge, with no ego: you soak everything up, take feedback and actually change what you do on the next call, and never think you're above the basics.
  • Resilient and disciplined: you can hear "no" twenty times before lunch and still mean it on call twenty-one. You've stuck at something hard and kept showing up when it got tough, whether that's competitive sport, music, a part-time job alongside your studies, volunteering or a society you helped run.
  • Curious, and a genuine listener: you ask the second question and listen to understand, not to wait for your turn. Construction people can spot a fake a mile off, and so can we.
  • Quick on your feet: calls rarely go word perfect. You think creatively, react to what's actually been said, and speak plainly and confidently. You don't need to be loud, just credible.
  • A strategist who takes action: you think about who to call, when and why, then get on with it without waiting to be told. You listen to calls and practise before anyone asks you to.
  • You've done your homework: you understand, at a high level, the problems people in construction face, and you can clearly say why construction and why this job. "My dad's an electrician" is a start, not an answer. 

Nice to have (if you don't have it now, you will after joining) 

  • Any sales or customer-facing experience, such as retail, hospitality or recruitment, especially where you had targets to hit.
  • A competitive streak, mostly with yourself.
  • Experience in a start-up or fast-growing business.
  • Experience using a CRM, a dialler or other sales tools.
  • Any construction site experience, through work, a placement or an apprenticeship. 
 
Shape isn't the place for you if any of the following is true: 
  • You'd rather set the strategy and have someone else build the campaigns
  • You'd rather report on activity than be measured on booked demos
  • You want an easy role without much challenge
  • You like to be the smartest person in the room
  • You don't like continuously receiving honest candid feedback
  • You prefer to do your own thing rather than work with a team

_________________________________________________________________________________________

Benefits

The Standard Stuff

  • Health Insurance Scheme. Comprehensive private health coverage - for you and your family. Because your well-being is our priority
  • Bonus Scheme. As a permanent member of the team, you’ll share in our success. Our annual bonus is designed to reward both the now and the future - with a flexible mix of cash and high-growth equity that you choose. Bonuses are discretionary and based on performance
  • Professional body membership. One fee covered per year - so you can stay connected to your field and develop your craft

 

The Life-Changing Stuff

  • In-house coaching: Regular 1:1 coaching sessions, fully confidential, to help you navigate challenges, build self-awareness, and grow intentionally - professionally and as a human being
  • Flexibility: Getting things done is what really matters, not what time of day you do it. That means you don’t have to ask permission for things like picking up your kids or going to the doctor, just keep your team in the loop if you think they will be affected. 
  • Grow your whole self: Our leaders are more like coaches and one of our main objectives is to give 5 years’ worth of learning and development for every 1 year with us. You have a coach, mentor, well-being therapist and a development-orientated environment: That’s literally what our vision is all about and the primary reason Laminar exists. 
  • Be surrounded by the best: We only hire and retain the very best people. You might be used to being the smartest in the room but that won’t be the case in Laminar. You will be surrounded by people you can learn from. We are 100% meritocratic so fast progression is the norm. You will be supported to excel in whichever areas you are most interested in! With Laminar, development is unbounded
  • Long-term impact: We are focused on solving the biggest issues in construction project delivery in a way that can spread and outlast us

_________________________________________________________________________________________

Important! Applying properly

Apply with your CV and a cover letter answering these three questions. We care much more about your answers than your CV. 
  1. Why construction, and why this job?
  2. What do you think are the biggest problems facing the people we'd have you calling?
  3. What's something you've stuck at, even when it got hard, and what did it teach you? 

A note on AI: yes, we use it every day, and you're welcome to use it to research or sharpen your thinking. But right now this is about getting to know you, so make sure your answers sound like you. There are no wrong answers. We'd rather hear what you really think, even if it's not completely accurate. 

What happens next 

Every application is read by the people you'd work with. We move quickly, and you'll hear back at every stage. After an initial screen, there are three stages: 

  • Meet and greet: we get to know each other and make sure we're aligned on expectations, both yours and ours.
  • Mock call with feedback: a role-play cold call. We'll give you feedback and see how you use it. We'll prepare you for this, and nobody expects it to be perfect.
  • Meet the team, then a decision: meet the people you'd be working with every day. Then we'll give you a clear answer either way, with feedback.

title: Robotics Systems Engineer (Mechanical)
description:
ANYbotics is a fast-growing tech company dedicated to shaping the future of mobile robotics across multiple industries. Join our highly talented and motivated team of more than 200 people and work on cutting-edge robot technology.

The Opportunity
 

We are looking for an experienced Robotics Systems Engineer (Mechanical) to join our team of product developers and robot enthusiasts. We build competitive products for our customers, and they depend on tightly integrated, complex mechatronic systems. In this role, you bridge mechanical design and system-level engineering. You own how mechanical subsystems fit into the overall robot architecture, from requirements and interfaces through integration, verification, and field support.

You will work closely with specialists from R&D, electronics, and software development to define, evaluate, integrate, and validate the robotic system across the full product development process. You will also work continuously with our operations team so that system decisions meet product target costs, manufacturability, and quality standards as ONE TEAM. Your work makes our robots more nimble, robust, and user-friendly, and opens new ways to optimize system performance and capabilities. We are passionate about excellent hardware design and system performance at competitive costs.

 
The Impact
 

As a Robotics Systems Engineer (Mechanical), you will play a crucial role in shaping the architecture and design of our future robotic systems. You will turn customer and product needs into system and mechanical requirements, define and manage subsystem interfaces, and drive trade-off decisions on performance, robustness, weight, cost, and serviceability. Your contributions will directly increase the reliability and attractiveness of our products.

With your innovative mindset and industrial experience, you will bring new ideas and methods to how we develop, integrate, and verify our robots. Your hands-on experience with mechatronic systems makes you key to improving and upgrading the robot’s functions. Working alongside our R&D experts, you will strengthen our ability to sustain and continuously improve our product portfolio in the field.

 
 
Market & Our Technology
 
ANYbotics transforms industrial plants in the energy, process, and utility sectors by bringing robotics to a wide range of new applications that were previously out of reach. Our customers are large asset operators and industrial service providers pioneering the use of robotics for inspection and maintenance. Our mobile robot ANYmal uses legs for extreme mobility in complex environments, camera- and LiDAR-based sensing for full autonomy and obstacle avoidance, and AI for high-quality, consistent inspection results. We develop a wide range of custom hardware in-house, including the complete robotic platform, actuators, sensors, inspection payloads, charging systems, and all related mechanical hardware, and integrate it into one reliable system.

Your Contributions
  • Define system and mechanical requirements from customer needs and use cases
  • Shape the system architecture and design integrated mechatronic subsystems
  • Define and manage interfaces between platform, actuators, sensors, payloads, and charging systems
  • Drive trade-offs on performance, robustness, weight, cost, and serviceability
  • Plan and run system integration, verification, and validation
  • Do engineering analyses, including FEA and tolerance stack-ups
  • Monitor robustness, cost, and quality across the product life cycle, including root cause analyses and field inspections
  • Work with R&D, software, and operations on specifications and design reviews
  • Create system and product documentation, from specifications to assembly and user manuals

    • Your Profile
  • University degree in mechanical engineering, mechatronics, or a related field
  • At least 5 years of industrial experience in systems engineering or mechanical product development
  • Proven experience with requirements engineering, interface management, and system integration of mechatronic products
  • Hands-on experience with verification, validation, and testing
  • Proficient in SolidWorks and PDM environments
  • Experience with FEA, tolerance analysis, and DIN/ISO tolerancing standards
  • Knowledge of design-to-cost and productivity optimization methods
  • Excellent written and spoken English
  • Structured team player who enjoys working across disciplines in a high-tech company

    • Bonus Points
  • Experience with MBSE or requirements management tools is a plus
  • Experience sizing standard components such as motors, gearboxes, and bearings
  • Experience with explosion-proof design and certification under ATEX and IECEx
  • Knowledge of the design and manufacturing of injection-molded parts
  • Experience with electric drives and control theory
  • Programming skills (e.g. Python) for analysis, testing, or automation
    • We offer you a very exciting and dynamic work environment, the opportunity to become part of a fast-growing company and an ambitious team that is on a mission to change the industrial inspection market, a chance to leverage your experience and bring in your own ideas, a fair market salary, an attractive employee stock ownership plan, and a job in the city of Zurich.

Any profiles or resumes submitted to ANYbotics employees without a prior written agreement will be considered public disclosure and the property of ANYbotics, involving no liability or fee for subsequent hiring.

title: Heavy-Duty Mechanical Engineer
description:
About Us

Harmattan AI is a next-generation defense prime building autonomous and scalable defense systems. Following the close of a $200M Series B, valuing the company at $1.4 billion, we are expanding our teams and capabilities to deliver mission-critical systems to allied forces.

Our work is guided by clear values: building technologies with real-world impact, pursuing excellence in everything we do, setting ambitious goals, and taking on the hardest technical challenges. We operate in a demanding environment where rigor, ownership, and execution are expected.

About the Role

As a Heavy-Duty Mechanical Engineer on Harmattan AI's Launcher team in Lausanne, you will take a clean-sheet, fully autonomous launch system from a blank sheet of paper all the way to the factory floor and live field deployment.

Our Launcher team builds the ruggedised, autonomous deployment infrastructure that takes our larger platforms from storage to flight at a moment's notice. Operating in a fast-paced startup environment within a tight-knit, cross-functional squad (alongside a Team Lead, another Mechanical Engineer, a Hardware Engineer, and a Software Engineer), you will act as an end-to-end technical owner. Your work spans defining system specifications, sizing heavy structures and high-acceleration systems, managing budgets and suppliers, and getting hands-on in the workshop and field to stress-test hardware to failure.

Responsibilities

  • End-to-End Clean-Sheet Design: Architect, design, and prototype ruggedized, unmanned launch systems from scratch, taking hardware from initial concept through field test rigs to deployable systems.

  • Kinematics Power Sizing: Size and integrate high-acceleration hydraulic, pneumatic, or spring-loaded actuation systems, high-speed release mechanisms, and custom dampening systems capable of handling extreme dynamic loads.

  • Autonomous Launch Operations: Design reliable mechanical systems capable of operating independently in harsh, remotely supervised environments—handling self-deployment, automated launch sequences, and system resets.

  • Structural Engineering & Validation: Perform hand calculations and FEA to size heavy-duty structural weldments and moving assemblies, accounting for weld fatigue, shock, and sudden violent loads.

  • Testing & Prototyping: Build custom test benches and field rigs to validate designs, running physical stress tests to failure and iterating rapidly on hardware.

  • Cross-Functional Collaboration: Partner closely with Flight Dynamics to define launch requirements, and work alongside Hardware and Embedded Software engineers to synchronize mechanical actuation with automated launch code.

  • Supplier & Project Ownership: Manage project budgets, timelines, and technical documentation (2D/3D CAD, BOMs, test reports) while partnering with suppliers on heavy-precision machining and series production.

Candidate Requirements

  • Heavy-Duty Mechanical & Structural Design: Proven track record designing large-scale, heavily loaded machinery, structural weldments, and rugged mechanisms from scratch (ideally in aerospace, defense, heavy equipment, or robotics).

  • Kinematics Expertise: Deep hands-on experience sizing and designing moving assemblies, high-speed release mechanisms, and pneumatic or hydraulic circuits (cylinders, accumulators, valves) under high-acceleration forces.

  • CAD & Structural Analysis: High proficiency in 3D CAD (SolidWorks preferred) and structural validation using both hand calculations and FEA for dynamic and fatigue load cases.

  • Manufacturing & Sourcing: Strong command of Design for Manufacturing (DFM) across heavy-precision machining, welding, and industrial fabrication, with experience sourcing custom components and managing external suppliers.

  • True "Builder" & Startup Mindset: Thrives with high autonomy and end-to-end ownership—equally comfortable defining technical specs, managing budgets, turning wrenches in the workshop, and running live field tests.

  • Communication & Mission Alignment: Clear written and verbal communication to document complex engineering decisions, paired with full commitment to Harmattan AI’s mission, pace, and growth.

We look forward to hearing how you can help shape the future of autonomous defense systems at Harmattan AI.
