title: Heavy- Duty Automation Engineer
description:
About Us

Harmattan AI is a next-generation defense prime building autonomous and scalable defense systems. Following the close of a $200M Series B, valuing the company at $1.4 billion, we are expanding our teams and capabilities to deliver mission-critical systems to allied forces.

Our work is guided by clear values: building technologies with real-world impact, pursuing excellence in everything we do, setting ambitious goals, and taking on the hardest technical challenges. We operate in a demanding environment where rigor, ownership, and execution are expected.

About the Role

As a Heavy-Duty Automation Engineer on Harmattan AI's Launcher team in Lausanne, you will take a clean-sheet, fully autonomous launch system from a blank sheet of paper to live flight tests by simulation, prototype testing and field testing.

Our Launcher team builds the ruggedized, unmanned deployment infrastructure that takes our larger autonomous platforms from storage to flight at a moment's notice. Operating in a fast-paced startup environment within a tight-knit, cross-functional squad, you will own the entire control, automation, and safety architecture end-to-end.

Your work spans defining system specifications, selecting controllers, sensors, and high-speed valves, managing external suppliers, and getting hands-on programming PLCs, wiring prototypes, and tuning closed-loop characteristics and motion controls in the workshop and field.

Responsibilities

  • End-to-End Control & Safety Architecture: Architect, specify, and own the complete control-system work package from initial concept through commissioning and live flight tests by simulation, prototype testing and field testing.

  • PLC & Safety Programming: Develop robust industrial PLC and safety PLC control logic to govern fully autonomous, remotely supervised operations—including self-deployment, automated launch sequences, and autonomous aircraft reloading.

  • High-Acceleration & Precision Control: Select, integrate, and tune motion control systems (controllers, sensors, proportional/high-speed valves) capable of managing both high-precision positioning and extreme launch acceleration.

  • Machine Safety & Risk Assessment: Define safety standards, perform risk assessments, and implement hardware/software interlocks and performance levels for high-energy, unmanned outdoor equipment.

  • Hands-On Commissioning & Field Testing: Wire, calibrate, and commission control hardware on prototype test rigs and deployable systems, troubleshooting and iterating rapidly during live field trials.

  • Cross-Functional Collaboration: Partner closely with Mechanical, Flight Dynamics, and Operations teams to synchronize mechanical actuation, flight requirements, and autonomous launch sequences.

  • Supplier & Documentation Ownership: Manage external component suppliers and integrators, maintain up-to-date electrical/control schematics, specifications, and commissioning documentation, and drive system reliability.

Candidate Requirements

  • Heavy-Duty Automation & Control Design: Proven experience designing, programming, and commissioning complex, heavy-duty automated machinery from scratch.

  • PLC & Safety Systems Expertise: Deep hands-on experience programming industrial PLCs and safety PLCs (e.g., Siemens, Beckhoff, or equivalent), including machine safety standards, risk assessments, and safety interlock design.

  • Electrical Cabinets & DAQ Architecture: Demonstrated proficiency in layout, wiring, and assembly of industrial control enclosures, alongside real-time data acquisition and test systems (e.g., National Instruments PXI platforms).

  • Hydraulic & Motion Control: Strong practical command of closed-loop characteristics and motion control, high-precision positioning (e.g., automated handling/reloading), and high-acceleration actuation.

  • Hardware Integration & Commissioning: Comfortable getting hands-on with electrical wiring, sensor calibration, valve selection, and field troubleshooting on ruggedized outdoor prototypes.

  • Supplier & Work Package Management: Experience owning automation work packages, sourcing specialized or custom fit-for-purpose control hardware, and managing external vendors.

  • True "Builder" & Startup Mindset: Thrives with high autonomy and end-to-end ownership in a fast-paced environment—equally comfortable architecting control loops, wiring test benches, and supporting live field deployments.

  • Communication & Languages: Fluency in English required (French is a plus), with clear technical documentation skills and full commitment to Harmattan AI’s mission, vision, and growth

We look forward to hearing how you can help shape the future of autonomous defense systems at Harmattan AI.

description:
This position is listed on behalf of a partner company, which manages all applications and next steps. Our partner is looking for an Account Executive based in Netherlands.

As an Account Executive – EMEA, you will drive new business development and strategic account growth across Europe, the Middle East, and Africa, helping shape the future of AI-powered engineering and semiconductor design. You will introduce innovative physics simulation technology to leading semiconductor and electronics organizations, demonstrating its value in optimizing hardware development and manufacturing workflows. Combining new customer acquisition with strategic account expansion, you will build relationships with technical experts, business leaders, and C-level executives. You will lead complex enterprise sales cycles, develop regional partnerships, and create demand in an emerging technology market. Working closely with engineering, pre-sales, and product teams, you will ensure successful customer evaluations and long-term adoption. This is an exciting opportunity for an ambitious sales professional to influence an evolving industry while taking ownership of a strategic international territory.


Accountabilities

  • Strategic Account Management: Build and maintain strong relationships within key enterprise accounts across EMEA, identifying business units and opportunities where advanced physics simulation technology can deliver measurable business value.

  • New Business Development: Identify, prospect, and develop new strategic customers, generating demand and establishing relationships with technical, commercial, and executive stakeholders.

  • Account Expansion: Drive both new customer acquisition and growth within existing accounts, developing land-and-expand strategies across complex engineering organizations.

  • Partner Ecosystem Development: Build and manage relationships with resellers, service providers, distributors, and strategic channel partners to increase regional market reach, generate customer introductions, and accelerate adoption.

  • Full Sales Cycle Ownership: Manage the entire enterprise sales process, from prospecting and discovery to value proposition development, technical evaluations, contract negotiations, and closing high-value deals.

  • Cross-Functional Collaboration: Work closely with pre-sales, forward-deployment, and engineering teams to coordinate customer test cases and pilot deployments, ensuring alignment with business objectives and technical requirements.

  • Pipeline Management and Forecasting: Maintain a strong and accurate sales pipeline, targeting at least four times quota coverage while providing clear forecasts and visibility into opportunity progression.

  • Market and Competitive Intelligence: Gather customer insights, partner feedback, regional market trends, and competitive intelligence to inform product development and commercial strategy.

  • Strategic Customer Engagement: Navigate complex organizational structures and engage effectively with technical individual contributors, domain experts, senior executives, and decision-makers.

  • Regional Market Development: Represent the business across EMEA, regularly traveling to strategic customer locations and partner organizations to develop relationships and advance commercial opportunities.

    • Requirements:

  • At least 7 years of experience in enterprise software sales, ideally as a major account manager or enterprise account executive within the semiconductor or electronics industry.

  • Proven track record of consistently meeting or exceeding annual sales quotas of $2 million or more and closing complex, high-value deals ranging from six to seven figures.

  • Strong understanding of the semiconductor ecosystem, including Electronic Design Automation (EDA) tools, fabless and Integrated Device Manufacturer (IDM) business models, and advanced packaging technologies such as 2.5D and 3D IC.

  • Established network of senior decision-makers and industry contacts within major semiconductor, electronics, or engineering organizations across EMEA.

  • Excellent executive presence and communication skills, with the ability to articulate complex technical and commercial value propositions to VP-level and C-suite stakeholders.

  • Strong technical aptitude and the ability to discuss physics simulation concepts and their applications in design, validation, and manufacturing workflows without relying on sales engineers for every customer interaction.

  • Demonstrated experience selling through and managing partner ecosystems, including resellers, distributors, service providers, or other channel relationships.

  • Strong strategic account planning, prospecting, negotiation, and closing skills.

  • Ability to operate autonomously, build relationships from the ground up, and create demand in markets where product categories and purchasing budgets may not yet be established.

  • Experience with consultative, challenger, and value-based selling methodologies, ideally supported by MEDDIC, MEDDPICC, or Force Management frameworks.

  • Excellent stakeholder management and cross-functional collaboration skills, combined with a proactive, entrepreneurial, and results-driven mindset.

  • Willingness and ability to travel regularly throughout Europe, the Middle East, and Africa.

    • Preferred Qualifications:

  • Academic or professional background in Mechanical Engineering, Electrical Engineering, or a related technical discipline.

  • Previous Account Executive or enterprise sales experience at a leading EDA or engineering software company, such as Cadence, Synopsys, or Ansys.

  • Experience working for a high-growth AI or deep-tech startup focused on engineering applications.

  • Existing relationships with senior executives and decision-makers at major semiconductor companies across EMEA.

  • Proven success implementing land-and-expand strategies within large, complex, and highly specialized engineering organizations.

  • Experience establishing and scaling strategic channel and partner ecosystems.

  • Strong evangelistic selling skills, with the ability to educate customers, challenge established practices, and introduce innovative technology solutions.

    • Benefits:

title: Dutch speaking Support Specialist
description:
Hi there! Thanks for stopping by 👋

Are you actively looking for a new opportunity? Or just checking the market? Well… you might just be in the right place!

As part of Lightspeed’s Support team, you will be the first point of contact for our customers who need assistance, helping with a wide variety of requests all the way from general education to hardware/software investigation and everything in between.

Working closely with various global teams at Lightspeed, you will investigate, troubleshoot, test and resolve issues that our hospitality customers may be facing during service.

 

What you’ll be doing:

  • Working with a truly global, multi-language 24x7 team across APAC, EMEA and NOAM

  • Flexibility on working days and shifts (weekends included)

  • Have enthusiastic, positive and knowledgeable interactions with our Hospitality customers, partners and Lightspeed team members, maintaining Lightspeed's Gold Class standard for support via phone, chat and email.

  • Use consistent troubleshooting techniques to quickly and efficiently identify the source of customer issues and provide a prompt and appropriate solution

  • Work within our customer support platforms to document, track and resolve interactions

  • Assist with the identification, reproduction and escalation of product issues and bugs to the Quality Assurance team, tracking through to resolution with each customer, partner and Lightspeed team member

  • Advocate and promote improvements to our products and services

  • Operating within a roster/schedule to ensure high availability of our assistance for our customers (In collaboration with your manager)

 

What you’ll be bringing to the team:

  • Previous customer service experience and/or technical support Strong attention to detail with an emphasis on providing an exceptional customer experience

  • Excellent verbal and written communication skills in Dutch & English

  • Basic experience using common online, mobile and desktop platforms; iOS, Android, OSX, Windows

Even better if you have, but not necessary:

  • Experience interacting with customers through Phone, Email, Ticketing and Live Chat platforms

  • Experience or knowledge of the Hospitality industry

  • Experience supporting a SaaS product

  • Experience supporting an iOS application

  • Computer networking experience or interest

 

Even better if you have, but not necessary

  • Passion in technology;

  • Working knowledge of Mac OS and basic knowledge of HTML/CSS;

  • Hospitality experience;

  • French written and verbal communication skills;

We know that people are more than what’s on their CV. If you’re unsure that you have the right profile for the role... hit the ‘Apply’ button and give it a try!


Please make sure to apply with a CV in English.


What’s in it for you:

  • PTO scheme

  • 400€ annually towards Health and Wellbeing

  • Dental cover

  • Private healthcare

  • Optical cover

  • Opportunity to join a growing team, in a fast-paced, high-growth company

  • Work with a team of incredibly talented and forward-thinking people!

  • Work for a team that values hard work, and knows how to celebrate the wins

  • Amazing benefits & perks, including equity for all Lightspeeders

In short, an opportunity to learn, expand your skill set, forge wonderful relationships and make your mark within the diverse and inclusive Lightspeed family, a true Canadian tech success story.

To all recruitment agencies: Lightspeed does not accept unsolicited agency resumes. If we have not directly engaged your company in writing to supply candidates for a specific vacancy, Lightspeed will not be responsible for any fees related to unsolicited resumes.

Lightspeed is a proud equal opportunity employer and we are committed to creating an inclusive and barrier-free workplace. Lightspeed welcomes and encourages applications from people with disabilities. Accommodations are available on request for candidates taking part in all aspects of the selection process.

Where to from here?

Obviously, this has to be mutually beneficial: we want you to step into a role you love, and we want to offer you a place you’re proud to come to every day. For a glimpse into our world check out our career page here.

Lightspeed is building communities through commerce, and we need people from all backgrounds and lived experiences to do that. We were founded in 2005, in Montreal’s gay village and our original members were all part of the LGBTQ+ community. The ethos of our business has been about inclusion from the very beginning, and we strive to provide a workplace where everyone belongs.

Who we are:

Powering the businesses that are the backbone of the global economy, Lightspeed's one-stop commerce platform helps merchants innovate to simplify, scale, and provide exceptional customer experiences. Our cloud commerce solution transforms and unifies online and physical operations, multichannel sales, expansion to new locations, global payments, financial solutions, and connection to supplier networks.

Founded in Montréal, Canada in 2005, Lightspeed is dual-listed on the New York Stock Exchange (NYSE: LSPD) and Toronto Stock Exchange (TSX: LSPD). With teams across North America, Europe, and Asia Pacific, the company serves retail, hospitality, and golf businesses in over 100 countries.

Lightspeed handles your information in accordance with our Applicant Privacy Statement.

title: Numbering Analyst
description:
Join Vonage and help us innovate cloud communications for businesses worldwide!

Vonage Communications APIs:

As an emerging leader in the $10B+ communications API market, we empower global brands to connect better with their customers, employees and partners through transformative communications experiences.

Vonage API solutions empower organisations to build their custom omnichannel communications structure, allowing them to reach and engage customers on their preferred schedule and channel, including voice, video and messaging. Think of a rideshare service instantly connecting with customers, hospital staff conducting remote monitoring, customers verifying their identity before completing a purchase, AI virtual agents servicing customers around the clock and much more.

Why this role matters:

Vonage works with carrier partners and holds licences to operate as a carrier or service provider in several countries, enabling us to deliver a growing portfolio of Carrier Services to customers around the world.

As a Numbers Analyst, you will help deliver and manage numbers, short codes and associated services across Vonage Number Inventory, API, Contact Center and other businesses. You will take ownership of assigned operational work, partnering with carriers and internal teams to ensure orders are implemented accurately, inventory is available, and service issues are investigated and resolved. Your work supports reliable customer service and the continued growth of Vonage Carrier Services.

Your key responsibilities:

  • Own assigned number and short code provisioning requests from intake through implementation, maintaining accurate records and keeping relevant stakeholders informed.
  • Monitor number inventory and coordinate restocking to support business and customer demand.
  • Test newly provisioned numbers and services, investigate faults, and coordinate troubleshooting through to resolution.
  • Process and implement customer orders submitted through Sales or directly by customers, checking request details and resolving gaps with the relevant teams.
  • Support customer issue resolution, taking responsibility for follow-up and escalating complex or time-sensitive issues appropriately.
  • Contribute to CPaaS CSP onboarding, testing and service design activities, coordinating operational readiness with internal teams and carrier partners.
  • Work across Support, Legal, Operations, Sales and other teams to maintain clear communication and continuity of service.
  • Build effective day-to-day working relationships with carrier partners and contribute to the resolution of operational matters.
  • Provide information and supporting records for audits and regulatory inquiries, working with compliance colleagues as required.
  • Identify recurring operational issues and opportunities for automation and contribute to improvements that streamline workflows and strengthen service quality.

What you'll bring

Required:

  • Experience in a telecoms, carrier services, contact centre or related operational environment.
  • Working knowledge of telephony or messaging services, with the ability to investigate provisioning and service issues methodically.
  • A reliable, organised approach and the ability to manage assigned work independently, prioritise competing requests and follow through to completion.
  • Clear communication skills and the confidence to coordinate effectively with customers, carrier partners and colleagues across different functions.
  • Good attention to detail when processing orders, updating service information and preparing operational records.
  • A practical, continuous-improvement mindset and willingness to contribute to better processes and automation.

Experience we consider a plus:

  • Experience with Zendesk, Atlassian Jira or Confluence.
  • Experience with Salesforce and Microsoft Office.
  • Exposure to SQL or data tools such as Kibana, Snowflake or MySQL.
  • Experience supporting carrier onboarding, number provisioning, short codes or CPaaS services.

How You Will Benefit

  • Medical Insurance
  • Life Insurance

  • Meal Card (Pluxee Tienda Card)

  • Volunteer Time (VTO)

  • Ericsson Care Line

  • Additional benefits and perks will be shared and discussed with you by the recruiter during the interview process #LI-ML1

There’s no perfect candidate. You don't need all the preferred qualifications to make a valuable impact on our team. Our employees and customers come from diverse backgrounds, so if you're passionate about what you could achieve at Vonage, we'd love to hear from you.

To learn how we process your personal data during the recruitment process, please refer to our Privacy Notice.

Who we are:

Vonage is a global cloud communications leader. And your talent will further help brands - such as Airbnb, Viber, WhatsApp, and Snapchat - accelerate their digital transformation through our fully programmable-based unified communications, contact center solutions, and communications APIs. Ready to innovate? Then join us today.

Note: The purpose of this profile is to provide a general summary of essential responsibilities for the position and is not meant as an exhaustive list. Assignments may differ for individuals within the same role based on business conditions, departmental need or geographic location.

title: Warehouse Executive (Netherlands) - Entry Level/No Experience Required
description:
Important Information

This role is a full time, 100% in office, entry-level position. No experience is required.

Working hours: M-F, 10AM - 6:30PM

Location: Oude Meer, North Holland, 1438 BC

Contract: 6 month FTC

About Nivoda

Nivoda is the leading global B2B jewellery marketplace, Nivoda’s growth trajectory has skyrocketed over the past 12 months, and we continue to expand across new regions at an unprecedented pace. Our DNA centers on understanding our customers' needs and offering them a seamless experience. With a growing team based in major cities worldwide, including London, New York, Hong Kong, and Mumbai, Nivoda is becoming the go-to marketplace for the global jewelry industry.

We aim to be bold, innovative, and relentless in our pursuit of excellence as we transform an industry steeped in tradition.

The Role

You'll be a key player in a tight-knit team. Working alongside highly experienced logistics professionals at one of our largest international hubs, you'll handle and repack incoming and outgoing diamond shipments with precision and care.

This is a hands-on, detail-oriented role that sits at the heart of our operations. You’ll be responsible for maintaining the smooth day-to-day flow of the office while upholding our high standards of accuracy and security. With our rapidly growing company, the opportunities for personal and professional growth are enormous.

title: Revenue Operations Analyst (Europe)
description:
Company Overview

Deepgram is bringing the world’s most natural interface, voice, to the technology we use every day. Our speech models and real-time infrastructure power AI systems that keep up with the way people actually speak. More than 5,000 organizations run conversational voice AI on Deepgram in production, including Twilio, Cloudflare, Sierra, Decagon, Vapi, Cresta, Granola, and Jack in the Box.

The Deepgram Voice Agent Platform brings together speech-to-text, text-to-speech and speech-to-speech, with voice-native foundation models available through cloud APIs or self-hosted and on-premises deployments. Built for accuracy, low latency and cost efficiency, Deepgram makes high-quality voice experiences practical to build and run at scale. More than 650,000 developers have used Deepgram to process more than 200,000 years of audio. Every day, more of the world’s conversations with AI run on our models.

Operating Principles

Deepgram is a research company that productizes as fast as possible. Four Operating Principles shape how we think, decide, and work together:

  1. Compress before you communicate. You think it through first, then lead with the bottom line.

  2. Resist entropy. You question what already exists before adding more process or tools.

  3. Solve the category. You fix recurring problems at the source, not one case at a time.

  4. Work at the frontier. You go after problems no one has solved yet.

We look for people who already work this way, and these principles shape how we grow and evaluate our team.

AI-First by Default

We build AI that millions of people talk to, and we run the company the same way. AI is how we centralize work here, and is core to how we operate.

That means more than using the tools. We expect you to:

  • Build, not just use. Design your own workflows and agents, and use AI to remove whole categories of work instead of doing the same work faster.

  • Own the output. AI can speed up the work. It doesn’t make anyone less accountable for it. You understand, verify, and stand behind everything you share, including what an agent produces for you.

  • Spend the time you get back at the frontier. The capacity AI creates goes toward problems no one has solved yet.

  • Keep pace. Models and tools change every month, and so will your work. You adopt what’s new quickly and drop what no longer earns its place.

We judge AI by what it helps you deliver and whether you stand behind the result, not by how often you use it. In interviews, expect to walk us through a workflow you built and where you drew the line between AI and your own judgment.

Note: this role is based remotely out of Europe.

Regional Expectations

  • Based in Europe with strong overlap to customer business hours in the region.

  • Excellent written and spoken English. Additional European languages are a plus.

The Opportunity

Deepgram is hiring a Revenue Operations Analyst to help build and operate the systems, data, and workflows that power our GTM organization.

This is a hands-on role for someone who likes getting into the details: fixing broken workflows, improving data quality, supporting quote-to-cash and usage-based billing processes, and finding ways to automate repetitive work. You’ll work closely with GTM Engineering, Finance, Sales, Customer Success, and Renewals to make our commercial systems more reliable, scalable, and efficient.

What You’ll Do

  • Support and improve quote-to-cash workflows, including CPQ, order forms, contract changes, subscriptions, entitlements, and downstream system updates.

  • Partner with Finance and GTM Engineering on usage, billing, and monetization workflows, including reconciliation across CRM, product, billing, and finance systems.

  • Serve as a hands-on Salesforce and GTM systems operator, building reports, dashboards, flows, automations, and system enhancements.

  • Maintain strong data quality and governance across accounts, opportunities, contracts, usage, renewals, and customer records.

  • Troubleshoot and resolve GTM systems and process issues, identifying root causes rather than relying on manual workarounds.

  • Identify repetitive or high-friction workflows and help build automation and AI-enabled solutions to reduce manual effort.

  • Support the systems and reporting used to operationalize forecasting, routing, territory, quota, and commission decisions.

  • Partner with the Director, GTM Engineering on system requirements, testing, implementation, documentation, and ongoing optimization.

  • Help create scalable operating processes as Deepgram grows, while staying close to the day-to-day work that surfaces where systems need to improve.

It’s Important to Us That You Have

  • 3–4+ years of experience in Revenue Operations, GTM Systems, Sales Operations, Business Systems, or a related role.

  • Strong hands-on Salesforce experience, including reporting, flows, automation, and data management.

  • Experience working across CRM, CPQ, billing, contract, or other GTM systems.

  • Strong analytical and problem-solving skills with high attention to detail.

  • A track record of improving workflows, not just executing existing processes.

  • Comfort using AI and automation tools to reduce manual work and improve operations.

  • Ability to work cross-functionally across GTM, Finance, and technical teams.

It Would Be Great If You Had

  • Experience in a usage-based or consumption-based business.

  • Experience with CPQ and contract-generation tools.

  • Familiarity with billing or metering systems.

  • SQL or experience working with GTM/customer data.

  • Experience with tools such as Claude, Cursor, n8n, Workato, Retool, or similar automation environments.

  • Experience in a high-growth SaaS or AI company.

Notice: We're aware of individuals impersonating Deepgram recruiters. All legitimate Deepgram recruiting communication comes from an @deepgram.com email address. If you've received a message claiming to be Deepgram, please forward it to careers@deepgram.com.

title: Enterprise Account Executive | New Logo | Italy
description:
At Jamf, we believe in an open, flexible culture based on respect and trust. Our track record and thriving work environment all stem from the freedom we grant ourselves to get the job done right. We take pride in helping tens of thousands of customers around the globe succeed with Apple.

The secret to our success lies in our connectivity, while operating with a high degree of flexibility. Work-life balance remains our priority while feeling connected is important to maintain our strong culture, achieve our goals, and thrive as #OneJamf.

What you’ll do at Jamf:

The Enterprise New Logo Account Executive is a results-driven hunter responsible for identifying, pursuing, and closing new enterprise logos for Jamf. Focused exclusively on net-new acquisition within the enterprise segment (organizations with 1,000+ employees), this role requires strong prospecting discipline, the ability to manage complex multi-stakeholder sales cycles, and the consultative acumen to position Jamf's Apple Enterprise Management solutions at the executive level. Success in this role is defined by consistent pipeline generation, new logo attainment, and laying the foundation for long-term customer partnerships.

This role is offered in Italy only, preferably for candidates located in Milan and used to travel in the territory #LI-Remote

What you can expect to do this role:

New Logo Prospecting & Pipeline Development

  • Build and manage a targeted outbound prospecting motion to identify and engage net-new enterprise accounts within an assigned segment or territory (Italy, Greece, Cyprus, Malta)
  • Develop segment fluency — understanding buyer personas, common objections, industry-specific compliance needs, and Apple ecosystem maturity within target accounts.
  • Partner with Marketing, Business Development, and Channel partners to execute coordinated account-based prospecting that feeds a healthy, qualified pipeline.
  • Maintain consistent pipeline coverage and hygiene, ensuring sufficient volume and stage diversity to meet and exceed quota targets.

Enterprise Sales Cycle Management

  • Manage the full sales cycle from initial outreach and discovery through proposal, negotiation, and close — navigating the complexity typical of enterprise buying processes.
  • Identify and engage multiple stakeholders across IT, Security, Finance, Legal, Procurement, and executive leadership to build multi-threaded relationships within target accounts.
  • Apply a structured qualification methodology (e.g., MEDDPICC) to assess deal health, prioritize effort, and improve forecast accuracy.
  • Navigate enterprise procurement processes, including security reviews, DPAs, and SLAs, with support from Jamf Legal and internal stakeholders.
  • Develop and deliver compelling business cases, demonstrations, and ROI presentations tailored to the priorities of diverse buying audiences.

Commercial & Deal Execution

  • Structure initial commercial agreements that are competitive, value-aligned, and appropriately sized to facilitate a strong land — with long-term expansion in mind.
  • Negotiate contract terms with support from Jamf Legal and Finance, maintaining deal momentum while protecting Jamf's commercial interests.
  • Maintain competitive positioning in deals where incumbents or alternatives are present; articulate Jamf's differentiated value with confidence.

Partner & Ecosystem Engagement

  • Build productive working relationships with Apple's enterprise sales team and Jamf's channel and reseller partners to generate introductions and support deal execution.
  • Engage partner resources appropriately to accelerate pipeline and strengthen account access, especially within named accounts or complex organizations.

Forecasting, Reporting & Team Contribution

  • Maintain accurate, up-to-date records in Salesforce, including account activity, pipeline stage, and deal notes, to support individual and team forecasting.
  • Provide consistent, reliable monthly and quarterly forecasts, with clear visibility into deal status and expected close timelines.
  • Share learnings from the field — win/loss patterns, competitive intelligence, objection themes — to contribute to team and segment knowledge.

What we are looking for:

  • Minimum of 5 years of B2B SaaS or technology sales experience with a demonstrated track record of meeting or exceeding quota (Required)
  • Professional working proficiency in English and Italian is required and Spanish is preferred.
  • Experience managing complex enterprise sales cycles involving multiple stakeholders, including IT and executive-level buyers (Required)
  • Proven ability to generate pipeline through outbound prospecting, partner engagement, and marketing collaboration (Required)
  • Familiarity with a structured sales qualification methodology (e.g., MEDDPICC, MEDDIC, SPIN) and ability to apply it to assess deal health (Required)
  • Demonstrated ability to work effectively in both direct and indirect (channel/partner) selling models (Required)
  • Strong written and verbal communication skills; able to deliver clear and persuasive presentations to technical and business audiences (Required)
  • Proficiency with Salesforce or equivalent CRM for pipeline tracking, forecasting, and activity documentation (Required)
  • Consultative, solutions-oriented selling approach with the ability to connect technology to business outcomes (Preferred)
  • Familiarity with Apple enterprise ecosystem, endpoint management, or SaaS security solutions (Preferred)
  • Experience navigating enterprise procurement processes including DPAs, SLAs, and security reviews (Preferred)
  • Self-directed and resilient; able to manage long sales cycles and ambiguous buying processes with discipline and focus (Preferred)
  • Travel in EU territory around 50%.

SECURITY AND PRIVACY REQUIREMENTS

  • Participation in ongoing security training is mandatory.
  • Established security protocols will be adhered to, sensitive data will be handled responsibly, and data protection practices are followed, including understanding relevant privacy regulations and reporting breaches.
  • Acknowledging the Jamf Code of Conduct, where applicable security and privacy policies can be found, is a requirement of all roles at Jamf.

Why Jamf?

  • Named a Fortune Best Workplace for Millennials, 2021.
  • We offer a clear and defined sales career path. Our main goal is to help you successfully step into our Account Executive role, but there are many ways to advance your career at Jamf.
  • We train and then we give you the room to grow. Our Jamfs can explore the vertical career path, as well as the horizontal, to discover new interests and opportunities.
  • You don’t have to be a techie to be a Jamf. Our best-in-class sales focused Bootcamp training provides you with the technical and product knowledge required to confidently talk with customers about Jamf.
  • We set achievable targets, help each other out, and share best practices across the team.
  • You will have the opportunity to make a real and meaningful impact for more than 70,000 global customers with the best Apple device management solution in the world.
  • We put people over profits – which is why our customers keep coming back to us.
  • We encourage you to simply be you. We constantly seek and value different perspectives to ensure Jamf is a place where everyone feels comfortable and can be successful.
  • 23 of 25 world’s most valuable brands rely on Jamf to do their best work (as ranked by Forbes).

OTE represents the total target annual compensation, consisting of a fixed base salary and performance-based sales commissions. Variable compensation is dependent on the achievement of sales targets and is not guaranteed.

Employment terms, including job classification and applicable minimum salary provisions, are governed by the Italian National Collective Bargaining Agreement for the Metalworking Industry (CCNL Metalmeccanici Industria)

Pay Transparency Range

€90.000—€124.700 EUR

What it means to be a Jamf?
We are a team of free-thinkers, can-doers, and problem-crushers. We value humility and the relentless pursuit of knowledge. Our culture flows from a spirit of selflessness and relentless self-improvement - driving both personal growth and collective progress throughout our company. We unite around common goals while respecting personal approaches, believing that fulfilled individuals create a thriving, vibrant workplace.

Our aim is simple: hire exceptionally good people who are incredibly good at what they do and let them do it. We provide the support and resources to let everyone be their authentic, best selves at work, at rest, and at play. We are committed to supporting the continual improvement of Apple in the workplace, the organizations that rely on them and the people who keep it all running smoothly.

Above it all, waves our banner of #OneJamf – and the knowledge that when we stand together, we accomplish so much more than we could alone. We seek individuals who share this unwavering journey toward growth to join us in our quest for constant improvement.

What does Jamf do?
Jamf extends the legendary Apple experience people enjoy in their personal lives to the workplace. We believe the experience of using a device at work or school should feel the same, and be as secure as, using a personal device. With Jamf, customers are able to confidently automate Mac, iPad, iPhone and Apple TV deployment, management, and security – anytime, anywhere – to protect the data and applications used by employees in the workplace, students learning in the classroom, and streamline communications in healthcare between patients and providers. More than 2,500 Jamf strong worldwide, we are free-thinkers, can-doers, and problems crushers who are encouraged to bring their whole selves to work each and every day.

Get social with us and follow the conversation at #OneJamf

Jamf is committed to creating an inclusive & supportive work environment for all candidates and employees. Candidates with disabilities or religious beliefs are encouraged to reach out if they need additional support or alternative options to our recruiting processes to accommodate their disability or religious belief. If you need an accommodation, please contact your Recruiter or Recruiting Coordinator directly. Requests for accommodation will be handled confidentially by Recruiting and will not be shared with the hiring manager. Jamf is an equal opportunity employer and does not discriminate against individuals who request reasonable accommodation for disability or religious beliefs. To request accommodations please email us at recruiting@jamf.com

title: National Real Estate Practice Leader
description:
The National Real Estate Practice Leader is responsible for advancing IMA’s national presence, growth, and expertise across the real estate industry. This leader brings deep knowledge of real estate risks, sophisticated carrier and market relationships, and a strategic mindset oriented around complex property portfolios, development activity, and evolving economic and regulatory conditions. The leader serves as a highly visible resource across geographies and builds a durable practice capability that markets, producers, service teams, and clients can use across IMA.

Essential Responsibilities:

Growth, Production & Market Impact

  • Drive national new business growth across priority real estate sectors, which may include multifamily, affordable housing, commercial office, industrial and logistics, retail, mixed-use, hospitality, development, and property management.
  • Actively support producers on complex real estate opportunities, including strategy, program structure, property and catastrophe risk, valuation, builder’s risk, casualty, environmental risk, cyber, management liability, claims, and alternative risk considerations.
  • Provide direct involvement on high-value pursuits, including complex portfolios, catastrophe-exposed assets, development projects, and organizations with sophisticated risk financing needs.
  • Participate in internal business reviews, prospect meetings, client presentations, and RFP responses, representing IMA’s national real estate expertise.
  • Bring forward timely insights on real estate, capital markets, insurance conditions, regulatory developments, climate risk, construction costs, and economic trends, and apply them to client and growth strategy.

Real Estate Specialty Strategy & National Alignment

  • Develop and execute the national strategic plan for the Real Estate Practice, ensuring alignment with IMA’s enterprise growth priorities.
  • Establish a clear point of view on priority client segments, geographic opportunities, differentiation, investment needs, and where the practice can win.
  • Partner with market and sales leaders to translate opportunity into focused plans with outcomes, owners, milestones, talent needs, service needs, and resource requirements.
  • Align service standards, technical expectations, and client delivery models across participating IMA markets to support a consistent client experience.
  • Assess the current state of the practice and recommend where to scale, strengthen, incubate, maintain, partner, or stop.

Carrier, Market & Industry Relationships

  • Build and maintain deep relationships with property and casualty carriers, wholesale and program partners, alternative risk providers, and other markets relevant to real estate clients.
  • Strengthen market access and carrier alignment for complex portfolios, catastrophe-exposed assets, development projects, and difficult or specialized risks.
  • Build trusted relationships with real estate associations, centers of influence, lenders, capital partners, and other industry stakeholders.
  • Collaborate with carrier and external partners to bring useful market intelligence, benchmarking, risk insights, and new solutions to IMA’s clients and internal teams.
  • Represent IMA in relevant real estate forums and bring emerging client needs, market changes, and partnership opportunities back into the organization.

Talent Development & Capability Building

  • Define the production, service, technical, analytics, claims, risk control, and leadership capabilities required for the practice to succeed.
  • Actively support specialty recruiting by identifying talent pools, target organizations, role profiles, and high-potential candidates, and by participating in interviews and selection.
  • Partner with Market Presidents and business leaders on onboarding, deployment, development, promotion, and retention of real estate talent.
  • Mentor and develop real estate-specialized talent across production, account management, technical placement, analytics, claims, and risk control.
  • Build a sustainable national bench of real estate experts and future leaders, with deliberate development and succession planning.
  • Reduce reliance on any one individual or market by converting expertise into repeatable solutions, playbooks, tools, training, service standards, and delivery models.

Collaboration, Growth Enablement & Internal Integration

  • Serve as a consultative growth partner to Market Presidents, Commercial Lines leaders, sales leaders, producers, and client teams.
  • Engage early in strategic prospects, complex client needs, and major opportunities to pressure-test assumptions, shape pursuit strategy, and connect the right expertise and resources.
  • Increase producer confidence and effectiveness through real estate insight, practical coaching, relationship support, and clear access to practice resources.
  • Lead national practice calls and cross-market collaboration, promoting knowledge sharing and the transfer of proven approaches across IMA.
  • Partner with Marketing on focused thought leadership, events, association involvement, and market-facing content aligned with practice strategy.
  • Help markets replicate proven growth plays while adapting them to local asset classes, relationships, talent, and execution realities.

Performance, Accountability & Enterprise Leadership

  • Establish meaningful goals and expectations for growth, talent, capability, client value, activity, and execution.
  • Maintain a regular review cadence with market and enterprise stakeholders, surface risks and barriers early, and recommend adjustments based on evidence.
  • Create shared accountability across specialty, market, sales, and service leadership by clarifying ownership, milestones, resource needs, and decision points.
  • Represent the practice in enterprise planning and provide an objective view of opportunity, capacity, performance, and investment needs.
  • Measure success through the capability and results of the practice, not simply the individual activity of the Practice Leader.

Required Experience & Skills

  • Extensive real estate-related brokerage, underwriting, risk management, consulting, or adjacent experience, with strong technical knowledge of real estate exposures and insurance solutions.
  • Demonstrated credibility across relevant real estate sectors, client operating models, risk exposures, insurance markets, and competitive dynamics.
  • Experience supporting complex real estate portfolios, sophisticated placements, development projects, strategic pursuits, or industry-specific solutions.
  • Strong knowledge of property and catastrophe risk, valuation, builder’s risk, complex casualty, contractual risk transfer, claims, and alternative risk considerations.
  • Demonstrated ability to build senior-level relationships with real estate executives, clients, carrier leaders, associations, centers of influence, and strategic partners.
  • Proven ability to lead through influence across markets, functions, and reporting lines.
  • Experience recruiting, developing, mentoring, or deploying specialized talent.
  • Ability to convert technical knowledge into practical solutions, clear communication, scalable tools, and measurable growth or client value.

Competencies

  • Real Estate Industry and Business Acumen
  • Strategic Leadership and Commercial Judgment
  • Capability Building and Talent Development
  • Market Partnership and Growth Enablement
  • Relationship Building with Real Estate Executives, Carriers, and Industry Partners
  • Complex Client and Pursuit Leadership
  • Enterprise Collaboration and Shared Accountability
  • Effective Communication and Executive Presence
  • Execution Discipline and Follow-Through

title: Commercial Insurance Sales Agent II (Intermediate)
description:
Why USAA?

At USAA, our mission is to empower our members to achieve financial security through highly competitive products, exceptional service and trusted advice. We seek to be the #1 choice for the military community and their families.

Embrace a fulfilling career at USAA, where our core values – honesty, integrity, loyalty and service – define how we treat each other and our members. Be part of what truly makes us special and impactful.

We are proud to support active-duty military spouses. USAA roles may offer remote or hybrid flexibility for active-duty military spouses consistent with applicable policy and business needs.

The Opportunity

As a dedicated Commercial Insurance Sales Agent II (Intermediate), you will work within defined guidelines and frameworks to advise business owners and commercial clients on risk management strategies, insurance program design, coverage analysis, and tailored commercial insurance solutions. Leverage commercial insurance products and marketplace expertise to address unique risk exposures, evaluate coverage needs, and develop customized risk management solutions. Secures appropriate coverage by utilizing knowledge of the insurance marketplace, carrier relationships, underwriting guidelines, and policy structures.


Start date for this position is February 22, 2027.


  • 14 weeks of virtual training 8:00am – 4:30pm CT
  • Work schedule after training with be 9:30am – 6:00pm CT.

This role is remote eligible in the continental U.S. with occasional business travel.


What you'll do:

  • Utilizes a consultative approach to determine customer needs, build rapport, and provide solutions across 5 or more carriers, including USAA, to offer options and fulfill members unique needs and exposures.
  • Build and maintain relationships between members, nonmembers and insurance carriers, exercising effective technical knowledge and communication skills.
  • Utilizes understanding of compliance and insurance standards and Agency Management Systems to limit agency Errors & Omissions (E&O) exposure through proper documentation.
  • Classifies members’ and/or non-members’ business and provides accurate risk management and risk mitigation solutions.
  • Facilitates periodic account reviews by leveraging the carrier renewal cycle and understanding the members' and nonmembers' risk profile to provide consultative advice and appropriately address and mitigate risk.
  • Partners and negotiates with underwriters on endorsements, renewal questions, and remarkets for underwriting determination (approval or declination) leveraging intermediate knowledge of Carrier guidelines and processes.
  • Provides select account service including policy changes, certificates, endorsements, renewals, non-renewals, and remarkets, cancellations, reinstatements, and record updates within agency systems.
  • Ensure risks associated with business activities are effectively identified, measured, monitored, and controlled in accordance with risk and compliance policies and procedures.

What you have:

  • High School Diploma or General Equivalency Diploma.
  • 1 year of experience managing, retaining, servicing, and expanding commercial insurance relationships in an agency or broker setting.
  • Demonstrated product and underwriting knowledge to serve members across a national distribution footprint.
  • Experience using Agency Management Systems (AMS), Customer Relationship Management (CRM) systems, and multiple carrier platforms.
  • Knowledge of estimating/calculating Insurance to Value (ITV) across a wide range of commercial property types and structures.
  • Demonstrated communication, critical thinking, and problem-solving skills.
  • Experience documenting customer interactions in CRM systems and effectively managing opportunities through the customer lifecycle.
  • Experience in supporting retention efforts by identifying coverage gaps, recommending solutions, and uncovering cross-sell opportunities.
  • Experience working in a goal-oriented environment with individual performance expectations.
  • Valid General Lines Insurance License for home state and/or ability to obtain home state and multistate licenses within 90 days.
  • Develop proficiency in coverage interpretation and policy servicing while delivering exceptional customer experience.
  • Support retention efforts by identifying coverage gaps, recommending solutions, and uncovering cross-sell opportunities.
  • Effectively document customer interactions and account activity within agency and CRM systems.
  • Identify opportunities to deepen customer relationships through additional insurance solutions and risk management recommendations.

What sets you apart:

  • Commercial Insurance experience.
  • Strong curiosity and active listening skills.
  • Ability to build trust quickly with customers.
  • Resilience and adaptability in a changing environment.
  • Ability to manage multiple priorities while maintaining accuracy.
  • Growth mindset and openness to coaching and feedback.
  • Strong problem-solving and critical thinking skills.

Compensation range: The salary range for this position is: $48,340.00 - $86,630.00.


USAA does not provide visa sponsorship for this role. Please do not apply for this role if at any time (now or in the future) you will need immigration support (i.e., H-1B, TN, STEM OPT Training Plans, etc.).

Compensation: USAA has an effective process for assessing market data and establishing ranges to ensure we remain competitive. You are paid within the salary range based on your experience and market data of the position. The actual salary for this role may vary by location.

Employees may be eligible for pay incentives based on overall corporate and individual performance and at the discretion of the USAA Board of Directors.

The above description reflects the details considered necessary to describe the principal functions of the job and should not be construed as a detailed description of all the work requirements that may be performed in the job.

Benefits: At USAA our employees enjoy best-in-class benefits to support their physical, financial, and emotional wellness. These benefits include comprehensive medical, dental and vision plans, 401(k), pension, life insurance, parental benefits, adoption assistance, paid time off program with paid holidays plus 16 paid volunteer hours, and various wellness programs. Additionally, our career path planning and continuing education assists employees with their professional goals.

For more details on our outstanding benefits, visit our benefits page on USAAjobs.com

title: SVP of Enterprise Payments
description:
Location

Fargo Corporate Office - Remote

Job Description:

Work Location: Fargo Corporate Office (Remote Capable in Midwest States)

Work Location Type: On-Site, Hybrid, or Remote Capable in Midwest States

Work Hours: 8-5 M-F


The SVP of Enterprise Payments is responsible for shaping and leading Gate City Bank’s enterprise payments strategy across consumer, commercial, and treasury experiences. This position will define the Bank’s future-state payments vision and build a scalable, flexible ecosystem that supports customer growth, operational efficiency, new revenue opportunities, and continued innovation.


Serving as the Bank’s enterprise payments leader and subject-matter expert, this position will evaluate customer and business needs, payment economics, market trends, regulatory requirements, and emerging technologies to determine how Gate City should evolve the way money moves. The role will translate that strategy into a prioritized roadmap and lead key initiatives from discovery and design through implementation, launch, adoption, and optimization.


This position will initially lead primarily through influence, expertise, and cross-functional partnership, while establishing the technology, partnerships, governance, and internal capabilities needed to support the Bank’s evolving payments business. Success will be measured by Gate City’s ability to deliver secure, integrated, and differentiated payment experiences that create sustainable value while maintaining the flexibility to adapt as payments continue to evolve.


ESSENTIAL FUNCTIONS:


  • Owns the strategic vision, capability model, roadmap, and governance for modernizing the Bank’s consumer and business payments ecosystem.
  • Develops and maintains Gate City Bank’s enterprise payments strategy, including strategic priorities, target customer segments, differentiated value propositions, investment priorities, and a multi-year capability roadmap.
  • Identifies opportunities to grow payment-related revenue, deepen customer relationships, increase transaction activity, improve deposit retention, and expand the Bank’s role in consumer and business financial workflows.
  • Develops the business and operating model for future payment capabilities, including product ownership, pricing, revenue models, service models, operational responsibilities, technology support, risk ownership, and performance management.
  • Leads discovery of consumer and business financial workflows to identify unmet needs, friction, manual workarounds, external fintech dependencies, and opportunities for Gate City to own, orchestrate, integrate, or partner.
  • Uses customer interviews, transaction behavior, operational data, frontline insight, market research, and competitive intelligence to define and prioritize payment problems worth solving.
  • Establishes and applies an Own, Orchestrate, Integrate, or Partner framework to determine where Gate City should control the customer experience, coordinate multiple providers or rails, connect to valued external platforms, or rely on strategic partners.
  • Defines potential target-state models connecting payment initiation and capture, customer and account context, identity and authentication, fraud and risk decisioning, payment-method selection, routing, execution, settlement, reconciliation, notifications, exceptions, and servicing.
  • Works with Technology and Enterprise Architecture to translate strategic choices into business and architectural requirements, including APIs, data flows, integration patterns, security, resiliency, interoperability, scalability, observability, and platform dependencies.
  • Determines appropriate build, buy, extend, integrate, partner, or hybrid approaches and develops recommendations considering strategic control, customer value, speed, economics, scalability, vendor dependency, implementation complexity, and long-term flexibility.
  • Researches the payments ecosystem and identifies processors, networks, orchestration platforms, fintechs, core and digital providers, fraud and identity partners, open-banking providers, and other · technologies that could enable the future-state model.
  • Leads partner discovery and evaluation, including requirements definition, market scans, RFI/RFP support, demonstrations, due diligence, proofs of concept, reference validation, commercial evaluation, and recommendation development, after customer needs and strategic requirements are sufficiently defined.
  • Develops decision-ready business cases defining the customer problem, target use cases, strategic value, expected economics, investment requirements, risks, dependencies, operating impacts, implementation approach, and measures of success.
  • Defines intelligent payment decisioning and routing requirements that may consider customer preference, payment purpose, transaction context, speed, cost, availability, risk, fraud controls, limits, recipient capability, liquidity, settlement requirements, and operational impact.
  • Establishes an incremental implementation roadmap allowing the Bank to modernize in practical stages while integrating with existing channels, Fiserv DNA, operational processes, payment rails, and related technology investments.
  • Leads cross-functional delivery of approved priorities from discovery and requirements through partner selection, design, pilot, implementation, launch readiness, adoption, measurement, and post-launch optimization.
  • Evaluates how existing and emerging capabilities should connect to the future-state ecosystem, including cards, ACH, wires, instant payments, digital wallets, account-to-account and Pay by Bank, open-banking APIs, P2P, embedded payments, cross-border payments, tokenization, digital assets, and agentic payment experiences.
  • Partners with Fraud, Risk, Compliance, BSA/AML, Legal, Information Security, and Operational Risk to embed customer protection, regulatory requirements, controls, monitoring, and responsible decisioning from the beginning.
  • Partners with Digital, Commercial Banking, Treasury Services, Deposit Operations, Customer Experience, Finance, Data, Technology, Enterprise Architecture, and frontline teams to identify and sequence high-value consumer and business use cases that improve transparency, control, speed, trust, and operational capacity.
  • Defines outcome measures for payment modernization, including adoption, transaction volume, revenue, cost, payment success, speed, fraud and loss, exceptions, customer experience, workflow penetration, and operational capacity.
  • Manages strategic relationships with networks, processors, technology providers, fintechs, consultants, and other ecosystem partners, ensuring recommendations and implementations support the Bank’s long-term architecture and business objectives.
  • Monitors payment technology, standards, network developments, regulation, customer behavior, and competitor activity and recommends what the Bank should implement, pilot, explore, monitor, partner for, integrate, or intentionally defer.
  • Builds enterprise payment fluency by clearly communicating customer evidence, strategic choices, future-state models, partner trade-offs, implementation implications, and the roadmap for customers, team members, operations, risk, and technology.

Other Duties:


  • Deliver a consistently exceptional service experience for both team members and customers.
  • Build and maintain effective working relationships with team members, leaders, customers, and external partners.
  • Demonstrate reliability and accountability in attendance to support operational needs and service expectations.
  • Comply with all Gate City Bank policies, procedures, and all applicable laws and regulations.
  • Maintain a high level of attention to detail and accuracy in all responsibilities.
  • Exercise sound judgment and make timely decisions in a fast‑paced environment.
  • Utilize approved AI-enabled tools and technologies to enhance productivity, support problem-solving and decision-making, and drive efficiencies while exercising sound judgment and adhering to company policies, privacy standards, and responsible use expectations.

Education and Experience: Education and Experience: Bachelor’s degree in business, finance, technology, information systems, product management, or a related field; 7 or more years of progressively responsible experience in payments, digital banking, financial technology, product management, payment operations, or platform modernization; experience leading cross-functional technology implementations and payment transformation initiatives; or an equivalent combination of education and experience.


Other Skills:

  • Deep understanding of consumer and business payment journeys and working knowledge of payment rails, processors, networks, digital channels, payment hubs or orchestration concepts.
  • Strong capability in partner and platform evaluation, requirements definition, business case development, payment economics, solution design, implementation planning, and data-informed decision-making.
  • Ability to translate between business outcomes and technology requirements and influence effectively across business, technology, operations, risk, compliance, finance, and external partners.
  • Ability to operate in ambiguity, separate durable opportunities from hype, connect technology advancement to customer and business outcomes, and move initiatives from research through implementation and measurable adoption.

Certifications: Relevant payments, product, technology, risk, or project management certification preferred, including CPP, AAP, NCP, CTP, or PMP.

title: US Remote Patient Care Advocate (Customer Service)
description:
Job Title: Patient Care Advocate 

Job Location: Remote


About Us: 

We are a dedicated team focused on improving access to affordable prescription medications for patients. By partnering with insurance companies, healthcare providers, and pharmacies, we work to reduce the financial burden of medications, ensuring that patients can access the treatments they need without excessive costs. 


Role Overview: 

As a key member of our team, you will help patients navigate our Prescription Payment Plan. This involves working closely with patients, insurance providers, healthcare professionals, and pharmacies to ensure seamless enrollment, eligibility verification, cost-sharing, and prescription fulfillment. 


What You’ll Do: 

  • Patient Enrollment & Eligibility: Assist patients with enrolling in the program, ensuring all necessary personal and insurance information is provided and verifying eligibility. 
  • Prescription Coverage: Help patients confirm that their prescribed medications are covered under the program, and manage the approval process for eligible medications. 
  • Cost-Sharing & Payment: Reduce patients' out-of-pocket costs by applying the program benefits. Manage copayments, coinsurance, and assist with additional copay assistance when applicable. 
  • Prescription Fulfillment: Coordinate with participating pharmacies to ensure the correct application of benefits during prescription filling, ensuring patients pay the reduced amount. 
  • Refills & Continued Use: Support patients by ensuring they continue receiving medications at reduced costs, monitoring adherence to medication regimens, and ensuring continued eligibility. 
  • Program Renewal & Updates: Guide patients through annual renewals and inform them about any updates to the program or medication formulary. 


What We’re Looking For: 

  • High school diploma or GED required
  • Experience in healthcare, insurance or customer service required (experience with prescription assistance programs is a plus)
  • Strong attention to detail and ability to navigate complex processes
  • Excellent communication skills for working with patients, healthcare providers, and pharmacies
  • A genuine passion for helping others and making a positive impact on their healthcare access

title: Content Reviewer - United States
description:
Every search represents someone seeking reliable information. They depend on search results being accurate, trustworthy, and relevant to their local context. But search engines only learn to return trustworthy information if human evaluators with deep research expertise and cultural knowledge verify and correct them. Your linguistic precision, fact-checking rigor, and understanding of how your culture communicates and values information is irreplaceable in building search systems that people can actually trust.

 

In this role, you will evaluate search queries, results, and AI-generated content for factual accuracy, authority, relevance, and user intent alignment. Your judgment determines whether search systems return trustworthy, contextually appropriate information.

 

  • Analyze multi-turn search queries and web results for factual accuracy, source authority, and user intent alignment
  • Conduct cross-referencing and fact-checking using regional sources, specialized databases, academic resources, and web directories
  • Assess localized content relevancy across diverse domains—news, sports, local culture, technical queries considering regional context and cultural nuance
  • Evaluate AI-generated content for factual grounding, hallucination risk, and contextual appropriateness
  • Provide structured assessments that train search ranking and content relevance models

 

Qualifications to succeed in this project:

 

  • Professional fluency in English
  • Residency in the United States for the last 3 consecutive years  
  • Active use of Gmail and other forms of social media and experience in the use of web browsers to navigate and interact with a variety of content
  • Deep local cultural awareness and familiarity with regional news, current events, and contemporary culture
  • Strong fact-checking and critical thinking abilities
  • Access to a stable broadband internet, a reliable computer and a smartphone (Android 5.0, iOS 14 or higher)
  • Linguists, cross-cultural researchers, domain specialists, and detail-driven professionals with strong research methodology (preferred)

 

Why join the project:

 

  • Fully remote flexibility: Structure your contributions around research, consulting, teaching, or other professional commitments without rigid scheduling
  • Comprehensive research support: Access detailed evaluation guidelines, reference materials, databases, and resources for fact-checking across domains
  • Quality recognition: Performance assessments focused on consistency, fact-checking precision, and nuanced judgment
  • Intellectually demanding by design: If you are driven by fact-checking precision, source authority analysis, and the challenge of identifying what makes information truly trustworthy, this work is built for that mindset.
  • Responsive support: Direct access to evaluation support staff for clarification on ambiguous queries or technical guidance
 
Qualification path

How to get started:

  • Complete your contributor profile and application
  • Take a qualification assessment at your own pace within the time given
  • Verify your identity through our secure identity verification process
  • Acceptance form & Rater Academy: Complete an acceptance form and approximately 2.5 hours of Rater Academy training
  • Receive your project assignment and access credentials

 

Service Rates 

The rate of pay is 0.2333 USD per task, with an estimated earning potential of 14 USD per hour.

Compensation is based on tasks completed and project availability. Estimated earnings may vary depending on task volume and program requirements including, quality, and productivity, in accordance with the program's quality standards and guidelines.

 

Independent Contractor Relationship

This opportunity is offered on an independent contractor basis. Contributors have the flexibility to choose when and how much they work, subject to project availability and quality requirements. This opportunity is not and should not be construed as creating an employment relationship with TELUS Digital.

title: Paid Media Specialist
description:
Kinsta is one of the top providers of managed hosting for WordPress, with a growing club of 230,000+ businesses including startups, universities, and Fortune 500 firms. We're motivated by excellent quality and proud to have received a 97% satisfaction rating from our customers.

That's because, to us, each day is a chance to grow. As a team, we continuously inspire each other to learn new and better ways to make an impact. We own our jobs proudly - our leaders don't hold our hands, but they're in our corner whenever we ask for help - and our environment is flexible and remote-first.

As our new Paid Media Specialist, you'll plan, run, and optimize paid social advertising campaigns for Kinsta. You'll join our Performance Marketing team, report to the Paid Media Team Lead, and work closely with Demand Generation, Design, and RevOps to deliver a consistent volume of sign-ups and revenue that supports Kinsta's growth goals. It's a hands-on role for someone who is comfortable with data and enjoys testing new ideas.

Your focus is Kinsta's paid social presence across LinkedIn, Meta, Reddit, X, and other relevant platforms. You'll reach the businesses, agencies, and enterprises that run their sites on WordPress, through campaigns that cover the full funnel from awareness to customer acquisition.

You'll own campaigns from build to optimization, keep conversion tracking reliable, and turn performance data into clear recommendations. We work with teams across the globe, so you should be used to collaborating asynchronously and flexible enough to join the occasional early or late call. The ideal Kinsta Paid Media Specialist is analytical, detail-oriented, curious, proactive, and collaborative.

What You Will Do:

Plan, build, launch, and manage paid social campaigns across LinkedIn, Meta, Reddit, X, and other relevant platforms, covering the full funnel from awareness and demand generation to lead generation and customer acquisition.

Monitor performance and continuously optimize targeting, bidding strategies, budgets, ad creatives, and landing pages, scaling what works while keeping acquisition costs efficient.

Run audience research and competitive analysis to find new opportunities for growth.

Develop and run A/B tests across ad messaging, creative assets, audiences, and landing pages.

Own conversion tracking: implement, maintain, and troubleshoot it through Google Tag Manager, Google Analytics 4 (GA4), and platform-specific pixels and tags, and work with marketing and technical teams to keep conversion events and attribution accurate.

Analyze campaign performance using ad platform data, web analytics, and CRM reporting, and build reports and dashboards that share results and actionable insights.

Collaborate with content, design, product marketing, and sales on ad copy, creative concepts, and campaign assets that match our messaging and business priorities.

Support our paid media strategy: follow advertising trends and platform updates, and recommend ways to improve campaign efficiency, lead quality, and overall marketing ROI.

Use AI tools to streamline research, reporting, ad copy, and creative ideation, automate repetitive tasks, and apply critical thinking to AI-generated recommendations so decisions stay grounded in accurate data and business objectives.

What You Bring To The Role:

2-4 years of hands-on experience independently building, launching, managing, and optimizing paid social campaigns, including on Meta, LinkedIn, and Reddit, ideally in hosting, B2B technology, or a related industry.

Practical experience setting up and troubleshooting conversion tracking with Google Tag Manager, GA4, and advertising platform pixels or conversion tags.

A strong understanding of core paid media metrics, including CPC, CPM, CTR, conversion rate, CPA, and ROAS, and experience analyzing campaign data and turning findings into actionable optimizations.

Familiarity with audience targeting, retargeting, and campaign testing methodologies, and an understanding of marketing funnels, attribution, and how paid media contributes to lead generation and customer acquisition.

Attention to detail, a proactive approach to problem-solving, and excellent organizational and communication skills, with the ability to manage multiple campaigns and priorities at once.

Bonus if you have:

Experience running paid media campaigns for B2B SaaS, hosting, PaaS, or other technical products, and familiarity with WordPress or cloud platforms.

Experience with CRM, marketing automation, and attribution or reporting tools such as HubSpot, Salesforce, Looker Studio, Dreamdata, or HockeyStack.

Knowledge of advanced conversion tracking, including enhanced conversions, offline conversion imports, and server-side tracking, plus a basic understanding of HTML, JavaScript, cookies, and how tracking tags work on websites.

Experience optimizing landing pages and collaborating on conversion rate optimization (CRO) initiatives.

Proficiency in other languages and experience managing non-English paid media campaigns

Experience using AI tools such as ChatGPT or Claude to improve campaign workflows, analysis, and creative development.

Our Benefits:

Annual remote expense budget.

Flexible PTO.

Paid parental leave.

Annual professional development budget: available after one year with Kinsta.

Sabbatical: available after three years with Kinsta (and every three years thereafter).

Location-specific healthcare benefits (includes vision and dental) for employees hired in the USA, UK, Canada, and Hungary.

Pension plan for employees hired in the UK, and 401k contributions for employees hired in the USA.

We will not discriminate and we will take actions to ensure against discrimination in employment, recruitment, advertisements for employment, compensation, termination, promotions, and other conditions of employment against any employee or job applicant on the basis of race, color, gender, national origin, citizenship, age, religion, creed, disability, marital status, veteranâs status, sexual orientation, gender identity, gender expression, or any other status protected by the laws or regulations in the locations where we operate.
