title: Sytems & Infrastructure Engineer - Robotics (m/f/d)
description:
As a Software Engineer at our Rostock location, you will develop innovative software solutions for the next generation of autonomous systems. Working closely with cross-functional teams, you will tackle complex technical challenges and contribute throughout the entire development lifecycle—from concept and implementation to the continuous improvement of our technologies. At Quantum Systems, we develop intelligent, connected systems across the air, land, sea, and underwater domains, delivering solutions that support demanding civilian and defense applications worldwide.

What is your Day to Day Mission:

  • Deploy, configure and maintain Linux-based systems on robotic platforms and ground control stations.

  • Design, implement and troubleshoot network and communication architectures for field deployments and operational environments.

  • Build and maintain secure connectivity solutions between distributed systems and remote assets.

  • Configure, monitor and troubleshoot wired, wireless and satellite communication links.

  • Manage routing, firewalling, VPNs and network services across complex system environments.

  • Build, deploy and maintain containerized applications and supporting infrastructure.

  • Support software deployment pipelines, automation and infrastructure management.

  • Monitor system performance, network health and service availability.

  • Work closely with robotics, software and hardware teams to integrate and operate complete system solutions.

  • Prepare, maintain and support robotic platforms during testing, demonstrations and customer deployments.

  • Troubleshoot issues across software, networking, communications and hardware components.

  • Contribute to technical documentation, deployment procedures and operational best practices.



What you bring to the team:

  • Experience in DevOps, Systems Engineering, Infrastructure Engineering or a similar role.

  • Strong Linux administration and troubleshooting skills.

  • Experience with Embedded Linux platforms, autonomous systems, robotics hardware or edge computing devices.

  • Solid understanding of networking concepts including TCP/IP, routing, VPNs, firewalls, NAT and network services.

  • Experience deploying and operating distributed or remote systems.

  • Practical experience with containerization technologies and modern deployment workflows.

  • Understanding of infrastructure automation and CI/CD principles.

  • Experience integrating and troubleshooting communication systems and networked devices.

  • Strong analytical and problem-solving skills across software, hardware and networking domains.

  • Hands-on mindset with the ability to work directly on systems in laboratory and field environments.

  • Ability to perform effectively in fast-paced and mission-critical situations.

  • Strong communication skills and fluent English.


Why Quantum-Systems:

  • We believe in the power of combined efforts: straightforward tech expertise paired with a customer-centric focus.

  • We are industry pioneers who are ambitious, bold, and visionary.

  • We push limits, think outside-the-box and strive for technological excellence to shape the future of aerial data.

  • We promise to be your runway for individual and professional growth.


Our benefits:

  • Company pension scheme: We support you so that you can already make provisions for later.

  • Flexible working hours: With trust-based working hours, you are not only responsible for your working hours, but also for your work-life balance.

  • Mobile working: If it gets too turbulent for you in our office, you can get the necessary balance through mobile working.

  • Bike-Leasing: We support you in staying environmentally mobile and healthy.

  • Corporate Benefits: Your opportunity for attractive offers and discounts from well-known suppliers and brands, e.g. Adidas, Apple, Expedia.

  • Employee events: We not only want to grow together, but also celebrate our successes together.


About us:

Quantum Systems specialises in the development, design, and production of small Unmanned Aerial Systems (sUAS). The company’s range of electric vertical take-off and landing (eVTOL) sUAS are built to maximize range and versatility and to provide operators with a seamless user experience. By integrating cutting-edge software capabilities, like edge computing and real-time AI-powered data processing, Quantum Systems is building next-generation UAS for clients in defence, security, public sectors.


Our commitment:

We are an open-minded company that not only values diversity, but actively promotes it. Regardless of gender, age, ethnic origin, religion, sexual orientation or disability, we firmly believe that the diversity of our employees is an essential part of our success.

At our company, every voice is heard and every perspective is valued. We believe that our differences enrich us and help us to find creative solutions and generate innovative ideas. We pride ourselves on creating an inclusive work environment where all employees can reach their full potential.

title: Product Marketing
description:
Deine Mission

Produkt und Design sind bei Bling eine Rolle.Du baust bei uns eigene Features, vom User-Problem bis zum Release. Du findest das Problem, entwickelst das Konzept, gestaltest die Lösung selbst in Figma und briefst sie übergabereif für die Entwicklung. Nach dem Launch schaust du dir an, wie dein Feature genutzt wird, und entscheidest, was als Nächstes passiert.

Du arbeitest direkt mit unserem Head of Product und trägst vom ersten Monat an die Verantwortung für deine Features.

Deine Aufgaben

  • Du übernimmst Ownership für eigene Features, von der User-Problem-Discovery über die Konzeption bis zum Launch
  • Du gestaltest die Lösungen selbst in Figma: User Flows und Screens auf Basis unseres Design Systems
  • Du übersetzt deine Konzepte und Designs in klare Tickets für unsere Entwickler und erarbeitest die technische Umsetzung gemeinsam mit ihnen
  • Du verantwortest Releases und stehst für die Qualität der gebauten Funktionen ein
  • Du erkennst Reibungspunkte in der User Journey und entwickelst Lösungen, die Conversion, Activation und Retention messbar verbessern
  • Du analysierst nach dem Launch die Nutzung, initiierst Experimente und A/B-Tests und leitest daraus die nächsten Schritte ab

Dein Profil

  • Du hast schon etwas gebaut und kannst es zeigen: ein Feature, ein Side Project, eine App. Ob aus ein bis zwei Jahren im Product Management oder Product Design oder aus starken Praktika, ist uns egal
  • Du hast Freude daran, Produkte zu skalieren, und willst sehen, dass sich deine Arbeit in den Zahlen zeigt
  • Du wartest nicht auf Aufgaben. Du siehst ein Problem, machst es zu deinem und lässt es erst los, wenn es gelöst ist
  • Du fühlst dich sicher im Umgang mit Figma und hast ein gutes Gespür für UX/UI und ästhetische Interfaces
  • Du denkst in der Konzeption schon die Umsetzung mit und kannst mit Entwicklern auf Augenhöhe über Lösungen diskutieren
  • Du arbeitest aktiv mit AI und weißt, wo sie dir Arbeit abnimmt und wo du besser selbst ran musst
  • Du übernimmst Ownership, arbeitest strukturiert mit Roadmaps, Tickets und Deadlines und hältst dabei ein hohes Tempo
  • Du sprichst Deutsch auf Muttersprachniveau und sehr gutes Englisch, lebst in Berlin und bist drei Tage pro Woche bei uns im Büro

Was dich erwartet

  • Echte Ownership: Deine Features landen bei über 150.000 Familien
  • Direkte Zusammenarbeit mit unserem Head of Product, mit kurzen Wegen, schnellem Feedback und steiler Lernkurve
  • Ein MacBook und hochwertiges Equipment, damit du bestens ausgestattet bist, um erfolgreich zu arbeiten
  • Ein flexibles Hybrid-Arbeitsmodell, das dir ermöglicht, im Büro oder von zu Hause zu arbeiten – mit der Option, gelegentlich auch remote zu arbeiten
  • Subventionierter Urban Sports Club, ein Bling-Mobile Tarif und weitere Benefits
  • Ein modernes, lebendiges Büro im Herzen von Berlin Mitte mit einer voll ausgestatteten Küche mit kostenlosen Getränken, Frühstück, Snacks und unserer Siebträger Kaffeemaschine
  • Regelmäßige Teamevents, die unsere Unternehmenskultur stärken und jeden Erfolg noch schöner machen

Schick uns deinen CV und einen Link zu etwas, das du gebaut hast.

title: Financial Crime Analyst
description:
The company

Small businesses move fast. Opportunities often don’t wait, and cash flow pressures can appear overnight. To keep going, and growing, SMEs need finance that’s as flexible and responsive as they are.

That's why we built iwoca. Our smart technology, data science and five-star customer service ensures business owners can act with the speed, confidence and control they need, exactly when it's needed.

We’ve already cleared the way for 100,000 businesses with more than £4 billion in funding. Our passionate team is driven to help even more SMEs succeed, through access to better finance and other services that make running a business easier. Our ultimate mission is to support one million SMEs in their defining moments, creating lasting impact for the communities and economies they drive.

We’re looking for a Financial Crime Analyst

If you’re curious, analytical and enjoy getting into the details, this could be the role for you. You’ll dive into suspicious activity, help protect small businesses from fraud and financial crime, and play a key part in keeping our processes sharp and secure. We're looking for candidates based in either London or Leeds.

The role
iwoca's Financial Crime Analysts protect our customers and our business from fraud. You'll become an expert in how fraudsters target small businesses and card products, helping our business credit card grow safely while keeping the experience smooth for genuine customers.

You'll investigate suspicious applications, accounts and card activity, owning the process from first alert to final decision. Working closely with our Credit Cards and Operations teams, you'll spot new fraud patterns early to help strengthen our controls. From time to time, you'll also support our core lending business with fraud cases on our Flexi-Loan, giving you a wider view of financial crime across iwoca.

Your mission will be:

  • Investigating cases flagged as a potential fraud or AML risk. Including CIFAS flags, facial biometric anomalies, device based anomalies, signs of document tampering and more.

  • Screening PEP, sanction and adverse media matches.

  • Taking ownership of customer verification on a case by case basis and deciding what information is required to reduce the risk of fraud and money laundering.

  • Monitoring account activity and transactions, investigating anything unusual and raising unusual activity where needed.

  • Identifying opportunities to improve our processes and implement changes which will make us more efficient

  • Working closely with our Account Managers, Credit Analyst and Broker teams to maintain our high fraud prevention standards while ensuring a fast and slick service.

The requirements

We look for people who are smart, humble, motivated and who are always looking to improve.

Ideally, you’ll have:

  • At least 1 years’ experience within a financial crime related role

  • Good knowledge of fraud and financial crime

  • Brilliant communication skills and experience delivering constructive and candid feedback

  • A confident and enthusiastic attitude that works well in a regularly changing and fast-paced environment

  • A pragmatic, risk-based approach to case investigation

  • An analytical mindset with a practical approach to problem solving, sometimes we need to make decisions with limited information

Whilst we welcome applications from all qualified candidates, please note that this particular position does not offer visa sponsorship. Candidates must be eligible to work in the UK independently.

The salary

Our base salary range in Leeds is £30,000 - £35,000 and our base salary range in London is £35,000 - £40,000. We want to pay all of our employees fairly, so that’s why we regularly benchmark salaries based on market rates and to recognise your increasing value to our business.

At iwoca, we prioritise a culture of learning, growth, and support, and invest in the development of our team members. We value thought and skill diversity, and encourage people to explore new areas of interest, adopt better tools – including AI – and apply sound judgement so our products and decisions improve over time.

The offices

We put a lot of effort into making iwoca a great place to work:

  • Offices in London, Leeds, Berlin, and Frankfurt with plenty of drinks and snacks.

  • Flexible working hours.

  • Medical insurance from Vitality, including discounted gym membership.

title: Sr. Account Executive, Retail Media
description:
Help retailers turn shopper intent into a growing media business

Constructor helps e-commerce businesses connect shoppers with the products they want through AI-powered search and product discovery.

We’re looking for an experienced Retail Media sales professional to help grow our business across EMEA. You’ll work with retailers to understand their monetisation ambitions, build compelling business cases and sell technology that helps them develop and scale their Retail Media offering.

This is a hands-on commercial role—not a campaign-operations position. You’ll combine deep industry knowledge with enterprise sales discipline, working alongside Account Managers and the wider Sales team to turn qualified opportunities into lasting customer partnerships.

What you’ll do

Own Retail Media opportunities from discovery to close

  • Identify and qualify opportunities with retailers looking to launch, improve or scale their Retail Media business.

  • Lead consultative discovery with Retail Media, e-commerce, commercial and technology stakeholders.

  • Build opportunity strategies with clear decision processes, executive engagement and agreed next steps.

  • Lead proposals, negotiations and commercial agreements in partnership with the relevant account owner.

  • Maintain a credible pipeline and an evidence-based forecast.

Build business cases that stand up to scrutiny

  • Understand each retailer’s commercial model, advertiser demand, inventory and operational readiness.

  • Translate those inputs into clear monetisation scenarios, with transparent assumptions and measurable success criteria.

  • Explain how sponsored products, display formats and relevant integration approaches can support the retailer’s objectives.

  • Work with technical and product specialists to define demonstrations, proof plans and realistic delivery expectations.

  • Help customers evaluate revenue potential alongside shopper relevance, customer experience and operational requirements.

Navigate a complex buying group

  • Build relationships with senior Retail Media, digital, commercial and technology leaders.

  • Help stakeholders align around the opportunity, investment and path to launch.

  • Understand the relationship between retailer economics and the needs of brands, sellers and agencies.

  • Address commercial and organisational blockers rather than treating every challenge as a product gap.

Make the wider commercial team stronger

  • Partner with Account Managers on Retail Media expansion opportunities within existing customer relationships.

  • Support Sales colleagues where Retail Media is part of a broader customer proposition.

  • Share discovery frameworks, objection handling, business-case approaches and lessons from live deals.

  • Help develop a repeatable Retail Media sales motion across EMEA.

  • Ensure closed opportunities move into delivery with clear commitments, ownership and success criteria.

Bring market insight into the business

  • Share customer feedback, competitive insights and emerging buying requirements with Product and leadership.

  • Represent Constructor in relevant customer conversations and industry events.

  • Help sharpen our positioning through practical knowledge of what retailers need to build a sustainable media business.

What you’ll bring

  • A proven track record selling Retail Media, commerce media or closely related advertising technology.

  • Experience managing complex enterprise sales cycles, from discovery and business case through negotiation and close.

  • A strong understanding of retailer monetisation and the relationships between retailers, brands, sellers and agencies.

  • The ability to discuss media performance, measurement and incrementality—and distinguish credible evidence from assumptions.

  • Confidence engaging senior commercial and technical stakeholders.

  • Strong commercial judgment, pipeline discipline and forecasting skills.

  • An ability to make complex technology and business models easy to understand.

  • A collaborative approach: you can lead a specialist sales motion while respecting the broader customer relationship.

  • Professional fluency in English.

Your experience may come from a Retail Media platform, an adtech provider or a retailer’s media business. What matters is your ability to combine industry expertise with demonstrated commercial delivery.

It would be a bonus if you have

  • Experience selling retailer-facing technology that enables Retail Media networks.

  • Experience with sponsored products, onsite display, auctions or mediation.

  • Familiarity with enterprise e-commerce and product discovery.

  • Experience working across several EMEA markets.

  • Relationships within the European Retail Media ecosystem.

  • Additional European language skills.

What success looks like

You build a qualified pipeline, develop strong customer business cases and convert opportunities into commercial partnerships. Customers understand both the growth opportunity and what it will take to realise it.

You also create impact beyond your own deals: Account Managers and Sales colleagues become more confident in Retail Media conversations, customer commitments are clear, and market feedback helps shape a more effective proposition.

Why this role

  • Help shape a specialist Retail Media sales motion across EMEA.

  • Work at the intersection of AI-powered commerce, shopper experience and retailer monetisation.

  • Combine ownership of complex deals with influence on positioning and commercial strategy.

  • Work closely with commercial, product and technical teams to turn customer ambitions into actionable plans.

Benefits

  • A competitive compensation package including stock options

  • Fully remote team - choose where you live

  • Work from home stipend! We want you to have the resources you need to set up your home office

  • Apple laptops provided for new employees

  • Training and development budget for every employee, refreshed each year

  • Parental leave for qualified employees

  • Work with smart people who will help you grow and make a meaningful impact

At Constructor.io we are committed to cultivating a work environment that is diverse, equitable, and inclusive. As an equal opportunity employer, we welcome individuals of all backgrounds and provide equal opportunities to all applicants regardless of their education, diversity of opinion, race, color, religion, gender, gender expression, sexual orientation, national origin, genetics, disability, age, veteran status or affiliation in any other protected group.

title: Field Solutions Engineer
description:
Shield AI is a venture-backed defense-tech company with the mission of protecting service members and civilians with intelligent systems. Its products include Hivemind autonomy software, V-BAT and X-BAT aircraft, and Aechelon simulation and synthetic reality technologies. With offices and facilities across the U.S., Europe, the Middle East, and Asia-Pacific, Shield AI’s technology actively supports operations worldwide. For more information, visit www.shield.ai. Follow Shield AI on LinkedIn, X, Instagram, and  

Shield AI is hiring a Field Solutions Engineer based in Madrid, Spain to support technical sales, customer engagements, demonstrations, and capture activities focused on advanced simulation, synthetic environments, image generation systems, and AI-enabled mission systems.

This role will support defense simulation, training, test, and evaluation customers across Europe, helping them understand how Shield AI and Aechelon capabilities can support training systems, next-generation synthetic battlespace environments, live-virtual-constructive ecosystems, and AI-enabled simulation use cases.

This role requires direct, hands-on experience with advanced defense simulation, training, and test environments. The ideal candidate should understand image generation systems, platform-in-a-box solutions, threat models, constructive entities, sensor simulation, scenario generation, and LVC architectures, and how these technologies integrate into complex distributed simulation ecosystems.

This is a simulation-first role. Autonomy experience is valuable where AI or autonomy is used to run synthetic agents, generate behaviors, drive adversary models, automate scenarios, or improve realism in simulated environments. Real-world autonomy experience is preferred, but the primary requirement is deep simulation domain expertise combined with strong customer-facing technical communication.

What you'll do:

  • Serve as a customer-facing technical expert for Shield AI and Aechelon simulation, synthetic environment, and AI-enabled mission system capabilities across Europe.

  • Support customer discovery, technical briefings, demonstrations, technical interchange meetings, RFIs, RFPs, proposals, white papers, and capture activities.

  • Translate customer mission needs, training objectives, test requirements, CONOPs, and integration considerations into credible solution concepts.

  • Support engagements involving European, NATO, and allied defense simulation, training, test, and evaluation environments.

  • Explain image generation systems, synthetic environments, PAIBs, threat models, LVC architectures, sensor simulation, scenario generation, and AI-enabled synthetic agents to technical, operational, commercial, and leadership audiences.

  • Partner with Business Development, Capture, Product, Engineering, Customer Engagement, Program, and technical teams to represent customer requirements, risks, roadmap gaps, and field feedback.

  • Help customers evaluate how advanced simulation and synthetic environments can support operational training, mission rehearsal, test and evaluation, experimentation, force modernization, and AI/autonomy development.

  • Develop technical sales assets, including capability briefs, demo scripts, solution templates, FAQs, white papers, technical explainers, and customer-specific briefing materials.

  • Maintain product truth by ensuring customer-facing materials and discussions accurately reflect current capabilities, constraints, roadmap timing, and integration considerations.

  • Build trusted relationships with customer technical stakeholders, operational users, acquisition organizations, defense primes, systems integrators, and internal cross-functional partners

Required qualifications:

  • 7+ years of experience in modeling and simulation, training systems, test and evaluation, image generation systems, synthetic environments, defense software, aerospace systems, solutions engineering, systems engineering, field applications engineering, technical sales, or related technical customer-facing roles.

  • Direct hands-on experience with defense simulation, training, or test environments supporting military or government customers.

  • Practical experience with image generation systems, platform-in-a-box systems, synthetic environments, threat models, constructive entities, sensor simulation, scenario generation, or live-virtual-constructive environments.

  • Strong understanding of how simulation systems are used for operational training, mission rehearsal, experimentation, test and evaluation, and capability development.

  • Experience supporting customer-facing technical engagements, proposal efforts, integration discussions, technical interchange meetings, or operational workshops.

  • Ability to translate customer requirements, mission needs, training objectives, and technical constraints into feasible solution concepts, requirements, demos, and product feedback.

  • Strong written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to explain complex technical systems to technical, operational, commercial, and leadership audiences.

  • Ability to work cross-functionally with Business Development, Product, Engineering, Customer Engagement, Program teams, and technical SMEs.

  • Strong judgment in representing product capabilities, limitations, roadmap dependencies, and integration considerations to customers.

  • Ability to operate independently across complex international customer engagements while maintaining alignment with internal stakeholders.

  • Willingness and ability to travel throughout Europe and internationally for customer engagements, demonstrations, exercises, and internal meetings.

  • Professional fluency in Spanish and English.

Preferred qualifications:

  • Experience supporting defense simulation, training, test, or experimentation customers in Spain, Europe, NATO, or allied markets.

  • Experience working with ministries of defense, armed forces, government laboratories, defense primes, systems integrators, training organizations, or test organizations.

  • Professional fluency in Spanish or another European language.

  • Experience with AI-enabled synthetic agents, computer-generated forces, adversary behavior models, automated scenario generation, or AI-driven entity behavior in simulated environments.

  • Real-world autonomy experience, including autonomous aircraft, unmanned systems, robotics, AI-enabled mission systems, or autonomy software.

  • Familiarity with LVC architectures, simulation interoperability, DIS/HLA, test infrastructure, training range integration, or distributed simulation environments.

  • Hands-on experience with Python, C++, Linux, APIs, SDKs, simulation tooling, visualization systems, autonomy software, robotics middleware, or technical prototyping.

  • Prior military, defense, aerospace, simulation, test, training, robotics, unmanned systems, or advanced software experience.

  • Experience supporting proposals, RFIs, RFPs, white papers, technical volumes, or complex international capture activities.

Our international teammates receive a comprehensive total rewards package aligned to your country office location. For full details on compensation and benefits, please consult your talent acquisition partner.

title: Architect – Customer Demos & Key Accounts – English, German, Korean
description:
This position is listed on behalf of a partner company, who manages all applications and next steps. Our partner is looking for an Architect – Customer Demos & Key Accounts – English, German, Korean based in Switzerland.

As an Architect – Customer Demos & Key Accounts, you will bridge the worlds of architecture, customer relationship management, and software development. You will showcase innovative building configurators to international customers, demonstrating how complex project requirements can be transformed into permit-ready building designs within minutes. Combining architectural expertise with technical understanding, you will adapt product demonstrations to different customer needs and evaluate new features from a practical planning perspective. You will also manage relationships with strategic accounts, understand their workflows, and translate operational challenges into actionable product requirements. Working closely with architects, engineers, and software developers, you will help improve product quality and ensure successful customer adoption. This fully remote opportunity offers the chance to influence the future of digital building planning within an international, collaborative team.


Accountabilities:

You will combine product demonstrations, architectural quality assurance, and strategic account management to ensure that customers successfully adopt building configurators while providing valuable insights to improve the product.

  • Customer Demonstrations: Prepare and deliver engaging product demonstrations for customers and partners, primarily remotely and occasionally on-site, in English, German, or Korean.

  • Tailored Product Presentations: Adapt demonstrations to specific customer use cases, building types, and project requirements while explaining design logic, planning regulations, and generated outputs.

  • Architectural Quality Assurance: Test new features and configurators before release, evaluating generated site layouts, floor plans, and building models for architectural plausibility, buildability, and compliance with underlying rules.

  • Issue Identification & Documentation: Identify bugs, inconsistencies, and improvement opportunities, documenting findings with clear reproduction steps, screenshots, and structured feedback.

  • Cross-Functional Collaboration: Work closely with planning and algorithm teams to prioritize issues and ensure product improvements reflect real architectural and customer requirements.

  • Product Feedback & Roadmap: Gather insights from customer demonstrations and conversations, translating feedback into actionable recommendations for the product roadmap.

  • Knowledge Management: Develop reusable demonstration scripts, test cases, and shared documentation to improve internal knowledge sharing and product evaluation processes.

  • Key Account Management: Serve as the primary product-side contact for selected strategic customers, building strong relationships with their expansion, planning, and real estate teams.

  • Workflow Analysis: Understand customer processes from initial site assessment through permitting, identifying opportunities to automate, simplify, or connect existing workflows.

  • Technical Requirements Translation: Convert customer workflows and operational needs into concrete software requirements, rules, and parameters for development teams.

  • Implementation & Customer Success: Coordinate product rollouts, support customers through implementation and productive use, and maintain engagement after launch.

    • Requirements:

    The ideal candidate combines formal architectural training with strong communication, analytical, and customer-facing skills. You should understand how buildings are designed and planned, be comfortable discussing technical concepts with software engineers, and have the ability to translate complex customer workflows into practical software requirements.

  • Bachelor's or Master's degree in Architecture.

  • Practical experience in architectural design, building planning, or permitting processes is highly desirable.

  • Fluency in English and German is required, with Korean language proficiency considered a strong advantage.

  • Confidence presenting products and communicating with international customers in multiple languages.

  • Basic understanding of artificial intelligence, algorithms, and programming concepts.

  • Ability to understand rule-based systems, interpret simple scripts or logical structures, and communicate effectively with technical development teams.

  • Familiarity with BIM software such as Revit or Archicad is advantageous.

  • Experience with parametric design tools such as Grasshopper is a plus.

  • Strong understanding of architectural planning workflows and customer decision-making processes.

  • Ability to analyze operational processes, identify inefficiencies, and translate findings into clear software requirements.

  • Previous experience in key account management, consulting, or customer-facing project management is highly valued.

  • A forward-deployed mindset, with the ability to work directly with customers, take ownership of their success, and act as a bridge between customer teams and engineers.

  • Excellent presentation, communication, and interpersonal skills.

  • Strong attention to detail, organizational skills, and a structured approach to testing and documentation.

  • Willingness to travel occasionally for customer visits and on-site collaboration.

    • Benefits:

  • Fully remote working arrangement, with the flexibility to work from anywhere worldwide.

  • Permanent employment contract.

  • Flexible working hours.

  • Opportunity to work at the intersection of architecture, technology, and software innovation.

  • Direct interaction with international customers, including major retailers and real estate developers.

  • Opportunity to influence product development through direct customer feedback and architectural expertise.

title: Platform Engineering Internship - Observability
description:
The Observability Platform team is responsible for managing the capabilities that help identifying the issues within TomTom’s online products and ensure they are timely fixed to enable best customer experience. We drive improving the operational quality and effectiveness of the service and aim to enable self-service for our users by system engineering and software development.  

The position is targeted towards last-year students with a potential to become a full-time employee over the course of 6-12 months.


What you’ll do: 

As a Platform Engineer you will work on addressing reliability, availability, scalability, efficiency for your team’s components and help the rest of the company benefit from them. 

  • You will manage existing Observability tools and help internal customers master them. 

  • You will learn by example about the architecture, design, standards, and implementation of new and existing systems to enhance their functionality, reliability, efficiency and scalability with a moderate level of autonomy. 

  • You will learn to scale systems and increase their reliability in a diverse environment ensuring the mission critical systems meet 99.95% SLOs. 

  • You will support navigation tooling in the world. 


    • What you’ll need: 

  • Experience with modern coding/infrastructure related languages such as Python. 

  • Systems engineering fundamentals understanding: Linux, containers, networking (TCP/IP, DNS, TLS), distributed systems basics

title: Business Analyst (Mexico Based) - Global Services Company
description:
About Truelogic

At Truelogic we are a leading provider of nearshore staff augmentation services headquartered in New York. For over two decades, we’ve been delivering top-tier technology solutions to companies of all sizes, from innovative startups to industry leaders, helping them achieve their digital transformation goals.

Our team of 600+ highly skilled tech professionals, based in Latin America, drives digital disruption by partnering with U.S. companies on their most impactful projects. Whether collaborating with Fortune 500 giants or scaling startups, we deliver results that make a difference.

By applying for this position, you’re taking the first step in joining a dynamic team that values your expertise and aspirations. We aim to align your skills with opportunities that foster exceptional career growth and success while contributing to transformative projects that shape the future.

Our Client

A Leading global professional services firm with over 9,000 employees worldwide and more than 40 years of experience delivering innovative technology and talent solutions. Operating across both public and commercial sectors, the company combines deep industry expertise with a people-first approach to help organizations solve complex challenges and achieve lasting results. As a privately held organization, it maintains the flexibility to prioritize long-term impact, innovation, and excellence, while also being recognized as a pioneer in bringing neurodiversity and inclusive practices into the enterprise.

Job Summary

We are seeking a Business Analyst, Field Operations & Metering to support technology initiatives across the gas, propane, and electric utility sectors. In this role, you will collaborate with field operations, metering, customer operations, IT, and delivery teams to analyze business needs, identify process improvement opportunities, and translate operational requirements into effective technology solutions. You will play a key role in optimizing field workflows, enhancing work execution and service delivery, and driving successful technology adoption across the organization.

Responsibilities

  • Collaborate with field operations, metering, dispatch, customer operations, and IT stakeholders to gather business requirements, document current-state processes, identify operational challenges, and define data, device, and integration needs.

  • Develop process maps, use cases, workflows, business rules, and impact assessments for utility field activities, including meter installations, exchanges, removals, inspections, meter reads, service orders, disconnects/reconnects, and exception handling.

  • Create and maintain epics, features, user stories, acceptance criteria, test scenarios, and supporting documentation in Azure DevOps or similar tools.

  • Track defects, validate business requirements, and ensure delivered solutions meet operational needs.

  • Support process improvements and technology adoption across gas, propane, and electric utility operations.

Qualifications and Job Requirements

  • Fluent in English, both written and verbal.

  • Previous experience as a Business Analyst supporting field operations, metering, utility technology, or customer operations projects.

  • Experience with business process mapping and documentation using tools such as Visio, Lucidchart, PowerPoint, or similar applications.

Preferred Qualifications:

Why You’ll Like Working Here

  • A Culture That Values You: We prioritize well-being and work-life balance, offering engagement activities and fostering dynamic teams to ensure you thrive both personally and professionally.

title: Sales Development Representative
description:
About Freshpaint:

Healthcare is a $4+ trillion industry in the U.S. alone, and it’s undergoing a rapid digital transformation.

Hospitals, digital health companies, and life sciences organizations rely on analytics and advertising tools to reach patients, measure performance, and grow. But those tools weren’t built for regulated healthcare data. That creates real compliance risk and forces teams to choose between growth and privacy.

Freshpaint eliminates that trade-off.

We’re a privacy-first data platform that helps healthcare organizations use modern marketing and analytics tools without exposing protected health information (PHI). Freshpaint sits between a company’s website or app and the third-party tools they use, automatically detecting and controlling sensitive data before it’s shared.

In short: we let healthcare teams move fast, safely.

Backed by Top Investors

Freshpaint is backed by some of the most respected names in technology, including:

  • Y Combinator (OpenAI, Stripe, Airbnb, Coinbase, DoorDash)

  • Intel Capital (Broadcom, Astera Labs, VMware, RedHat, MongoDB)

We’ve raised tens of millions of dollars in funding to build the privacy infrastructure layer for healthcare’s digital future.

Who we’re looking for
We’re looking for a driven, aspiring seller who wants to build a career in sales and get very good, fast. You don’t need years of experience. You do need drive, discipline, and the curiosity to learn a complex space. The right person is competitive, coachable, resilient, and relentless: they can take a “no” on a cold call and pick up the phone again with the same energy. They want to understand why healthcare marketing is hard (HIPAA, tracking pixels, privacy risk) and can turn that into short, sharp outreach that gets a busy executive’s attention. They run their own day in a remote environment, apply feedback on the very next call, and see progress as part of winning.

What you’ll be doing
As an SDR on our Provider team, you’ll build net-new pipeline by booking first meetings with marketing, digital, and privacy leaders at health systems and specialty groups. These are the people who decide how patient data is used in marketing, and your work gives our Provider AEs a steady flow of high-quality first conversations. You’ll start with a structured 2-week onboarding bootcamp, get certified on our pitch and objection handling, and be fully ramped by the end of your second month. After that, it’s about steady results: high activity, real personalization, and clean execution.

Primary responsibilities

  • Ramp quickly: complete onboarding and certification, book your first qualified meeting within 30 days, and hit full quota by the end of Month 3

  • Book qualified first meetings and source new opportunities with marketing, digital, and privacy leaders at health systems and specialty groups

  • Consistently hit quota after ramp (roughly 5–6 opportunities and 10 meetings per month)

  • Help source $1.6M+ in qualified Provider pipeline in your first two full quarters

  • Own your weekly activity: 400 calls, 75 net-new prospects added to sequence, and 10+ live conversations

  • Research accounts using ZoomInfo, LinkedIn Sales Navigator, and news triggers to write outreach that references something real about the account

  • Invite target accounts to Freshpaint-led events (Growth Clinics, House Calls, webinars) and turn attendees into opportunities

  • Keep HubSpot clean: log every activity, book through the right flow, and make sure every meeting is attributed correctly

  • Review your own calls in Gong, take coaching, and keep improving your messaging

Desired skills & experience

  • Up to 1 year of SDR, BDR, or outbound sales experience, or a background in a target-driven, customer-facing role and a clear reason you want to be in sales

  • Comfortable with high-volume cold calling; rejection doesn’t slow you down

  • Aggressive in pursuit of expanding your knowledge & becoming a subject matter expert

  • You own your development: You don’t wait for your manager to find your gaps and help you solve for them. You analyze self performance and spot the areas for growth and build action plans around them.

  • Strong, concise writing: you can write a short, direct email a VP would actually read

  • Curiosity and willingness to learn a new, regulated industry in depth (no technical background required)

  • Organized and process-minded; you see CRM hygiene as part of doing the job well

  • Self-starter who can manage your own schedule in a fully remote environment and asks for help early

  • Coachable: you look for feedback and act on it fast

  • Se

  • Adaptable in a startup where priorities, products, and plays change often

Nice to haves

  • Exposure to healthcare, health tech, or another regulated industry

  • Experience with HubSpot (CRM and sequences), Gong, ZoomInfo, or LinkedIn Sales Navigator

  • Familiarity with digital marketing concepts like ad platforms, analytics, or tracking pixels

  • A track record of competing and winning, whether in sales, athletics, or something else

Perks & Benefits

We take care of our team—here’s a peek at what you get when you join:

  • Competitive pay + generous equity

  • Half-day Fridays, every Friday

  • 16 weeks fully paid parental leave (eligible after 6 months; commission-based roles receive 100% base salary during leave)

  • Flexible PTO with a required 2-week minimum

  • Top-tier health, dental & vision (100% covered for you, 80% for dependents)

  • Intentional & engaging company offsites (past trips: Arizona, Jackson Hole, Nashville, New Orleans & more)

And more! Check out our careers page for the full list.

title: OSP Licensing and Permitting Specialist
description:
Here at GoNetspeed, we believe in the power of connectivity. We believe that life doesn’t wait for us to catch up. We believe that providing the fastest and most reliable Internet to the communities we serve means committing to the present and building for the future.

And we believe that our amazing team of employees are the key to our future and vision of connecting communities for today and for whatever comes next. If this excites you, come and join our team.

The OSP Licensing & Permitting Specialist is responsible for obtaining, managing, and maintaining permits and approvals required for outside plant fiber and utility infrastructure projects. This role supports the successful delivery of OSP construction by coordinating with municipalities, utility companies, and regulatory agencies to ensure compliance with permitting requirements, joint use agreements, and project schedules.

Essential Job Functions:

License & Permit Application Management:
• Determines required permits based on project scope, OSP design, and jurisdiction
• Performs jurisdictional research
• Prepares, submits, tracks, and closes permits and applications for OSP construction (fiber, conduit, aerial and underground facilities)
• Reviews engineering and construction/permit drawings for permitting compliance
• Ensures compliance with Right-of-Way (ROW), easement, and environmental requirements
• Performs and/or coordinates Make Ready Engineering (MRE) activities, including clearance analysis and utility coordination
• Reviews, coordinates, and validates pole loading analysis (PLA) to ensure structural compliance with joint use and utility standards
• Coordinates with pole owning utilities regarding pole attachment requirements, relocations, replacement, and make ready timelines
• Tracks permit status, conditions, fees, and expiration dates
• Responds to agency comments and revises applications as needed
• Advises engineering on design changes required for permit approvals
• Mentors or guides OSP Licensing & Permitting Coordinators as needed

Regulatory Compliance:
• Interprets and applies utility agreements, municipal ordinances, and state/federal regulations related to utility pole attachments, conduit use, and ROW work
• Coordinates with municipalities, DOTs, utility companies, railroads, HOAs, and private property owners
• Resolves escalated permitting issues and conflicts
Coordination and Communication:
• Coordinates traffic control plans, lane closures, and inspection scheduling
• Communicates permit requirements and constraints to coordinators, engineering, construction, and project management teams
• Supports construction start dates by ensuring permits are approved and active
• Coordinates inspections, restoration requirements, and final sign-offs
• Maintains permit logs, documentation, data base, trackers
• Assists with audits, regulatory reporting, and record retention
Completes special projects as assigned by the Licensing & Permitting Manager*.
*These tasks do not meet the Americans with Disabilities Act definition of essential job functions and are usually less than 5% of time spent. However, these tasks still constitute important performance aspects of the job.

Knowledge, Skills, and Abilities:
• Strong knowledge of OSP construction (aerial, underground, fiber, conduit) and jurisdictional permitting requirements.
• Ability to interpret utility agreements, municipal ordinances, ROW rules, and state/federal regulations.
• Skilled in reviewing OSP engineering drawings, TC plans, and permit packages for compliance.
• Experience with Make Ready Engineering (MRE) and basic pole loading analysis (PLA) review.
• Ability to coordinate with pole‑owning utilities on attachments, relocations, and make‑ready timelines.
• Proven ability to resolve escalated permitting issues and agency comments.
• Strong communication skills for working with municipalities, DOTs, utilities, engineers, and construction teams.
• Excellent organization, documentation, and permit tracking skills; able to manage high permit volumes.
• Proficient with permitting databases, trackers, spreadsheets, and documentation systems.
• Ability to mentor or guide junior permitting staff.
• Ability to consistently follow‑up and strong attention to detail.
• Document control and reporting
• Professional, team‑oriented, and comfortable in a fast‑paced environment.

Education and Experience:
• High school diploma or equivalent required.
• 3–7 years of experience in OSP permitting, joint‑use licensing, or telecom utility coordination.

Compensation

Additional Information

GoNetspeed is an equal opportunity employer and does not discriminate on the basis of age, sex, gender identity, color, race, creed, national origin, religious persuasion, marital status, political belief, or disability.

Thank you for choosing GoNetspeed as your potential next employer! We know you have other options when selecting an employer of choice and are so glad you chose to apply with us.

title: Community Field Strategist- UK
description:
What We Do:

Cybercrime is growing, and more businesses are getting hit by threats that used to target only the biggest organizations. That pushes defenders like us to operate at the highest level, and it deepens our need for good people who want to make a meaningful impact.

Founded in 2015 by former NSA cyber operators, Huntress is a remote-first team working to make enterprise-grade cybersecurity accessible to businesses of all sizes. We work closely with security teams and service providers protecting complex environments, often without the time or headcount to handle it all. That’s why we build our technology in-house and back it with a 24/7 human-led Security Operations Center (SOC). As a result, our platform is never disconnected from the experts who manage it, ensuring our customers' protection.

Huntress now secures more than 6M endpoints and 17M identities worldwide. Those numbers keep growing because more businesses rely on us to help carry the load and operate with more confidence. Every day, you can see that commitment in how we stand with our customers and how we show up for each other.

Reports to: Manager, Community

Location: Remote UK

Compensation Range: £68,000 to £78,000 base plus bonus and equity

What You'll Do:

You are the person who brings Huntress to life in the room. You travel to roadshows, tradeshows, and other events, meet people who didn't plan to meet you, and turn genuine conversations into momentum for the business. Give More Than We Take shows up in the way you create value first, listen closely, and build relationships that feel human rather than transactional.

You are Outcome-Obsessed about creating meaningful engagements at events from the moment you leave your house to the moment you return, knowing that booth hours are just the tip of the iceberg. You make sure the right prospects receive thoughtful follow-up, account executives get the context they need, and qualified conversations become fully booked demo opportunities. You take ownership of the details, spot what is missing, and use sound judgment when the process needs to bend to serve the customer and the team.

Responsibilities:

  • Travel to assigned roadshows, tradeshows, and other events up to 60% of the time while representing Huntress with energy, professionalism, and a clear understanding of the audience.
  • Drive meaningful traffic to the Huntress booth with pre-event outreach, and by starting conversations, engaging attendees, and creating reasons for the right people to stop and learn more.
  • Execute on-site activations and feet-on-the-street account-based marketing activities as directed by your manager.
  • Build genuine relationships with prospects and partners, in transit, in hallways, over drinks, over dinner, at the booth, at event receptions and parties. Wherever the MSPs are, that’s where you’ll be found.
  • Drive interest through thoughtful conversation, and book demos at in-person events.
  • Manage event follow-up and relationship progression so account executives receive timely context, clear next steps, and strong opportunities to pursue.
  • Use AI tools to research target accounts, prepare for conversations, organize event notes, and draft timely follow-up while applying sound judgment to the final work.

What You Bring to the Team:

  • Experience engaging prospects at tradeshows, roadshows, conferences, or other in-person events is valuable.
  • You are curious, self-starting, eager to learn, driven, and comfortable taking initiative without waiting for perfect instructions.
  • You can engage strangers naturally, make small talk that leads somewhere useful, and build relationships without making the interaction feel transactional.
  • You are travel-ready and comfortable working in environments that require frequent movement, quick judgment, and consistent energy.
  • You are detail-oriented and able to follow a process while recognizing when the situation calls for a thoughtful deviation.
  • You use AI to work faster and smarter in day-to-day preparation, research, and follow-up, with good judgment about accuracy, privacy, and when human context matters most.

What We Offer:

  • 100% remote work environment - since our founding in 2015
  • New starter home office set up reimbursement (£398)

description:
GT was founded in 2019 by a former Apple, Nest, and Google executive. GT’s mission is to connect the world’s best talent with product careers offered by high-growth companies in the UK, USA, Canada, Germany, and the Netherlands.

On behalf of our client, a global cybersecurity company, GT is looking for an experienced Cyber Incident Commander interested in leading complex cyber incident response operations and contributing to the development of international cybersecurity capabilities.interested in leading complex cyber incident response operations and contributing to the development of international cybersecurity capabilities.

Work format: Remote, with readiness for international business travel.

About the Client & the Project

Our client is a global cybersecurity services and solutions provider helping government organisations, critical infrastructure providers, and businesses protect their operations against increasingly complex cyber threats.

The company brings together expertise in cybersecurity consulting, security monitoring, threat intelligence, technical security solutions, and incident response. Its mission is to help organisations strengthen their cyber resilience, minimise the impact of security incidents, and ensure effective recovery.

With an established international presence and a multidisciplinary team of cybersecurity professionals, the company is expanding its incident management capabilities.

The Incident Management function focuses on delivering a coordinated response to major cybersecurity incidents, combining technical investigations, operational coordination, crisis management, and strategic decision-making.

About the Role

As a Cyber Incident Commander, you will lead and coordinate the response to complex cybersecurity incidents, bringing together technical specialists, operational teams, and business stakeholders to ensure effective investigation, containment, remediation, and recovery.

This newly established leadership role offers an opportunity to shape incident response operations, manage and mentor cybersecurity specialists, and contribute to the continuous development of the company’s global incident management capabilities.

You will work closely with international teams and external stakeholders, combining strong technical cybersecurity expertise with leadership, crisis management, and decision-making skills.

Responsibilities:

  • Lead the response to major cybersecurity incidents, ensuring timely investigation, containment, mitigation, and resolution.

  • Manage and mentor a team of incident responders and technical specialists.

  • Coordinate technical, operational, and strategic response activities throughout the incident lifecycle.

  • Collaborate with specialists in threat attribution, cyber investigations, and incident mitigation.

  • Build and maintain relationships with law enforcement agencies, national CERTs, and regulatory bodies.

  • Act as the central point of coordination during cyber crises, ensuring effective communication between technical teams and business stakeholders.

  • Develop and refine incident response procedures, playbooks, and escalation protocols.

  • Collaborate with international incident management teams to ensure consistent practices and knowledge sharing across regions.

  • Conduct post-incident analysis and reporting, identifying lessons learned and areas for improvement.

  • Support the development of Security Operations Centre (SOC) capabilities and other cybersecurity functions as required.

  • Contribute to threat intelligence initiatives and proactive risk mitigation strategies.

Essential knowledge, skills & experience:

  • Proven experience in cybersecurity incident response and crisis management.

  • Strong technical background in cybersecurity, with the ability to understand, oversee, and guide technical investigations.

  • Experience working within international organisations and managing cross-border cybersecurity incidents.

  • Strong leadership experience, with the ability to manage and coordinate technical specialists and multidisciplinary teams.

  • Experience communicating with both technical and non-technical stakeholders.

  • Professional proficiency in English, with the ability to collaborate effectively with international colleagues.

  • Willingness to travel internationally.

Soft Skills:

  • Strong leadership and decision-making skills.

  • Excellent communication and stakeholder management skills.

  • Ability to remain effective under pressure and lead during critical situations.

  • Strong organisational and coordination skills.

  • Collaborative mindset and adaptability in a fast-paced, international environment.

Nice-to-have:

  • Experience managing complex or high-impact cybersecurity incidents.

  • Relevant cybersecurity certifications, such as CISSP, CISM, GIAC, or equivalent.

  • Experience with cyber crisis simulations or tabletop exercises.

  • Familiarity with threat intelligence platforms and digital forensic tools.

title: Customer Operations & Support Analyst
description:
About BigHand

BigHand offers technology solutions for busy legal professionals that provide data and insights to increase value and profits. Through our expert knowledge and innovative technology, we enable our customers to achieve enhanced efficiency, better decision-making and harness their competitive edge.

We build with tomorrow in mind, transforming ideas into action and empowering our customers to succeed in a world of constant change. We make big happen for our customers.

We are a business driven by our values and have these at the centre of everything we do. Our BigHanders are dedicated to building a culture where We Win Together, We Love to Learn, We Do the Right Thing, We Own It and We Find the Fun.

About the role

As a Customer Support Analyst at BigHand, you'll be the first point of contact for our clients across the APAC region, handling support enquiries, requests and incidents through our support channels. You'll take ownership of cases from start to finish, diagnosing technical and configuration issues across a range of technologies and working with our Product Specialists, Development, Customer Success and Account Management teams to get things resolved.

This is a chance to make a real difference to how the world's leading law firms experience our products, helping to improve customer satisfaction and product adoption along the way.

This role covers APAC hours, working 9:00 am to 5:30 pm AET.

What you’ll do

  • Provide first-line support for incidents and requests, following our case management processes.

  • Triage and diagnose client issues using playbooks and knowledge articles, carrying out remote investigations to restore product functionality.

  • Manage the full case lifecycle, working with Product Specialists, Development and Account Management to reach the right resolution.

  • Keep clients updated in line with our SLAs, and monitor cases through dashboards to make sure processes are followed.

  • Troubleshoot product integration challenges with client IT teams and BigHand experts, documenting and addressing any product shortcomings.

  • Create and maintain support documentation, including our internal and external knowledge base, known problems, defects, resolutions and support website.

What we’re looking for

  • Strong working knowledge of Microsoft Office (Word, PowerPoint and Excel) and Microsoft Windows Server.

  • The ability to explain technical concepts clearly to non-technical audiences.

  • Excellent organisation, documentation and record-keeping skills, with a keen eye for detail.

  • The ability to prioritise effectively and manage your own workload in a fast-paced environment, both independently and as part of a team.

  • Strong communication, listening and questioning skills, with a positive, can-do attitude and a genuine enthusiasm for helping people.

  • Various wellbeing benefits including private medical, online wellbeing programs & webinars, access to online therapy and Employee Resource Groups (ERG)

  • Opportunities to give back with company volunteer events and individual volunteer days

  • Career growth opportunities and study leave allowance

  • Family benefits including enhanced parental leave, secondary caregiver leave and fertility support

  • Financial benefits including life assurance, hardship loan and salary sacrificing

  • Access to over 500+ retail discounts through our company intranet

  • Fully remote working

  • Growing business with a global presence and a true focus on work-life balance

title: Billing Specialist
description:
Job Description:

Summary

Responsible for handling initial third-party payer billing (Medicare and managed care) for the purpose of reimbursement of services, cash receipts posting and other month-end charge entry duties; Upholds the philosophy, core values and goals of the organization and ensures that the Christian Mission of EverTrue is realized – “Older Adults Living Life to the Fullest”.

Responsibilities

1. Initial billing of skilled nursing facility/Anywhere Care claims to third party payers (Medicare, Managed Care, Commercial Insurance) or vendor Medicaid claims (Medicaid, Managed Care Medicaid and Medicaid Hospice) for multiple EverTrue sites, utilizing electronic claims submission

2. Ensures claims are received, and if returned to provider, resubmitted in a timely manner

3. Bills coinsurance claims where the primary insurance pays without issue; Refers more complex or past-due claims to the Senior Billing Specialist as needed

4. Posts cash receipts to Accounts Receivable (A/R) for third-party payer payments

5. May be responsible for filing of Medicare no-pay, benefit exhaust and information claims

6. Responsible for transferring claims to Senior Billing Specialist if:

  • Primary payer does not pay expected reimbursement, especially if in conflict with contract terms.

  • Claim aging becomes >90 days, or under 90 days and not submitted to payer and acknowledged

  • Claim is being audited/reviewed for any reason (ADR, CERT, RAC)

  • Claim non-payment/under-payment needs to be appealed

7. Maintains up-to-date technical knowledge of applicable Medicare/Medicaid/Managed Care/Anywhere Care billing rules and regulations via the CMS website, MAC website, etc.

8. Inputs Medicare ancillary charges in billing system in a timely manner

9. Serves as a resource to residents and community billing staff for applicable insurance benefit related issues

10. Serves as backup to RCM Billing Specialist; Handles verification of resident’s Medicare/Medicare Managed Care/Medicaid/Commercial Insurance benefits prior to receipt of third-party billable services

11. May handle small balance adjustments of $10 or less

12. May be responsible for maintaining Medicare Coinsurance bad debt schedule for cost report

13. Handles maintenance of resident income related to retroactive vendor Medicaid authorizations or retroactive changes in resident income

14. Handles Medicaid re-billing of charges related to retroactive vendor Medicaid authorizations or retroactive changes in resident income

Qualifications, Knowledge, Skills & Abilities

  • High School diploma

  • 1 – 3 years of Medicare billing experience

  • Proficient computer skills including Microsoft Outlook, Excel and Word are required

Physical Requirements and Working Conditions

The physical activities and demands described here are representative of those an employee encounters while performing the essential functions of this job. Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential job duties and responsibilities.

Lifting up to 30 pounds; Pushing/pulling 100 lbs. on wheels; A well-lighted and ventilated working area that has its own temperature control system (air conditioning and heat); The work will have some short notice requests, timelines for completion of tasks or reports and some major projects extending over months; Minimal exposure to infectious diseases and blood borne pathogens; Minimal exposure to chemicals and hazardous waste; Minimal exposure to outside weather conditions.

This job description is intended to describe the general nature and level of work performed by those assigned to this classification. This job description in no way states or implies that these are the only duties to be performed by those occupying this position. The job description and job functions described herein are subject to possible modification by EverTrue in accordance with applicable federal, state, and local laws.

SYSTRA Canada is part of the SYSTRA group, an international consulting and engineering group, a world leader in the design of transport infrastructures. The ALTO project is a major infrastructure initiative in Canadian history, aimed at developing over 1,000 km of new passenger rail service between major urban centers, including Toronto, Ottawa, Montreal and Quebec City.

Cost Monitoring & Reporting

  • Monitor and report project costs, forecasts, and variances.

Risk & Opportunity Management

Compliance & Audit Support

Ми в пошуках AI Game Architect із сильною експертизою в Game Design на рівні Senior, який самостійно перетворюватиме ідеї на готові мобільні ігри для Google Play та iOS за допомогою AI-інструментів.

В основі ролі — Game Design, системне мислення та цілісне продуктове бачення. Це не класична позиція Developer або AI Engineer: роль передбачає як розробку концепції гри, так і її практичну реалізацію. На ранніх етапах робота над грою відбувається практично самостійно. Якщо прототип або MVP демонструє сильні результати, навколо продукту поступово формується повноцінна команда.

Основні обов’язки:

  • Створення ігор: самостійно створювати нові мобільні ігри з нуля до релізу.

  • Game Design: проектувати core gameplay, метасистеми, прогресію, ігрову економіку та монетизацію.

  • AI-інструменти: використовувати Claude Code, Cursor, Codex та інші AI-інструменти для створення ігор.

  • Продуктові рішення: аналізувати результати та ухвалювати рішення щодо подальших ітерацій, припинення роботи над продуктом або його масштабування — Iterate / Kill / Scale.

  • Розвиток після запуску: проводити перші продуктові ітерації після релізу.

  • Масштабування продуктів: передавати успішні продукти на масштабування та допомагати формувати команду.

  • AI / Unity pipeline: удосконалювати пайплайн для повторного використання під час створення наступних ігор.

Очікування від кандидата:

  • Сильний досвід у Game Design / Systems Design.

  • Досвід роботи над великими мобільними проєктами, бажано в сегменті mid-core.

  • Уміння самостійно формувати цілісне бачення гри, а не лише окремих фіч.

  • Практичний досвід роботи з Unity.

  • Технічне мислення та розуміння базової структури ігрового проєкту.

  • Досвід створення власних прототипів, інструментів або ігор за допомогою AI.

  • Розуміння продуктових метрик мобільних ігор і вміння працювати ітеративно на основі результатів тестів.

Процес підбору:

  1. Інтервʼю з рекрутером.

  2. Тестове завдання.

  3. Інтервʼю з наймаючим менеджером.

  4. Збір рекомендацій.

  5. Офер.

Що ми пропонуємо:

Бенефіт-кафе: Свобода вибору — персональний бюджет на страхування, навчання, спортзал чи будь-що для твого балансу.

Бонуси за досягнення: Цінуємо strive for excellence і командну гру, відзначаємо помітні результати, ініціативу та реальний вплив.

Remote First: Працюй з будь-якої точки світу — віддалена робота є стандартом, а не винятком.

Вплив на бізнес: Мінімум бюрократії, максимум свободи дій і можливість втілювати свої ідеї.

Career Boost: Розвиток професійної експертизи, навчання, внутрішні тренінги, стратегічні сесії.

Culture Driver: Атмосфера єдиної команди, де успіх — результат спільної праці.
